    different callee-saved regs (r27/r26 vs r31/r30) and can crack an
    otherwise-stuck register-role swap. Related: STAGED SEQUENTIAL calls
    beat nested-call forms when WANT saves fewer registers - nesting spills
    extra saved regs around the inner call (800F52EC).
89. **Byte-countdown copy loops need `-fno-strength-reduce
    -fno-schedule-insns2`.** GCC strength-reduces trip>=3 countdown loops
    into `mtctr/bdnz`; WANT keeps them as addi/cmpwi/bne. Flag pair via
    `// FLAG:` marker (twin fn_800346D8 uses it); plain sched flags don't
    prevent the conversion.
90. **m2c stack-float statics shrink drafts (signature).** When a
    draft body is much SHORTER than want and full of dead `0;` float
    stubs, m2c modeled stack floats as file-scope statics and DCE ate the
    math. Don't polish such drafts - re-derive from disasm (whole
    0x800F9xxx-0x800FCxxx zone parks on this + PS ops).

## 6m — learnings (2026-08-22, 23 promoted / 8 EXACT-in-wip /
11 parked; script-wrapper zone 0x8010Fxxx-0x80112xxx)

Baseline was 1 EXACT / 33 DIFF. Cracked via parallel sub-agents plus the
recipes above; all findings below are verified byte-exact unless noted.

91. **Comma-sequence assignments INSIDE call arguments flip the saved-reg
    window.** ScriptClamp (fn_8011048C): writing the double-clamp as a
    comma chain in the setter's argument list -
    `(var_f13 = ((sp8 > sp10) ? sp10 : sp8), (var_f13 < minv) ? minv :
    var_f13)` with `minv` staged into its own named temp first - flipped
    ngccc's prologue from `stmw r30,2-slot` to WANT's `stmw r29,3-slot`
    (phantom r31 slot) and reproduced the optimistic-copy float dance.
    Plain if/else or separate-statement forms keep the smaller prologue
    and never match. When a NEAR wrapper's ONLY diffs are prologue frame/
    stmw span + float reg roles, try comma-chaining the assignments at the
    call site before anything else.
92. **Two-return max/min-clamp folds to `fsel`; symmetric form stays
    branchy.** fn_80111894: `if (v > max) return max; return v;` folds
    into fsel+fsubs and pushes the result to f13; the matching form is
    `if (v > max) v = max; return v;` (single tail return), which emits
    WANT's branchy `fcmpu/blelr/fmr` chain with the result living in f1
    throughout. Same family as recipe 14 but the trap is inverted: here
    the TERNARY-LIKE early returns are what fold - avoid two `return`
    sites in clamps.
93. **GCC sorts 8-aligned locals LOW: declare real double-backed slots
    FIRST.** fn_80110F7C needed TWO volatile-double dummies AND its real
    out-slot sp8 backed by a third volatile double declared as the FIRST
    local - GCC's local sort puts 8-aligned objects at the bottom of the
    frame, so declaration ORDER decides which slot lands at +8. Refines
    recipes 28/63: when an FPR-frame function also has real doubles,
    order them (real ones first) instead of only prepending dummies.
94. **Named s32 temps preserve lwz width on u8 fields.** SetFogColor:
    reading a byte field directly through a `(u8 *)` deref narrows to
    `lbz`, but reading it into a NAMED s32 temp first keeps WANT's wide
    `lwz` (the narrow store then uses stb from the temp). Sibling of item
    4p.4 and recipe 80 (volatile-read variant); use whichever matches
    WANT. Also there: chained init `fs.c2 = fs.c1 = fs.c0 = 0xFF;`
    reproduces the game's exact three-store schedule under rule 24.
95. **Eager bitwise boolean materialization reproduces cached cr
    compares.** UpdateAnimCache (EXACT) and SetUVWibbleParams: instead of
    one combined condition, materialize each test into its own named int
    first - `s32 t0 = (a != 0); s32 t1 = (b != 0); ... if ((t0 & t1) ==
    0)` - which lets GCC reuse cr6/cr7 comparison results exactly like
    WANT. Distinct from the §6b branchy-goto form (that one reproduces
    branch SHAPES; this one reproduces cr-flag CACHING).
96. **Integer-roundtrip store base defeats callee-saved FPR caching of
    array elements.** RotateVector investigation (parked on other
    grounds, trick probe-verified): GCC caches m[i] loads across product
    stores into callee-saved FPRs f21-f31 (frame balloons +0x30); routing
    the base through an integer roundtrip - `f32 *mp = (f32 *)(s32)&m[0];
    pp = mp + 0x20;` - forces per-element reloads like WANT. Related:
    helper-pointer stack round-trips via `void * volatile` reproduce
    WANT's stw+lwz spill of derived pointers.
97. **Sparse-hash script switch trees: default-first case order after a
    (u32) cast.** InitAnimSystem (96.1% park): the hash switch matched
    once the index was cast `(u32)` and cases were ordered so the DEFAULT
    body comes first (WANT roots the tree with `cmplw/bgt` to default).
    Extends item 84; remaining diff there is a leaf-vs-inline-default
    layout coin-flip (recipe-51 class).

## 6o — learnings (2026-08-22, 26 EXACT / 7 parked,
script-command zone fn_80146CA4–fn_80150590)

Baseline 5 EXACT / 4 NEAR / 24 DIFF → 26 EXACT via parallel sub-agents.
Most fixes were existing recipes applied (0-arg flush helpers per §6a,
hidden-arg passthrough, chained returns, lbl folded loads,
volatile-double frames — fn_8014E30C needed SEVEN dummies, and note the
sweep auto-injects only ONE: N>1 must be edited by hand). New findings:

1. **GPR register-pin generalizes beyond loop counters/FPRs.**
    `register s32 var_r30 __asm__("r30");` forces WHICH callee-saved GPR
    holds a value, cracking role-assignment coin-flips that resist every
    source shape (cracked ScriptFakeLights EXACT; got ScriptGetAnalogueInfo
    to 96.6%). Generalizes recipe 74 (r9 countdown) / recipe 67 (fr13
    float) to plain s32 values. Try it when the only diff is which saved
    reg a pseudo landed in — but pinning moves OTHER allocations too
    (fn_8014DDFC: pinning r0 pushed all switch-tree constants to r9);
    always re-diff the whole body.
99. **The inverse of §6a-3: genuinely 0-arg callees get phantom literal
    args from m2c.** The 80146xxx wrapper family stores `lbl_XXXX` to
    arg0+0xC then calls a flush helper whose prologue reads NO argument
    registers; m2c passed the rodata literal as arg1 (emitting lis+ori +
    spurious crclr). WANT leaves r3 untouched at the bl → declare
    `void fn_X(void);` and call with no args. Tell: callee prologue reads
    zero arg registers AND want's r3 is untouched at the call site.
100. **The subfic/adde bool fold needs EQUALITY, not `!= 0`.**
    `(field == ret)` emits xor+subfic+adde; `x != 0` compiles branchy;
    M2C_CARRY arithmetic is wrong when comparing two VALUES. Refines
    §6b-1: first pick the comparison polarity (`==`), then choose between
    statement form (folds) / goto form (branchy).    Batch confirmation
    (2026-08-30): the m2c bool-fold artifact `(0 - X) + X + M2C_CARRY` rewrites
    mechanically to `(X == 0)` (polarity-inverted where wrapped `== 0`/
    `!= 0`), clearing the .bss carry-static and promoting fn_80032AA0 /
    fn_800E2FF0 to EXACT; the SAME rewrite regressed ~16 drafts that were
    already far from matching (recipe-100 only pays off near a match).
    Distinct CLASS-B subset (2026-08-30): the `- !M2C_CARRY` borrow-form is
    NOT a uniform u64 subtract. Real subfc/subfe pairs reconstruct as u64
    chains (fn_800AF78C EXACT via `*(u64*)(o+0x34A0) += fn() - *(u64*)(o+
    0x34A8)`); but the other forms are different idioms — 64-bit NEGATE
    (srawi/subfic/subfze, fn_8026BD70/D288), `==1`→`&2` mask (addic/subfe/
    rlwinm, fn_80102E8C), sign-bit mask (subfic/addic/subfe/rlwinm,
    fn_8000B6F8) — the `!M2C_CARRY` is m2c mangling a different borrow
    idiom each time.    Classify before reconstructing; do NOT blanket-rewrite.
    64-bit NEGATE recipe (2026-08-30, fn_8026BD70/D288 = newlib
    __svfprintf_r/__svfiprintf_r): the want sequence
    `mr r31,r0; srawi r30,r0,31; cmpwi r30,0; bge; li r0,0x2d; subfic
    r31,r31,0; subfze r30,r30; stb` is `s64 x = (s64)v; if (x < 0) { x =
    -x; out = 0x2D; }` — VERIFIED byte-exact in isolation. The negate must
    stay IN-PLACE in the live pair regs (r30:r31), so it only reproduces
    from a true s64 variable, never from split-var emulations (0-l /
    -h-(l!=0) emit neg/subf instead). Grafting an s64 round-trip at just
    the site forces temps + 8 shuffle insns (want's pair stays live):
    fn_8026BD70 masked 29->60/1297 (kept, downstream regalloc cascade)
    but the site itself still mismatches and object grows 24B; fn_8026D288
    regressed 42->27 (reverted). Real fix = convert the WHOLE format state
    machine to one s64 var so the pair stays live through the negate. Polarity re-sweep
    (2026-08-30) on the 17 reverted class-B drafts: NO `(X == 0)`/`(X != 0)`/
    bare/`!X` variant beats the m2c form on ANY of them — the regressions came
    from the fold living inside divergent surrounding code, not from fold
    polarity (want's subfic/adde is unambiguously `X == 0`). m2c's `CARRY=0`
    occasionally compiles to the right `add` in context where the rewrite
    reschedules. recipe-100 ONLY pays off when the fold is an isolated
    value-return (fn_80032AA0/fn_800E2FF0), never mid-function.
    Re-triage sweep (2026-08-30, remaining 23 drafts with the static): the
    isolated-position rule extends to call-ARGUMENT folds — 3 more EXACT
    promotions, all small drafts where the fold is the ONLY artifact:
      fn_800A660C (80B): `fn_800A5ADC(lbl, r == 0, sp8)` where r = a
      callee's return; want subfic/adde on the call result. Also the r3
      passthrough arg m2c dropped (call takes 4 args, first = the
      function's own arg0, never set locally).
      fn_800A24C8 (220B): comparison switch; cases 10/12 were m2c's
      `return 0 + M2C_CARRY` = LOST comparison operand. want: subfc+li+
      adde (unsigned >=). CRITICAL: case 10 = `byte >= r9` vs case 12 =
      `r9 >= byte` are DIFFERENT expressions (want's subfc operand order
      differs) — writing them identically merges the case bodies and
      breaks layout. Case 8's fold = `(r9 ^ byte) == 0`. Switch on u32
      (cmplwi dispatch) with the switch value loaded AFTER the calls.
      fn_800F4040 (120B): vtable dispatch; m2c passed `vt` as the first
      call's 2nd arg but want passes arg1 through (r4 untouched); second
      call is 6 args not 7; offsets are lha (s16) fields. Fold = `r == 0`.
    Triage rule: sweep the 23 by SIZE + fold position. Small (<250B) with
    the fold isolated (return/call-arg) and NO other structural diff =
    promotable. Mid/large (fn_8004D3A4 296B, fn_800379CC 432B, ...) —
    even with the fold corrected the frame/regalloc diverges (the
    big-function allocator-order wall); the draft's true blocker is NOT
    the carry static. Remaining 20 drafts: 14 far-from-match class-B
    bool-folds (recipe-100 no-op), 4 reclassified borrow-forms (negate /
    masks), 1 needs full rebuild (fn_800AE250), 1 pre-existing broken
    (fn_801CCB68).
101. **Count GPR and FPR arg registers INDEPENDENTLY when inferring
    signatures.** PPC SysV: ints take r3-r10, floats take f1-f13 in
    separate counter streams, so `(s32, f32, f32, f32, f32, s32)` puts
    the trailing s32 in **r4** (next free GPR after r3) — miscounting
    from want's mixed mr/lfs sequence broke fn_8014F1FC until this was
    applied to its call into fn_8014E440. Use for every arity guess on
    float-heavy callees.
102. **QB_ constants can shadow sibling hashes of the same name family.**
    In fn_80150164's hash switch, `QB_CLASS` existed as the QUERY hash
    0x12B4E660 but the real case is 0xA0DFAC98 (different string, same
    name family). gen_qb_constants maps each NAME to one hash — always
    verify case literals against WANT's lis/ori pair before trusting a
    plausible-looking constant name.
103. **Negative results:** `-fno-crossjumping` / `-fno-reorder-blocks`
    do not exist in ProDG cc1 — when GCC tail-MERGES two identical return
    blocks that WANT keeps separate (fn_8014E114, 74% park), only source
    shapes help (make the sites textually distinct); no flag rescues it.
    And fn_8014E440 extends the doc06 PS wall to XO5=8 words (see that
    doc) — park immediately on undecodable primary-opcode-4 words.

## 6p — learnings (2026-08-23, 32 EXACT / 14 parked,
script-command zone fn_801588B0–fn_8015B210)

Baseline 1 EXACT / 5 NEAR / 40 DIFF → 32 EXACT via parallel sub-agents
(2 of the EXACTs are `__ps_t` drafts needing `-mps-float`). New findings:

104. **TRUTH_ORIF construct forces the store-flag bool in branch context.**
    When WANT emits `xor; subfic; adde` (+ cmpwi/beq wrapper) for a boolean
    computed inside an if/branch — where plain `(x == K)` folds to
    xoris/cmpwi and can NEVER match — write the condition as
    `!(!(a || 0))` (double-negated truth-or-zero). GCC 2.95 materializes
    it through the store-flag path, emitting the exact subfic/adde idiom.
    Combine with equality polarity (`(x ^ K) == 0`, recipe 100). Cracked
    fn_8015A5C8's tail to 98.2% and fn_80158AD80 fully. Generalization:
    `a || 0` alone in a condition context reproduces or.-based bools.
105. **`"+r"` asm barrier blocks const-propagation of a stack out-param
    re-read into a callee argument.** After the script engine writes
    `sp8`, passing `sp8` to a SECOND callee gets constant-folded to the
    pre-call value; `__asm__("" : "+r"(temp_r4));` on the re-read temp
    forces the reload (fn_80159CE4, EXACT). Extends recipe 78's "+f"
    float barrier and doc06 technique-2 pin to out-param flows.
106. **List-walker script commands park as a family** — two compiler walls,
    documented in docs/parkings/32-walker-role-rotation.md: (A) cyclic
    saved-register role rotation across {arrBase, hash, threshold} that
    resists pins (they over-constrain: alloc collapse or frame balloons),
    all decl-order permutations (no-op), and schedule flags — note the
    pA/pB asm barriers in these drafts are LOAD-BEARING, removing them
    collapses the body to ~16%; (B) prologue stores via frame-derived
    scratch r9 + saved-reg copy, which ngccc always folds to displacement
    form. Members: EC8/C2C/9078/AE3C + 9894/9A48. Don't re-grind these
    without a new idea from another function first.
107. **Tooling gap — PS drafts FAIL in sweeps without the flag.**
    test_wip_drafts.py does NOT auto-detect `__ps_t` drafts: they report
    FAIL under the default sweep but compile EXACT with
    `--extra-cflags "-mps-float"` (promote_wip.py DOES auto-detect via the
    marker). Before parking a PS-looking draft as FAIL, always re-run its
    sweep with the flag once. (fn_8015896C/fn_80158A00 were exactly this.)
108. **Promote-time caveat on (f32)(f64)(s32) EXACTs.** Letting ngccc
    synthesize its own int→float conversion can match .text bytes (the
    cast `(f32)(f64)(s32)v * f` even reproduces frsp-before-fmuls FPR
    roles naturally — cracked 801594D4), BUT the synthesized pool constants
    land in module `.rodata`, not the game's `.rodata2` (doc 14 blocker)
    — masked-sweep EXACT ≠ promotable for any draft containing such casts
    unless want's own pool doubles are referenced manually (§6j-1 dance).
    fn_80159BEC was promoted through it (pool lbl_802A8170) and fn_80159C68 is
    now EXACT-in-wip through it (pool lbl_802A8178, §6gh) — i.e. the pool is
    a bookkeeping item, never a reason to keep hunting for a different cast.
    Check at promote time, not sweep time.
109. **Recipe-57 staging extends to branchy-bool/arg-load interleave.**
    Staging call arguments into named temps BEFORE the branchy ternary
    bool reproduces want's exact load/branch interleave at call sites —
    not just operand order in straight-line code (fn_8015B0AC/B138 EXACT;
    also fn_801588B0: staging both s32 returns tested pre-loop reproduces
    long-range CR machinery incl. callee-saved cr4 via mfcr/mtcrf).

## 6p — learnings (2026-08-22, 28 EXACT-in-wip / 6 parked, nothing promoted)

All verified on drafts (`0x8010Cxxx–0x8010F2xx`, script-command
zone). Baseline was 0 EXACT / 34 DIFF; final state 28 byte-exact drafts in
src/wip/ (incl. one `-mps-float` PS fn) + 6 parked with best-match bodies.
New parking doc: [27-float-farg-coalesce.md](docs/parkings/solved/27-float-farg-coalesce.md) (SOLVED 2026-08-23).

104. **Counted-loop latch is compare-OLD-then-decrement.**
     `} while (--cnt != -1);` emits want's `cmpwi cnt,0; addi cnt,-1; bne`;
     the natural post-decrement `cnt-- != 0` instead emits an extra
     `mr r0,cnt` temp copy (fn_8010C350/C3CC EXACT). Countdown-init variant:
     pre-load the count into the SAME variable then
     `for (v = v - 1; v != -1; v--)` — forces `lwz`→saved-reg + fuses the
     guard `cmpwi/addi/beq` (fn_8010C4C8 EXACT; proven earlier on fn_800DE594).
105. **Frame+8 vs stack-slot ordering CONFLICT (refines recipe 63).** Any
     ≥8-byte or volatile local steals stack slot 8 — when `&sp8` must stay at
     r1+8 AND an FPR frame needs the +8 headroom, use same-size PLAIN pads
     pinned with asm `"m"` operands:
     `__asm__("" : : "m"(sp8), "m"(padA), "m"(padB));` Same-size pads tie on
     cost → declaration order decides slots (fn_8010CA64 EXACT). A padded
     struct + separate sp18 works too (fn_8010EA28, frame 0x30).
106. **Distinct temp names per call result keep results in r3.** One shared
     temp name for two call results gives call #2's result a saved-reg home
     (`or. r4,r3,r3` + copy-back); distinct names keep it in r3 for in-place
     test + chained passthrough (fn_8010CA64 EXACT).
107. **Loop bound as plain element index on an extern array symbol.**
     `lbl_803830E8[2]` (NO char* cast, NO local pointer) reproduces want's
     full lis+addi materialization + displaced loads + `mr` into the
     loop-carried reg; a local-pointer form rotates the double test away;
     a char*-cast form folds @l into each load and rematerializes twice.
     Extends recipe 59 from lookups to loop bounds (fn_8010CB44 EXACT).
108. **Assignment-in-condition stages an arg-setup between tests of `&&`.**
     `(t = (char *)p + 0xBC)` as the second && operand places its `addi`
     exactly between the two compares where every separate statement form
     hoists or sinks it (fn_8010D0E8 EXACT).
109. **Early-return literal shapes extend §4s polarity.** `if (x != 0)
     { ...; return 0; } return 1;` gives want's `or.` + shadow `li r3,0` +
     bne-to-epilogue where the m2c var_r3 form hoists wrongly (fn_8010CB44);
     the INVERTED guard `if (ret == 0) return 0;` reproduces beq-first +
     separate li-block layouts (fn_8010ED3C). Pick polarity by which block
     sits at want's branch target.
110. **Bitfield-view assignment forces rlwimi fusion.** Separate mask/or
     statements never fuse; declaring the word as a big-endian bitfield view
     (`u32 typ:7`) and assigning the field emits `li + rlwimi` inserts;
     union form covers `oris+rlwimi` too (`u.b.fld = 0x2B`; fn_8010EA28,
     fn_8010E820 EXACT).
111. **Register-pin for CALL-SLOT targeting.** Recipe 98 pins callee-saved
     homes; pinning an ARG register instead —
     `register s32 t __asm__("r9");` — controls WHICH call-arg slot (r3-r10)
     a value occupies when normal forms pick another reg. Combine with
     invisible clobbers `__asm__ volatile("" ::: "r3")` to force `or./mr`
     copy shapes emission-free (fn_8010EA28 EXACT).
112. **fixuns float→u32 dodge for doc-14.** Write the conversion as manual
     branches `if (!(a >= K)) {plain} else {a - 2^32 form}` referencing a
     REAL rodata2 f64 symbol (`extern f64 lbl_8029CE98` = 2^31): reproduces
     the canonical `cror cr0un,cr0eq,cr0gt; bso` expansion WITHOUT emitting
     private `.rodata`; a bare `(u32)` cast matches standalone but can never
     promote (fn_8010EEA8 EXACT). Positive-condition if/else also emits
     want's out-of-line float-compare return block (fn_8010C5DC EXACT,
     `-mps-float`).
113. **Out-param-filled float groups must be ONE address-taken array.**
     Individual scalars are UB (ngccc proves non-address-taken siblings
     undefined → leaves callee-saved FPRs uninitialized); `f32 in[5]` as a
     unit gets exact frame layout + slot order (fn_8010E6DC park notes).
114. **Mixed ABI arity: interleave r/f regs in prototype guesses.** Floats
     take f1-f13 and ints r3-r10 in SEPARATE counters, so
     `fn_8011A2AC(s32,void*,s32,f32,s32,f32,s32,f32)` puts floats in
     f1/f2/f3 and ints in r3,r4,r5,r6,r7 (fn_8010C86C EXACT). Refines
     recipe 101 — m2c routinely flattens these to all-s32.
115. **capstone prints rlwinm MB/ME as MSB-first bit positions.** Want
     `mb=0xa,me=7` = `& 0xFF3FFFFF`, `mb=9,me=7` = `& 0xFF7FFFFF` — convert
     before deriving C mask constants, else you "fix" the wrong bits
     (fn_8010E820).
115b. **`mfcr rX ; rlwinm rX,rX,SH,MB,MB` = a bool materialization, and the
     extracted bit is `(MB + SH) mod 32` of the 32-bit mfcr value** (CR0 sits
     at bits 0-3, so CR7 = bits 28..31 = LT,GT,EQ,SO, and a single-bit mask
     `MB` keeps weight `2^(31-MB)`). Two consequences that decide whole
     functions:
       - **equality can NEVER match this shape** — `(a == b)` lowers to the
         xor/subfic/adde adder fold (3 words, NO `cror`), while RELATIONAL
         comparisons lower to the CR extract. If want has `mfcr`+`rlwinm`
         with no preceding `cror`, the source is `<`/`>` (single bit), not
         `==`.
       - calibrate with the sibling shape: `>=` emits
         `cror crNun,crNeq,crNgt` + `rlwinm ..,2,29,29` ((29+2)%32 = 31 =
         CR7.SO); `<` emits no `cror` and `rlwinm ..,0x1f,0x1d,0x1d`
         ((29+31)%32 = 28 = CR7.LT). Mask 29 = weight 4, i.e. ngccc folded the
`*4` index scaling into the extract (m2c renders it as `& 4` or as
     `(u32)0 >> 1U`). fn_80078948: `p[arg2 < arg4 - 1]` = 100%; the `==`
     and `<=` forms cap at 9–14%.
115c. **CORRECTION to 115b (fn_8003F80C EXACT-in-wip, 3.9.3): `==` DOES
     lower to the CR extract for FLOATS, and the extract's SH is the whole
     signature.** Probe-calibrated on `s32 r = a OP b;` (f32 a,b — same
     SH values for `cmpw cr7`):
     | source | want shape |
     |---|---|
     | `a < b` | `fcmpu cr7,a,b` + `mfcr` + `rlwinm ..,0x1d,0x1f,0x1f` |
     | `a > b` | `fcmpu cr7,a,b` + `mfcr` + `rlwinm ..,0x1e,0x1f,0x1f` |
     | `a == b`| `fcmpu cr7,a,b` + `mfcr` + `rlwinm ..,0x1f,0x1f,0x1f` |
     | `a != b`| `fcmpu` + `crnot cr7un,cr7eq` + `mfcr` + `clrlwi ..,0,0x1f,0x1f` |
     | `a <= b`| `fcmpu` + `cror cr7un,cr7eq,cr7lt` + `mfcr` + `rlwinm ..,0,0x1f,0x1f` |
     | `a >= b`| `fcmpu` + `cror cr7un,cr7eq,cr7gt` + `mfcr` + `rlwinm ..,0,0x1f,0x1f` |
     So 115b's "equality can NEVER match this shape" is only true for
     **INTEGER** `==` (xor+adde fold, verified still true). A want
     `mfcr`+`rlwinm ..,0x1f,0x1f,0x1f` with no cror/crnot is a FLOAT `==`
     — and m2c renders it as the nonsense constant `((u32)0 >> 1U) & 1`,
     which sends you hunting for casts/bit tricks instead. Same for
     `0x1d`=`<` and `0x1e`=`>`. The mask is ALWAYS `0x1f,0x1f` (single bit
     at 31) unless an `*4`/`*2` scale is folded in (115b's `& 4` case).
     Field positions (validated via `a<<3` == `rlwinm r3,r3,3,0,28`):
     SH = bits 15-11, MB = bits 10-6, ME = bits 5-1. Capstone's SH for
     `rlwinm` is unreliable on these words (it printed `0x1e` for a true
     `0x1d`) — read the raw word, not the disassembly.
     Companion for the same function: `lwzux rD,rA,rB` (pre-indexed update
     load) requires REASSIGNING the incoming POINTER PARAMETER
     (`arg1 = (u32 *)((char *)arg1 + off); ... arg1[0]`) — a fresh local gives
     `lwzx` + separate `add`.
116. **Volatile-cast struct field stores serialize store order.** Casting
     each lvalue `(volatile s32 *)` per store (+ volatile sp8) forces ngccc's
     exact store serialization/slot choice when plain stores coalesce or
     reorder (fn_8010C6C0 EXACT); same file: `extern f32 lbl_X;` referenced
     directly folds lis+lfs like recipe 53 does for lwz. And empty
     `for(i=0;i<N;i++){}` loops DO survive ProDG -O2 as `li r0,N; mtctr;
     bdnz$` with scheduler-filled delay slots (refines recipe 73; fn_8010D340).


## 6q — learnings (2026-08-23, 35 EXACT-in-wip / 15 parked, nothing promoted)

 (fn_801403D8..fn_80146C58): baseline 0 EXACT / 1 NEAR / 49 DIFF →
35 EXACT / 7 NEAR (93-98%) / 8 hand-rebuilt DIFF parks. Worked as 1 direct +
6 parallel sub-agents; each touched only its own src/wip drafts.

84. **The fourteen-destructor-twin family (fn_8014687C..fn_80146C58, 76B
    each) fell to ONE pattern.** m2c drafts call the middle callee WITH the
    vtable/data label literal as arg0 (`fn_800F20D4(0x8029FCF0)`); the
    callees are actually **0-arg global-countdown resets** (pattern-b
    prologue: `lis r31; lwz r9,cnt(r31); cmplwi r9,1` — never reads r3).
    Fix: `static void fn_CALLEE(void);` proto + plain `fn_CALLEE();` call,
    store via `(s32)lbl_X` + `extern char lbl_X[]`, `if (arg1 & 1)`
    tail-guard calling `fn_80009AAC((void *)arg0)`. All 14 EXACT verbatim.
    Generalizes recipe 40: when a draft passes a DATA-LABEL literal as an
    argument and WANT shows no arg setup at the bl, check the callee's
    prologue before trusting m2c's arity.
85. **mfcr/mtcrf is NOT a wall by itself — long-range CR liveness across
    calls is.** Same idiom (`mfcr r12` in prologue + `mtcrf 0x18,r12` in
    epilogue) appears in EXACT fn_80143D28 AND its parked
    fn_80141FAC. The reproducible form: two conditions consumed CLOSE
    together — `(a != 0) || (b != 0)` naturally reuses cr3/cr4 incl. the
    mfcr save. The blocked form: conditions tested early, branched ~20
    insns later ACROSS one or more `bl`s (GCC keeps them in callee-saved
    CR fields). if/else orderings, bool temps (fold to subfic/adde),
    __builtin_expect, switch, goto forms, all five ProDG versions all fail.
    Survey: 406 .text fns contain mfcr, only 3 matched so far. See
    docs/parkings/28-cr-save-condition-liveness-across-calls.md.
86. **Frame-template struct locals pin exact sp layout INCLUDING holes and
    defeat GCC's 8-aligned-local sorter** (fn_80141570 EXACT): declare the
    stack slots as ONE struct `{u8 sp8[4]; u8 spB[4]; u8 spC[4]; s32;
    f32; char pad[24];} frame;` and address members. Individual locals get
    sorted/re-aligned by GCC and land in the wrong slots; the struct keeps
    declaration order. Stronger form of §6j-7 for frames where several
    differently-sized out-param slots interleave with f32s.
87. **Loop-invariant address setup written AFTER the setup calls forces the
    game's param-scratch `mr rN,r3` hop** (fn_80145168 EXACT): placing the
    walker computation after the call block keeps it from hoisting above
    them; every "cleaner" direct/hoisted form folds the copy away. Also:
    REMOVE a stale `// FLAG:` line the moment it stops being needed —
    promotion re-verifies against whatever flags the header still carries
    (a leftover flag can pass wip sweeps but wire wrong per-object cflags).
88. **`(f32)(f64)(s32-call())` expander probe result (fn_80143258 park):**
    ngccc's own int→float fixup expansion reproduces WANT's per-site
    `xoris r3; stw lo; li r4; mr r3; stw hi; lfd; fsub; frsp` sequence
    byte-exactly at every site — but synthesizes the 8-byte 0x43300000/
    80000000 pool constant into module `.rodata` → §4n/doc-14 DOL-shift
    blocker. Confirms doc-14 applies to the CALL-result conversion case
    too, not just literal casts. Micro-tool that DID help nearby shapes:
    volatile-array slot + `register u32 v __asm__("r3")` + asm-xor pins
    the xor/store pair exactly when reconstructing by hand.

## 6r — learnings (2026-08-23, 26 EXACT-in-wip / 24 parked,
nothing promoted)

 (fn_800FC56C..fn_8010048C): worked as 8 parallel sub-agents, each
disassembling/drafting/verifying its own functions against the DOL via
`gen_leaves.compile_fn` before anything touched src/wip. All 50 drafts now
live in `src/wip/` (EXACT ones with correct `range=` markers + flags so a
future `promote_wip.py <addrs>` pass is mechanical). Two parking docs
updated/closed and two new root causes catalogued:

89. **fn_800FDD50 SOLVED — doc-06 M5.0f "partial-derived register" class is
    CLOSED.** The M5.0m retry hint works; the full recipe that flipped it:
    `register char *base __asm__("r9")` pins the RELOAD HOME, a `volatile`
    read forces want's second `lwz r9,8(r3)` to exist at all, the §6l-76
    asm-output wedge CREATES the derived pointer
    (`__asm__("" : "=r"(mid) : "r"(base + 0x10));` → lone
    `addi r11,r9,0x10`), and all four pair copies use sequential
    displacements off `base`/`mid` — re-derived expressions coalesce back
    to one base register and lose.
90. **fn_800FFAB8 EXACT — doc-06 exhaustion-scan "lookalike" was harvestable
    after all.** Conditional-vtable-call + pair math shape: `volatile
    __ps_t sp8[2]` temps + ONE named alias pointer used in ARRAY form for
    lane 0 (`sp8[0] = ...`) but POINTER form for lane 1 AND the call arg
    (`pv[1] = ...; f(..., pv)`) reproduces want's mixed
    displacement-vs-addi store forms. Pair math is plain
    `__builtin_ps_mul`. Lesson: an exhaustion-scan bucket label ("not a
    dot product") is not proof of unmatchable — only of *that* family.
91. **`tools/ps_diff.py` opcode tables were SHIFTED one low from xo5=24 up**
    (`ps_sel`@22…`ps_nmadd`@30; op59 had bogus fsqrts@22 and swapped
    30/31 names). Correct Gekko map: sel=23 res=24 mul=25 rsqrte=26 msub=28
    madd=29 nmsub=30 nmadd=31 (op59 mirrors: fsels/fres/fmuls/frsqrtes/
    fmsubs/fmadds/fnmsubs/fnmadds); verified against cc1.exe
    `__builtin_ps_*` encodings (`__builtin_ps_mul` emits xo5=25). Fixed in
    the tool 2026-08-23 — earlier docs that name-decoded raw opcode-4 words
    pre-fix may carry shifted LABELS (the words were always right).
92. **NEW PARK: empty-doloop self-targeting `bdnz .` window**
    (`docs/parkings/30-empty-doloop-bdnz-window.md`, fn_800FE094). Want:
    `li r0,4; mtctr; <3 setup insns>; bdnz .` — displacement 0. Every C or
    inline-asm spin compiles forward-displaced because cc1 sinks the first
    psq pair + call-arg setups INTO the loop window then re-points bdnz;
    asm labels get separated by the same scheduler. All ProDG versions +
    schedule flags exhausted; rest of body byte-exact. Sibling detector:
    grep wants for `mtctr` within 4 insns of a displacement-0 `bdnz`.
93. **NEW PARK: AltiVec/VMX is a hard wall** (`docs/parkings/29-altivec-
    vmx-unemittable.md`, 8 fns: 800FDE38/FE204/FE42C/FE8D8/FF030/
    FF478/FFE78/8010048C). ngccc has NO VMX backend and no builtin route
    (unlike PS/SNAPS); binutils can't even assemble the mnemonics. Don't
    draft these beyond structural sketches — blocker is upstream of source
    shape. Discriminator vs PS words when diffing opcode-4 space: VMX V-form
    uses bits 6-10 as VD with VRc/V5 fields PS A/X-forms never set.
94. **Sentinel-walk vcall family (fn_800FCCD8/FCDC4/FCE48/FCE98 + twins)
    wants the comma-expression loop head**: `for (; (v = *(s32 *)((char *)p
    + 4), cur = p, v == -1 && (cur = NULL), cur != NULL); )` — the shared
    tail check must live IN the loop condition so the sentinel `-1 → NULL`
    fold lands where want has it; plain `while` bodies put the reload in
    the wrong block and flip regalloc. Pair with recipe 74's register pins
    for the chained-load temps; fn_800FCDC4 additionally needs
    `// FLAG: -fno-schedule-insns` (recipe 48 reconfirmed on this family).
95. **Negated-compare form for float range checks (fn_800FE3B4).** Writing
    the final test as `if (!(a > b)) goto ok;` yields want's bare `ble`;
    any direct `<=` form makes ngccc emit NaN-strict `cror`+`bsolr`, and
    early-return forms hoist constants into `blelr`. Same lesson as §4s
    polarity but on the NaN-semantics axis. Also: staged named temps before
    symbol stores place call-arg loads between lis/addi exactly (recipe 57
    reconfirmed, fn_800FFDC8); param reassignment routes later loads
    through the derived register (recipe 88 reconfirmed, fn_800FFE40).

## 6s — learnings (2026-08-23, script-command zone
0x80152E10–0x80154330: 33/37 EXACT via 6 parallel sub-agents; 4 parked)

Baseline was 4 EXACT / 1 NEAR / 32 DIFF. Most wins came from the existing trio
(hidden arg0 passthrough ×9 fns, real callee protos, void↔s32 return flips,
lbl-symbol folded loads) applied to `Script*` wrappers — check those FIRST on
any remaining Script* draft. New findings below.

1. **Two-web pointer prologue via `"+r"` barrier AFTER init.** Initialize the
    pointer var (`spv = &sp;`), THEN `__asm__("" : "+r"(spv));`, then copy to a
    second var (`sp = spv;`): GCC gives web A a scratch birth (`addi r9,r1,N`
    used by the early stores) and homes it into the second var's callee-saved
    reg (`mr r30,r9`) for the post-call uses — reproducing want's
    scratch-birth + home-copy prologue exactly. Extends §6j-2 (pin an existing
    var) and §6l-76 ("=r" wedge creates a pointer): the NEW part is
    init→barrier→copy making TWO webs joined by one copy. (fn_80153AE4 EXACT)
2. **Per-call-site pointer expressions pick `mr` vs fresh `addi`.** When the
    same out-param struct feeds two calls, pass the NAMED local at one site
    (emits `mr r4,r30`) and inline `&sp8` at the other (fresh `addi r4,r1,N`)
    — choose per site what want shows instead of fighting regalloc.
    (fn_80153AE4; same lever on 80153D54.)
3. **Unconditional early global load lands in a dead param register.**
    `nm = lbl_80305F9C;` placed BEFORE any branch keeps it live across both
    paths and GCC routes it through the still-dead arg0 home r3 — no extra
    save slot. Placed after/in branches it gets its own callee-saved reg and
    shifts the whole stmw span. Same lever: load both globals into named temps
    BEFORE the first call when want shows them in the saved pair.
    (fn_80153EF4, fn_801541F8 EXACT)
4. **subfic/adde `(x == 0)` fold works MID-FUNCTION after calls too** — not
    leaf-only (§6n-7): `var_r30 = temp_r3 == 0;` where temp_r3 is a call
    result folds to subfic/adde with the result homed in r30. The `!= 0`
    polarity of the same value stays branchy regardless of staging or schedule
    flags. Only `== 0`. (fn_801541F8 EXACT)
5. **goto-into-do-while hybrid = rotated list-walk with in-loop NULL
    materialization.** When want walks a list bottom-test style AND
    materializes an explicit `li rX,0` inside the loop (sentinel → p=NULL),
    plain `while` folds/rotates it away and m2c's check-first goto mislays the
    blocks. Shape:
    `goto check; do { body; check:; if (*(s32 *)((char *)p + 4) == -1) p = NULL; } while (p != NULL);`
    emits entry-jump + bottom test + the "dead-looking" store verbatim.
    (fn_80153BB0 EXACT)
6. **Reserve a dead saved-reg slot with a file-scope register var.** When
    want's stmw span includes a register that is DEAD in your reconstruction
    (`stmw r26..r31` but only 26/27/28/30/31 live), declare
    `register s32 r29_guard __asm__("r29");` at file scope — GCC saves/restores
    r29 and generates no body code, matching the span exactly.
    (fn_80153D54; parked on other grounds.)
7. **Write each switch arm with the FULL downstream call sequence; GCC's
    crossjumping then builds want's shared tail for you** (with per-arm
    constant-prop differences preserved). m2c hoists the shared calls out of
    the arms — re-inline them per arm. Pair with a void-return flip on the
    mid-chain callee (M8.31). (fn_80153678 EXACT, 380B)
8. **NEGATIVE: ngccc never crossjump-merges `bl` instructions.** Retail
    merged two duplicate call sites into ONE shared bl+tail with path-specific
    arg staging (fn_80153844); every single-call source breaks the saved-reg
    homes, every two-call source duplicates the bl (+size) — proved with a
    minimal synthetic test. New park doc:
    `docs/parkings/31-intra-fn-bl-crossjump.md`.
9. **PARTIAL route into doc 28's long-range CR liveness (cr4 dead-flag
    gate).** `cond_raw = 0; __asm__("" : "+r"(cond_raw)); cond = cond_raw;`
    before the checks reproduces mfcr/mtcrf + ONE `cmpwi cr4,r0,0` + two
    distant `bne cr4` (verified!) — but the asm-opaque value must survive the
    intervening calls in a callee-saved reg, stealing one and cascading
    frame/regalloc (~46 insns). Parked at 73.3%: fn_8015307C. Doc 28 updated;
    DOL-wide this idiom occurs exactly once, so low priority.

## 6t — learnings (2026-08-23, script-command zone
0x8015080C–0x80152D84: 21/30 EXACT via 6 parallel sub-agents; 9 parked)

Baseline was 0 EXACT / 2 NEAR / 28 DIFF. The usual trio (hidden arg0
passthrough (≈9 fns this batch), real callee protos, `(s32)lbl_*` symbol forms,
chained calls) cracked most drafts — see §6s first. NEW findings:

1. **m2c models trailing STACK call args (args 9/10, i.e. beyond r10) as
   phantom dead locals.** Three hits in one batch: `fn_800F2628` (NodeArrayManLoad)
   and `fn_8013157C` (SpawnScript + SpawnSkaterScript) are genuinely **10-arg**
   callees; m2c rendered args 9/10 as unused `spN` locals with dead stores.
   Signature: a stack local that is written once and "never read" right around
   a big call. Fix: widen the callee proto to 10 args and pass them explicitly
   (`..., (sp24 == 0) ? 0 : 1, 0)`). Check the CALLEE disasm for `stw r3/r4,
   8(r1)`-style stack-arg stores before trusting any ≤9-arg proto.
   (fn_80151320/fn_801527D8/fn_80152A4C EXACT.)
2. **Memory-backed condition = doc-28 CR machinery WITHOUT saved-CR cost.**
   Doc 28's retry hint ("helper stores flags early, branches load them late")
   is now PROVEN: ScriptCleanup (fn_801517BC, 620B, EXACT) reproduces want's
   `cmpwi cr4` + mfcr/rlwimi/srwi/clrlwi dance by keeping the flag in a
   **1-bit big-endian bitfield struct field** instead of a live CR:
```c
struct unkflags { u32 bit:1; u32 val:31; };   /* flag at arg1+0xCC */
var = ((struct unkflags *)((char *)arg1 + 0xCC))->bit;
((struct unkflags *)((char *)arg1 + 0xCC))->bit = 0;
/* ... calls ... */
((struct unkflags *)((char *)arg1 + 0xCC))->bit = var;
```
   Memory survives the calls (no callee-saved reg needed); the bitfield
   extract/insert emits exactly the srwi/clrlwi + rlwimi + cr-test idiom.
   Extends recipe 110 from single rlwimi inserts to full save/clear/restore
   across calls. Before parking any doc-28 member, look for what the original
   could have stored in MEMORY at the tested address.
3. **Dead-arg protos force arg-register materialization without crclr.**
   Recipe 60 keeps a dead constant alive by leaving the call UNprototyped
   (accepting crclr). The inverse also works: fn_8016A6E4/fn_8011984C are
   genuinely 0-arg but Cleanup declares them `void f(s32)` so ngccc still
   loads the caller's value into r3 before the bl — prototyped (no crclr) AND
   dead-arg loaded (fn_801517BC EXACT).
4. **Named constant assigned to its OWN local lands in a callee-saved reg
   live across a call** (generalizes §6c-28's zero-hoist to nonzero): 
   `var_r30 = 1;` as a named local before a call makes GCC park the 1 in r30
   for the shared post-call store, reproducing want's wider stmw span;
   scratch-reg forms re-materialize (fn_80151A64 EXACT).
5. **Named mask temp blocks GCC's `(x >> n) & 1` canonicalization**: staging
   the shift into its own variable emits literal `slw`+`and.` where inline
   form folds to `rlwinm` (fn_80151A64 case-2 arm).
6. **Case-tree median shaping via redundant case merge.** Adding a
   semantically-redundant `case N:` label merged with `default:` shifts GCC's
   balanced-binary compare tree root to want's index (verified split formula
   against gcc 2.95.3 `stmt.c balance_case_nodes`: split index =
   `(n + ranges + 1) / 2`). Extends items 84/97 (fn_80151A64 EXACT).
7. **NEGATIVE (park confirmations):** fn_80152510 @96.9% joins the doc-15
   lis/stw arg-setup coin-flip family (11 flags + 6 shapes resist);
   fn_80152C00/fn_80152CD0 @96% park on the loop-head walker-copy-vs-load
   order (preheader scheduling, ~12 shapes resist); fn_80151228 parks on
   want recomputing `addi r3,r1,8` per site vs GCC CSE-merging it (proved
   with minimal repro across all 5 ProDG versions); fn_80150B94 parks on
   GCSE merging the two compare constants (~95% structural).

## 6u — learnings (2026-08-23, hash/name-table zone
0x80132458–0x801371D4: 39/50 EXACT via 10 parallel sub-agents; 11 parked)

Baseline was 0 EXACT / 2 NEAR / 46 DIFF / 2 FAIL. The usual trio (real callee
protos, chained/passthrough call args, lbl-symbol folded loads, store-order
rotation) cracked most drafts — check §6s/§6t first. NEW findings:

1. **ngccc CAN crossjump-merge duplicate `bl` sites — doc 31 amended.**
   fn_801340FC: two error paths calling fn_801323D4 with DIFFERENT constant
   args (`addi r4,r28,-0x10D0` vs `addi r4,r27,-0x10B0`) but identical
   `bl; li r3,0; blr` tails were merged into ONE shared `bl` by plain
   goto-C. An explicit `goto exit0;` label between the second call site and
   the shared exit breaks the merge when want keeps both sites (distinct
   block boundary; fall-through/shared-tail shapes are what trigger it).
   §6s-8's synthetic if/else evidently produced per-path tails too different
   to merge — the "never merges" claim is now scoped. Flip side gives doc 31
   members a NEW retry hint: write BOTH per-path call sites with identical
   post-call tails and let crossjumping perform the retail merge itself
   (per-path arg staging survives because it precedes the merge point).
2. **Page-anchor register vars reproduce @ha/@l splits WITHOUT symbols.**
   When want hoists one `lis rX, page@ha` and reaches several addresses via
   `addi rY,rX,-disp` but symbols.txt has no label at any target:
   `register char *m1 __asm__("r28"); m1 = (char *)0x802A0000;` then pass
   `(s32)(m1 - 0x10D0)` at call sites — GCC keeps the anchor live in r28
   exactly like the game. (fn_801340FC EXACT.)
3. **Inline-asm @ha loop anchor.** For a symbol read EVERY loop iteration
   where want hoists a single `lis r29,lbl@ha` outside the loop (GCC refuses:
   it rematerializes or folds per iteration), emit it literally:
   `__asm__ volatile("lis %0,%1@ha" : "=r"(anchor) : "s"(lbl_X));` before the
   loop, `__asm__ volatile("lwz %0,%1@l(%2)" : "=r"(v) : "s"(lbl_X),
   "r"(anchor));` inside. Emits the exact lis/lwz@l pair and forces want's
   frame/stmw span. (fn_801345DC EXACT.)
4. **Adjacent-label pair viewed as a pointer array.** When want reads two
   NEIGHBORING .data pointers through one @ha anchor (first folded as
   `lwz @l(rX)`, second via `addi rY,rX,off`), declare
   `void **vp = (void **)&lbl_FIRST;` and access `vp[0]/vp[1]` — reproduces
   the mixed folded/addi forms without inventing an array symbol (extends
   recipe 59 to synthesized arrays). (fn_801358F0/fn_801359DC EXACT.)
5. **Empty switch cases steer the dispatch tree.** Adding semantically-empty
   `case 0..2:`/`case 13:` labels partitions the case range so GCC's balanced
   compare tree grows want's boundary-check leaf form; combine with §6t-6
   median shaping. Also: order case bodies to match emission, and assign the
   size variable BEFORE a nested `if` inside a plain else.
   (fn_80134E1C EXACT, 852B.)
6. **Raw per-site symbol derefs pick their own rematerialization.** Writing
   `*(s32 *)(lbl_X + off)` inline at EACH use site (no named base local) lets
   GCC choose per-region address remat exactly where the game did; ONE named
   base pointer pins a single home and shifts everything after it. Choose
   per region what want shows (raw derefs here, scoped named pointers there).
   (fn_80136510, fn_80136708 EXACT.)
   6b. **MECHANISM + the sharp tell (fn_801A4540, 440B, 6.3% → EXACT):** the
   named local does not merely "pin a home", it WINS the hard-register
   allocation. All five callee-saved regs are already taken by long-lived
   locals, so the extra local is the one that gets a callee-saved colour and
   the reload pass then re-materialises the *rematerialisable* symbol address
   in a VOLATILE reg — the exact inverse of retail. Spelled out as a repeated
   expression, the loaded value is a plain CSE pseudo, not a local var, loses
   the hard-reg competition to the address constant, and is re-loaded per use:
Caching the global in a local for four uses scores 6.3% with the label address in r9, the value moved from r4 into saved r27 and reloaded through r9 into r30, while spelling the dereference at each of the four sites scores 100% with the page high half 0x8030 held in saved r27 and the word at offset 0xfe98 loaded into r3 at all four sites.
   Tell: **one** `lis`/`addis` of a global sitting in a callee-saved reg +
   repeated `lwz` reloads of that same global ⇒ the source spelled the deref
   at each site; DELETE the caching local. Mirror image (address re-made in a
   volatile reg, value held across calls) ⇒ the caching local is correct.
   Identical instruction count and callee-saved set either way, so this is a
   pure alloc-order tell. Hand-check note: those `lis` immediates and `lwz`
   displacements are ADDR16_HA (1) + ADDR16_LO (N) relocs on one symbol and
   are scorer-masked — count them and confirm the REL24 targets by hand.
7. **Float→int bit-casts come out of plain C.** `(u32)fval` casts emit the
   game's full `stw` of the 0x43300000 stack pair + `cror/bso` NaN-guard
   conversion idiom — no union/manual dance needed for the SHAPE.
   CAVEAT at promote: synthesized pool constants land in module `.rodata`
   (§4n routing blocker) unless referenced through the game's own rodata2
   doubles manually (§6j-1). Verified instruction-level on fn_801354B4.

## 6v — learnings (2026-08-23, script-command zone
0x80155E44–0x80158848; 27 EXACT-in-wip (25 new) / 10 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline was 2 EXACT / 1 NEAR / 34 DIFF; cracked via 7 parallel sub-agents.
Most fixes were existing recipes applied (hidden arg0 §6e-32 on nearly every
draft, callee arity/return-type audits M8.31, chained r3 recipe 23). New
findings below.

117. **Dead-store survival via escaping array siblings.** When WANT keeps a
     store that looks dead (`stw r28, 8(r1)` never read), declare ALL sibling
     out-params as ONE stack array (`s32 sp8[4]`) and pass `&sp8[2]`/`&sp8[3]`
     into callees: because those addresses escape, the `sp8[0] = ...` store is
     alias-observable and survives DCE — no volatile or asm barrier needed.
     Scalar decls let GCC prove the store dead and drop it. (fn_801567D8 EXACT.)
118. **Fresh-zero register via init ordering.** Assign `x = 0` BEFORE the
     loop-counter init when WANT materializes a second zero register: GCC
     reuses the counter's known-zero for later zero stores unless a prior
     independent zero def forces a fresh `li r0`. Controls which register
     holds 0 AND where the stw lands — distinct lever from recipe 28 (hoist
     position) and recipe 64 (u64 split). Two agents converged on it.
     (fn_80158210/fn_80158318 EXACT.)
119. **blr-stub callees still consume call-site args.** fn_801AEBA0 /
     fn_8003AB40 are 4-byte `blr` bodies with ZERO prologue evidence, yet
     their call sites set r3/r4 and WANT keeps those writes: prototype them
     with the arity the CALL SITE shows. The doc-10 audit ("check callee
     prologue reads") returns nothing for stubs — fall through to call-site
     evidence instead of assuming `(void)`; correct 2-arg protos then emit
     want's exact mr/addi arg schedule unprompted. (fn_80155FC4/80155E44.)
120. **m2c scalar decl can hide a big stack buffer — check what callees
     write.** sp8 declared bare `s32` by m2c was really `s32 sp8[26]` /
     `s32 sp8[64]`: disassemble each callee receiving `&sp8` and take the
     HIGHEST offset it stores as the array bound. Fixes frame size, restores
     DCE'd tail stores, kills bogus statics. Detection half of §6j-4.
     (fn_80156CB0 NEAR 84.1%, fn_801575E0 NEAR 98.9%.)
121. **Twin call sites get OPPOSITE arg-move orders (doc-15 evidence).**
     fn_801575E0 has two structurally identical SetProp triples where WANT
     emits mr-first at one site and li-first at the other; ngccc emits the
     inverse at BOTH, and per-site register pins, UID-shift barriers, 40 decl
     permutations and void↔s32 flips all resist. Confirms expand_call
     emission-order artifacts are per-site compiler state, not source-
     reachable. New doc-15 members: fn_80156220 (93.8%), fn_801587C8 (93.8%),
     fn_801575E0 (98.9%).
122. **Switch ret-blocks cluster at function end (extends items 84/97).** For
     hash switches with paired-single bodies, GCC moves ALL case return-blocks
     to the function end and refuses WANT's shared leaf-compare factoring;
     case-source-order permutations cap ~66%. Parked pending a shape that
     keeps one compare shared. Needs `-mps-float`. (fn_80155FF8.)
123. **Stage address-taken args into named locals before the call.** When
     WANT holds `(s32)fn_ptr` and `&sp8` in SAVED regs across a bl while got
     rematerializes, assign both to named locals BEFORE the call statement —
     they claim saved-reg homes (r30/r28) exactly like WANT (recipe 57
     staging applied to address-taken/fn-ptr args). (fn_80155EE0 EXACT.)

## 6w — learnings (2026-08-23, 30 EXACT-in-wip / 4 parked, nothing promoted)

 (Script* QB-command wrappers, fn_8015B25C..fn_8015C450): baseline
0 EXACT / 4 NEAR / 30 DIFF → 30 EXACT / 4 NEAR parks (69-96%). The whole
batch is one family; ~10 fell verbatim to the template once the first was
hand-cracked. Worked 1 direct + parallel sub-agents.

97. **Script-command wrapper harvest: hidden script-context arg0 on EVERY
    `Script*` wrapper calling fn_80128xxx.** m2c drops it and passes the
    hash/idx literal FIRST instead; WANT shows r3 untouched at the bl.
    Signature truth: `s32 ScriptFoo(s32 arg0)` + `fn_80128xxx(arg0, hash,
    &sp8, flag)` (callees are 4-arg; verify each prologue). Canonical
    template = promoted `src/fn_8015B3AC.c` (ScriptVibrationOff) — copy
    it, swap callee/constants. This one template + recipe 98 cracked ~30
    functions in one session; re-run against any remaining Script*
    drafts calling fn_801282xx/C80/CB0/E34 with literal-first args.
98. **Global→field chain needs a TYPED pointer + REGISTER-VAR pin, and the
    pin register follows WANT per function.** lbl_80305EAC holds a struct
    ptr; WANT `lis r9,-0x7fd0; lwz r11,0x5eac(r9); lwz r3,off(r11)` is
    reproduced ONLY by
    `typedef struct { char _0[off]; s32 lvl; } G_t;`
    `register G_t *g __asm__("r11"); g = (G_t *)lbl_80305EAC;`
    Without the pin GCC folds to `lwz r3,0(r9); addi r3,r3,off` or swaps
    base/ptr roles (doc-15 coin-flip). Pin reg varies: most want r11, but
    ScriptJustGotFlag/ScriptCareerStartLevel want the PTR pinned r9 /
    base r11 inverted — read WANT's lis/lwz regs before choosing. A "+r"
    asm wedge alone does NOT fix the role swap (verified).
99. **Named local loaded BEFORE a call forces a callee-saved home**
    (extends §6j-6): loading the struct field into a named local above the
    next fn_80128xxx call gives it r30 + stmw prologue exactly like WANT
    (SetCurrentChapter/CareerReset); CareerReset additionally needed
    `sp8 = 0` written AFTER the lvl load to land its stw in WANT's slot.
100. **Per-arm duplicated loads + shared-bl tail** (ScriptGetFlag): when
    WANT reloads an out-param in EACH if/else arm then shares one bl,
    write the identical call in both arms (crossjump merges the bl) and
    pin the reloaded arg to its home reg (`a1 = sp8;
    __asm__("" : "+r"(a1));` → r4) so the per-arm lwz stay immovable.
101. **Rotated walk-loop comma-condition**: `(cond && (walker = 0)),
    walker` as the while-condition reproduces WANT's
    `[cmpwi;bne; li rN,0; cmpwi;bne]` test block for null-head init loops
    (ScriptInitializeSkaters), together with `register walker
    __asm__("r9")`/head-pin r11 and a `" +r"` barrier forcing the
    `lwz id/head; mr r9,r11` init pair.
102. **Unnamed temps in guard tests keep loads in scratch regs**:
    assigning the tested value to a NAMED var inside the test gave GCC a
    dead-arg-register reuse (f1 landed in r4); keeping the three guard
    tests on unnamed temps and assigning var_r3 only AFTER the tests kept
    the load in scratch r3 with copy-prop into the branchy
    `or. rX,r3,r3; li r3,0(shadow); beq` idiom (ScriptProfileEquals).
103. **Proto tension — two call sites of the SAME callee wanting OPPOSITE
    return types** (new doc-15 twist, fn_8015BCB4 @96%): declaring
    fn_80127684 `void` fixes site A's `[mr r3,r30|ori r4]` order but
    breaks site B (`lbz/lwz` swap); `s32` is right at B, wrong at A.
    Full param-type × ret-type matrix (~40 combos), staging, pins, 9 flag
    configs, all five ProDG versions — no single declaration satisfies
    both. When a return-type flip (M8.31) helps one site and hurts
    another, don't loop forever: it may be unresolvable standalone.
    Note the byte-twin fn_8015BB78 IS EXACT with the same callee (its
    args are fresh loads, different web shape) — compare twins before
    parking on "same callee, must be same proto".
104. **Stack-slot sizing tells**: when WANT has an unexplained stack gap
    (sp8 .. +0x40 with no locals declared), the out-param is likely an
    ARRAY buffer — `s32 sp8[14]` fixed SetPlayerFacePoints' frame layout
    immediately. Similarly a dead `stmw r31` slot can be forced with a
    file-scope guard variable when the body never uses r31.

## 6w — learnings (2026-08-23, script-command zone
0x8015C594–0x8015E868: 24 EXACT-in-wip / 1 parked / 16 unworked moved to
, nothing promoted)

Baseline was 41 DIFF / 1 NEAR. Worked as parallel sub-agents; the usual trio
(hidden arg0 §6e-32 — ~10 fns this batch, real callee protos with audited
arity+return type, folded `extern s32 lbl_80305EAC` global chases) cracked
most drafts. New findings:

105. **test_wip_drafts IGNORES `// FLAG:` lines — flag-dependent drafts
     sweep as false NEAR/DIFF.** *(RETRACTED 2026-09-28 — see the
     "Correction 2" in §6bg: `test_wip_drafts.py` **does** parse and apply
     the draft's own `// FLAG:` / `// extra_cflags:` lines, at
     `test_wip_drafts.py:224-248`, and auto-adds `-mps-float` for `__ps_t`
     bodies. A bare `--addr` run therefore already scores with the draft's
     flags. What still bites is the *other* direction: if you rewrite a
     header and drop `// family=`, the draft falls to family `?` and is
     scored with NO flags at all, producing a plausible but false verdict.
     Keep the `family=` marker line intact. For a genuine flagless control,
     use `score_body.py` with an explicit empty flag list.)*
     The original observation, retained for history: fn_8015C5F0 sweeps
     91.3% plain but is 100% with its header flags (`-fno-schedule-insns2
     -fno-schedule-insns -fno-sched-spec`, verified via
     `tools/flagdiff.py 0xADDR <flags>`). Before parking any NEAR that
     carries a FLAG line, re-verify WITH the flags (`--extra-cflags` on
     the sweep, or flagdiff); conversely promote_wip re-verifies with the
     header flags, so a flagless sweep verdict can understate what will
     promote.
106. **§6u-3 asm-anchor refinement: the `"s"` constraint needs an ARRAY
     decl.** `__asm__ volatile("lis %0,%1@ha" : "=r"(a) : "s"(lbl_X))`
     fails to compile when lbl_X is declared `extern s32;` — GCC 2.95's
     "s" operand only accepts it as `extern char lbl_X[];`. Plain C loads
     off the anchor stay schedulable (unlike full asm lwz), so prefer
     anchor + C loads over §6u-3's all-asm form when scheduling allows.
107. **Comma-increment staging keeps the post-increment addi before the
     bl.** When WANT emits `addi rIdx,+1` BEFORE a call that consumes the
     OLD index value, pass `(idx = i, i += 1, idx)` as the call arg — a
     separate `i++` statement or `i` directly lets GCC sink the increment
     after the bl (fn_8015C5F0). Same family as recipe 91's comma args,
     but for loop-index liveness ordering.
108. **Independent-load wedging between two calls via comma chains.** To
     place an unrelated load BETWEEN call A and call B exactly where WANT
     has it (which decides both values' callee-saved homes), fold it into
     B's argument comma-expression:
     `B(A(...), x, (ffeval = *(f32 volatile *)&lbl_Y, sp8));` — staging
     recipe 57 generalized from pre-statement to inter-call placement
     (fn_8015C5F0: gives skater=r29 / ffeval=r30 homes).
109. **Reconfirmations worth remembering for script zones:** s32→void
     proto flip fixes r3-vs-hash setup order at later call sites
     (fn_8015DCCC, inverse of M8.31); struct-member array access forces
     want's `lwzx r4,r9,r3` operand order (fn_8015D804, §4f ai-shape);
     inverted-polarity single-exit if/else guards kill block reordering;
     named f30/f31 temps kept live across call #1 pin FPR roles.
     Parked: fn_8015D174 @96.5% joins the doc-15 li/ori arg-setup
     coin-flip family (recipe 51).

## 6x — learnings (2026-08-23, 0x8013B3DC–0x8014036C zone: 23 EXACT-in-wip / 19 parked, nothing promoted)

New reusable findings this round (each verified on a real draft):

84. **Locals stack-slot allocation follows ORDER OF FIRST APPEARANCE in the body.**
    Leading `__asm__("" :: "m"(spN))` pins steal the LOW slots; UNREACHABLE
    trailing pins reserve no frame space at all. To force want's slot for a
    local, move its first appearance (or an `"m"` pin) earlier/later in the
    source; to widen the locals region without code, a trailing zPad asm pin
    after the last use works (fn_8013E0F8/fn_8013E184 EXACT via this).
85. **OOB `&spN + N` arithmetic keeps address webs opaque → base-register
    homing.** Out-of-bounds pointer math on a scalar stack decl forces ngccc
    to keep a base register with addi (like WANT) while real arrays/structs
    fold to displacement loads. Use when WANT shows `addi rX,r1,N` staging
    instead of `stw rY,N(r1)` (group-I discovery).
86. **Scratch-dest `or. rD,rS,rS` = explicit same-value `|` + pin, NOT a
    plain test (fn_8013DEE0 EXACT 2026-10-13, unparking the old note).
    Probe-verified on stock ngccc 3.9.3: plain `if (x)` / `if (x|y)` /
    `if (x!=0)` ALWAYS emit in-place `or. rX,rX,rX` (or `cmpwi` for the
    `!=0` form on some webs) — never a scratch dest. A scratch dest
    (`or. r0,r5,r5`) needs a REAL `|` RTX of two same-valued but distinct
    webs: `register s32 v __asm__("r5"); v = arg; ...; len = v | arg;
    if (len) use(len)` — the pin blocks CSE from merging the webs, the
    allocator coalesces both to r5, the new `len` pseudo takes r0, and
    combine records the test onto the copy (value reused later via
    `mr r5,r0`). Without the pin the same source folds to in-place form.
    Corollary: when WANT shows `or. rD,rS,rS` with D≠S, write the redundant
    `v|arg` (or `arg|arg` via a pinned alias), not a cleverer test.
87. **Checksum fold idiom:** `u16 lo = raw; raw >>= 16; raw += lo;` (in-place
    shift + compound add) emits clrlwi/srwi/add/clrlwi exactly; separate
    hi/lo temps emit srwi-before-clrlwi in the wrong order (fn_8013B538 EXACT;
    fn_8013B5C4 parked @96.4% on the mirror-image order).
88. **Inline-asm label materialization into a named reg:**
    `__asm__("lis %0,@ha(lbl)\n\taddi %0,%0,@l(lbl)" : "=r"(r))` places
    phase-label addresses into a SPECIFIC register matching want's
    scratch+target shape when extern-symbol refs pick the wrong reg
    (fn_8013C548, improved to NEAR 75.5%).
89. **Dead-code asymmetry park root cause:** retail sometimes KEEPS a
    provably-redundant branch-arm `li`/compare that stock GCC eliminates at
    every -O level (fn_8013B8FC residual). If the diff is want-EXTRA dead
    insns (not missing ones), no source form helps — park it (now part of
    docs/parkings/33).
90. **Arity ground truth discovered this round** (use before prototyping
    callees in this zone): fn_8013DA08 takes EIGHT args with fn_8013E034's
    return chained into arg1 (`or. r4,r3,r3`, no mr); fn_80137EE4/FEC are
    2-arg `(entry, 3)` helpers with entry passing through r3; fn_8013CC84 is
    3-arg `(obj, val-from-field@0x48, ctx)`; fn_8013E870 takes ≥2 args,
    arg0 = alloc-style call result (`fn_8013E870(fn_80009A44(0x493C), arg3)`);
    fn_80140164 returns s32 feeding fn_80125954 chains; fn_8013E034 is
    `(arg0, &head)` passthrough.
91. **Outcome:** baseline 46 DIFF / 2 NEAR / 2 FAIL → 23 EXACT +
    19 parked (5 NEAR-tier ≥75%, 14 DIFF w/ documented reasons) + 8 unworked
    deferred. The big DIFF cluster shares one root cause — see the
    new docs/parkings/33-inlined-iterator-volatile-webs.md BEFORE retrying
    any of BC8C/BD50/B76C/BB68/BF38/C6F0/C950/CC84/DC7C/E364.

124. **Scratch-web register pins are a THIRD pin class (generalizes 98/111).**
     Recipe 98 pinned callee-saved homes; §6p-111 pinned call slots; repeated
     node-walk / vtable-dispatch webs that live entirely in SCRATCH registers

125. **Pins leak into downstream call args (caveat for 98/111/124).** A
     hard-reg pin is global to the function, not scoped to its web: GCC will
     COPY the pinned register into later call argument slots instead of
     emitting fresh `li` when it holds a proven constant (fn_80173D30,

     at site A can silently break site B.
126. **ngccc never emits entry `clrlwi` for u8/u16-typed params.** WANT shows
     `clrlwi rX,r5,0x18` at function entry ⇒ declare the param `s32` and apply

     `u8` promotes silently and can never match (fn_80177610). This is the
     ngccc-side mirror of recipe 34's MWCC clrlwi note (80023278).

     arg reg inherits the caller's chain — EVERY call site must be

     wrong at ~4 sites per caller in this zone.

## 6z — learnings (2026-08-23, 0xA1DC81F9 chain-family zone
0x80183C7C–0x80185A88: 13 EXACT-in-wip / 2 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline was 15 DIFF / 0 NEAR → 13 EXACT via 5 parallel sub-agents. The §6a
chain-family template did most of the work (hidden passthroughs, chained
returns, full protos, s16 lha vtable offsets). NEW findings:

128. **Out-param zero-init as a COMMA-EXPRESSION CALL ARGUMENT places the
     spill store mid-arg-setup (extends recipe 107).** When WANT stores
     `stw rX,N(r1)` BETWEEN the arg-setup instructions of a call, write the
     zero-init inside the argument list: `fn(hash, &sp8, (sp8 = 0, 0))` —
     ngccc evaluates the assignment exactly where the argument slot sits.
     Separate `sp8 = 0;` statements + every schedule flag capped at 87.8%;
     the comma form hits 100% with default flags. TWO independent wins this
     batch (fn_80184F88: lands between lis/ori of the hash constant;
     fn_80185A88: both out-param sites). Try before any scheduling flag.
129. **Frame-tail padding: padded STRUCT MEMBER, not ARRAY.** A trailing
     +16B frame gap is reproduced by wrapping the slot as
     `struct { s32 v; char _p[12]; }` and accessing `.v`; declaring the
     same bytes as an ARRAY shifts tail-call arg scheduling instead
     (fn_80184A2C). Refines recipes 86/93: member access keeps the web
     scalar-shaped for the scheduler.
130. **GCC 2.95 ICEs (`function.c:2102`) on `"m"(array)` asm operands.**
     Use a subscripted lvalue (`__asm__("" : : "m"(sp[0]));`) when pinning/
     ordering stack buffers — the bare-array form kills cc1 outright.
131. **volatile double dummies PARTICIPATE in the local sort.** Adding
     `_dummy` (recipe 63) can STEAL the slot of a small local declared
     after a large buffer: slot order follows size-desc among
     same-alignment objects (fn_80184A2C: dummy took the 0x48 slot from a
     4-byte local behind a 64-byte buffer). Re-check slot assignment after
     every dummy addition.

Also: homing division results by REUSING the loop variables for the

fresh temps drifted (fn_80184A2C) — m2c's `var_r31`/`var_r30_2` split
naming is the tell that the original reused one variable per loop role.

## 70 — learnings (2026-08-23, memory-card Script* zone
0x80164D58–0x80168780: 23 EXACT-in-wip / 5 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline was 26 DIFF / 2 NEAR; worked as 8 parallel sub-agents. The usual trio
(hidden arg0 §6e-32, real callee protos w/ audited arity+return type, chained
calls, `(s32)lbl_X` folded loads) cracked most drafts. New findings:

124. **Phantom empty case steers hash-switch compare trees at zero byte cost.**
     ngccc balances the case tree at pivot ≈ `floor((n-1)/2)` of the
     value-sorted nodes. When want's root sits one higher than any flat n-case
     switch can produce, add a semantically-redundant `case K: break;`
     (empty body) with K > max real case (e.g. 0xE0000000/0xF0000000): it
     participates in balancing (n=7 shifts the split) but its leaf compare is
     folded away because the body equals falling out — zero extra insns,
     tree matches byte-for-byte. CAVEAT: set-dependent — some value sets emit
     compares for the phantom case anyway (fn_80167408); verify by re-diff.
     Cracked fn_80165660/66C7C/66F7C/67094/671A0 + both switches of 65E58.
125. **Case-arm SOURCE ORDER = block placement order** (extends items 84/97):
     reorder outer switch arms to match want's physical block layout to flip
     tree orientation (fn_80168298 finding, applied in 66F7C vs 672B8 twins —
     which arm is listed FIRST gets its body inlined after the tree). Also:
     GCC does NOT merge adjacent single cases (`case 1: case 2:` builds two
     nodes) — write the explicit `case 1 ... 3:` range when want shows a
     single low-bound test (each range counts as ONE balance node).
126. **`switch (globalvar)` keeps the index copy in r0**
     (`lis @ha; lwz r0,@l(r9)` feeding cmpwi chains) while `t = global;
     if..` chains keep it in a scratch reg via pointer load — read which form
     want shows before writing if-chains (fn_80167094's three-compare block is
     really a switch on lbl_802FFE50). Related: flat switches whose arms share
     one target reproduce range-collapsed compare trees exactly
     (`case 4:` first + `{1,2,3,5}` → shared block); nested/ternary forms don't.
127. **Assignment-expression call args chain AND persist**: `fn(t = f(), 0)`
     emits want's exact `bl; mr r29,r3; li r4,0; bl` — the named temp claims
     its saved-reg home while the anonymous value stays in r3 as arg0. Plain
     two-statement form inserts a spurious `mr r3,r29`. Extends recipe 23 /
     §4t to chains that must ALSO claim a callee-saved home.
128. **Raw-r3 passthrough via old-style no-arg proto**: when want calls a
     chained helper leaving the CALLER'S OWN entry r3 untouched at the bl and
     the path is call-free up to it, declare `s32 fn_X();` (unspecified args)
     and call `fn_X()` — every prototyped form emits `mr r3,rX` first; the
     old-style proto emits a bare bl (extends §6o-99 dead-arg trick;
     fn_80165E58). Distinct from recipe 60: there the DEAD arg is materialized,
     here the live arg must NOT be copied.
129. **Paired 8-byte script out-params are u64 locals, not scalar pairs.**
     Declaring them `u64` and extracting halves via `(s32)(x >> 32)` / `(s32)x`
     makes GCC allocate register pairs, reproducing want's batched pair loads
     into scratch (r11/r12), the "dead" half loads, and cross-call
     pointer-form reloads — scalar/array decls shrink the frame or miss the
     staging entirely (m2c's `*(s32 *)((char *)&spX + 4)` rendering masks it;
     fn_80165838: 127 diffs → 4).
130. **Register-pin discipline refinements:** (a) NEVER pin a local assigned
     from a call that you also pass onward — GCC passed *card* as unrelated
     call args (semantic corruption); pin a COPY of a param instead
     (`register s32 a0 __asm__("r29"); a0 = arg0;`). (b) Call-result pins
     stick where alias-copy pins dissolve (pure copies get copy-propagated
     away unless barrier'd). (c) Full-web pinning beats partial pins: blocking
     only one register ROTATES the remaining assignment order instead of
     shifting it down one — pin all values explicitly. (d) Reassigning the
     SAME pinned variable to its next role models want's register recycling
     (out-param base becomes loop walker base); separate-variable pins reserve
     both regs and block recycling (fn_80165838/66B94/67818).
131. **Volatile stack slot = per-iteration reload idiom**: `void * volatile
     sp8;` forces want's reload of a QB list pointer from its stack slot at
     guard+head+tail every iteration (plain C merges via alias analysis); also
     steers the guard reload into r9. Companion shape: rotated-loop guard that
     compares the BEST-register, not the index — `best = 0;
     __asm__("" : "+r"(best)); ... if ((u32)best < count)` + pin best→r30;
     without the barrier GCC folds to `cmpwi r0,0` (fn_80167E04).
132. **Scattered stack scalars may be ONE SDK struct** (extends recipe 120 to
     SDK callees): fn_80167818's u8@sp36/s32@sp38/u16@sp3C... fields are
     CARDStat members (&stat → CARDGetStatus/CARDSetStatus, sizeof 0x6C tiles
     the frame exactly). Check what SDK callees write, not just game callees;
     recover buffer sizes from frame holes (fn_80168298: sp8[104]/sp70[24]/
     sp88[24]/spA0[104]/sp108[104] tile the 0x198 frame).
133. **m2c QB-hash literals can be WRONG, and capstone prints lis immediates
     signed.** Two hashes in fn_80165E58 were misdecoded by m2c (draft said
     0xB00FF357/0xFE88614D; want is 0xB010F357/0xFE82614D). Always hand-decode
     want's lis/ori pairs as UNSIGNED hex before trusting draft literals or
     qb_constants.h names (§6o-102 hazard in reverse: you can "fix" a correct
     macro into a shadow-trap hash).
134. **16-byte block copies are struct assignments**: element-wise `a[i]=b[i]`
     emits interleaved load/store pairs; only `*(S4 *)dst = *(S4 *)src`
     reproduces want's fingerprint — all loads grouped BEFORE stores, element
     0 displaced through sp, elements 1–3 through a derived scratch register
     that then homes into the saved pointer (two-web `mr r27,r11` shape).
135. **NEGATIVE results:** goto-dispatch trees DO crack some switch shapes
     byte-for-byte (fn_80167818 10%→40%+) but FAIL others: goto edges carry
     const info so jump-copyprop specializes shared arms and reuses known-zero
     regs — retail switch edges are opaque (fn_80165E58; prefer recipe 124).
     Store-run rotate-right permutation applies only to CLEAN runs of
     independent stores; runs interleaved with call-arg setup emit in source
     order (refines §6k-64). Register vars are live-from-entry — they cannot
     model born-late webs (park reason below).

## 71 — learnings (2026-08-23, ScriptGoalManager zone
0x80188A84–0x80189684: 10 EXACT / 0 PARKED, nothing promoted)

Small batch, all template wins; headline result is in §6a-6 + doc-15: the
r29/r30 saved-reg swap coin-flip class is CRACKABLE via pin-a-copy
(`register s32 a0 __asm__("r29"); a0 = arg0;`) — cleared fn_80188FEC (an
old "unfixable straggler") and fn_80188F98 verbatim. Refinements beyond §70:

136. **Recipe 128 extends past entry-r3 to MID-CHAIN sites.** When r3 at a
     `bl` holds a PREVIOUS call's return that survived its own `cmpwi/bne`
     test (e.g. fn_801286D0's result tested then passed on), old-style
     `s32 fn_X();` + bare call still emits zero setup — recipes 23 (chain)
     and 128 (bare old-style) compose: `fn_801854C4(fn_80188190(), sp8)`.
137. **Passthrough-vs-chain depends on call history** (refines §6a-3): an
     untouched-r3 `bl` AFTER another call means r3 is that call's RETURN
     (`fn_80188190(fn_80128228(arg0, 0, &sp8, 1))`); only an untouched-r3
     bl with NO preceding call is the wrapper's own arg0 passthrough.
138. **Two-sided if/else polarity mapping** (extends §6a-4): want
     `beq→else-block, then inline` ⇒ write the NATURAL
     `if (cond != 0) {A} else {B}`; pre-flipping (`== 0 {B} else {A}`) makes
     GCC re-invert to `bne`. In the chain family the un-swapped source is
     always right; only single-arm early returns need §6a-4's inversion.
139. **Slot-refresh pointer for single-reload loops** (extends §6y-131
     without volatile): reading an `&spN`-written out-param directly in BOTH
     copy and loop condition emits two lwz reloads/iteration; instead use a
     named local `p = sp88;` in the body, then explicitly reassign
     `p = sp88;` after the increment BEFORE the condition — exactly-once
     bottom reload, no volatile needed (fn_80189114).
140. **Offset-first add extends to PLAIN address adds** (§6k-66 beyond
     lwzx/stwx): `(char *)(i + (s32)p)` flips operand order of
     `add r9,r10,r8` → `add r9,r8,r10` when only the ADD's operand slots
     differ (fn_80189114 loop condition).
141. **Statement-level evaluation-order staging** (generalizes recipe 57 to
     cross-statement ordering): when GOT hoists a LATER argument's loads
     above earlier nested calls, split the nested call into a named-temp
     assignment statement — GCC then evaluates args in statement order;
     also fixed an r27/r30 saved-reg role swap as a side effect
     (fn_80189214).
142. Reconfirmations: M8.31 return-type flips apply even when the callee's
     result is discarded (s32→void reordered mr/ori at a call site,
     fn_80188BBC); zone truth — after fn_80125954(...), fn_801280E0's r3 is
     ALWAYS the chained return, never the wrapper's arg0.

## 6y — learnings (2026-08-23, script-command zone
0x8015CBC0–0x8016158C: 47 EXACT-in-wip / 13 parked, nothing promoted)

123. **Value-returning signed compare = plain `<` expression; GCC emits the
     CR LT-bit extraction for you** (fn_8016158C). WANT's tail
     `cmpw cr7,rX,rY; mfcr r3; rlwinm r3,r3,0x1d,0x1f,0x1f` is exactly what

     hand-roll branchy li/cmp/bne forms or subfic/adde folds for a boolean
     that WANT materializes from a signed relational compare. Reverse tell:
     any want ending in mfcr+rlwinm …,0x1f,0x1f is `(a < b)` as a value.
124. **Out-param stack arrays (`s32 sp8[4]` + `&sp8[0]` at call sites) fix
     frame slot gaps AND force per-site reloads** — used in ~7 EXACTs this
     batch (8015CBF0/CD00/FF58/60620/60874/61044 sp8[32]/611C4). Extends
     §6v-117 (escaping siblings keep dead stores alive): sizing the array to
     what callees actually store also corrects the frame and keeps every
     &-taken slot out of saved regs.

     Tested directly on fn_80151228 (park): `s32 sp8[4]` +
     `&sp8[0]` ×5 still merges the address into one callee-saved web (frame

     it; it needs an anti-CSE mechanism GCC 2.95 doesn't have for plain

126. **NEW park root cause — LICM hoists single-use loop constants into
     saved regs where retail rematerializes lis/ori(-in-r0) per site**
     (fn_8015D4E4 ~26%). Distinct from doc-33 (that is iterator/volatile
     webs; this is plain constants inside a loop body): nested-if dispatch,

127. **Capstone/disasm lis-immediate sign trap when reconstructing hash

129. **If/else-arm accumulator beats the ternary when a LOAD sits at function

     choosing between plain `(f32)(f64)(s32)` casts and the §6j-1 manual

## 72 — learnings (2026-08-23, ScriptGoalManager zone
0x80189740–0x8018AC00: 24 EXACT / 0 PARKED, nothing promoted)

The zone template (0-arg fn_80188190 bare call + full protos + chained
returns + natural-polarity if/else) cracked nearly everything verbatim.
New levers discovered:

143. **Guard-value-in-arg-reg = live third argument.** If want loads a
     TESTED value into an ARG register (r5, not r0/r9 scratch), the guarded
     callee consumes it as arg2 — check its prologue (`mr r28,r5`). Every
     dead-value form (named local, "+r"/"+b" barriers, hard-reg pins)
     emits `lwz r0` instead and caps ~90%. Zone truth: fn_801277E4 is
     3-arg `(fieldPtr, hash, value)` (fn_8018A498).
144. **Escaping-array locals for out-param slots** (`s32 sp8[16]`, pass
     `&sp8[N]`): with separate never-address-taken scalars GCC caches them
     in callee-saved GPRs + SAVED CR FIELDS (mfcr/mtcrf, compares hoisted
     ABOVE the call that writes them, prologue inflates to stmw r25). The
     array forces per-call reloads, exact ascending displacements and
     correct stmw span — one edit fixed ~30 diffs (fn_801899F8). Same
     lever as recipe 117 generalized to whole out-param blocks; also sizes
     frames from callee max-arg constants (`li r7,0x200` → char sp8[0x200]
     declared FIRST, fn_8018A0A4).
145. **Pin-to-r3 arg-carrier forces edge-duplicated call setup** at
     bottom-tested loop calls: want duplicates `mr r3,r31` on BOTH edges
     with a pure `{bl; or.; bne}` test block — no plain C shape reaches
     it (goto/while/for/do-while share setup at the merge point, flags
     don't move it). Pin a register var to the arg register itself and
     feed the call through it:
     `register s32 t3 __asm__("r3"); register s32 v4 __asm__("r4");
      t3 = team; v4 = 0; goto test; body: ... t3 = team;
      test: temp = fn(t3, v4); if (temp != 0) goto body;`
     With args already in ABI regs at the bl, zero test-block setup is
     possible and GCC must duplicate the copy per edge (fn_8018AB7C).
     Generalizes §6p-111/§6y-124 from "choose which reg" to "force edge
     duplication".
146. **Byte-neutral value-returning rewrite flips expand_call arg-emission
     order in an EARLIER block**: a void wrapper's first-call arg order
     `[lis][addi][li r6][ori]` vs want `[lis][addi][ori][li r6]`
     resisted all schedule flags + void↔s32 CALLEE flips — but making the
     WRAPPER return a result that's already in r3 (the vcall verdict,
     `return ((s32 (*)(void *))...)(...)`) fixes block-1 scheduling with a
     byte-identical epilogue (fn_80189E64).
147. **r3-pinned staging register kills the arg-copy-vs-store coin-flip**:
     `register s32 darg __asm__("r3"); darg = temp_r30;` before a store run
     feeding a call emits want's lone `mr r3,r30` exactly there AND reuses
     it at the bl free (fn_8018A548). Try on any doc-15 "mr one slot late"
     single-diff NEAR.
148. **Full inverted-polarity if/else needed when a VALUE arm contains a
     call** (extends §4s): want `[cmpwi r5,-1; li r3,0-shadow; beq EP]`
     comes ONLY from `if (t == -1) { var_r3 = 0; } else { body; var_r3 =
     1; }` — natural-polarity pre-init emits li-before-cmpwi; ternary /
     early-return / goto / assign-in-condition all lose the branch shadow
     (duplicate else-block at bottom); all schedule flags resist
     (fn_8018A1F4).
149. **Inverted-inner-test early return reproduces shadow-hoisted li**: a
     second guard written `if (field != 0) { return 1; }` creates want's
     distinct cond2-false→epilogue edge with pre-set return value; plain
     nested ifs merge both false edges into one shared block (fn_8018A548).
150. Reconfirmations: twin-site order tension solved by ONE void flip on
     the shared callee satisfying both sites (fn_80180190... fn_80127568);
     per-caller proto flips — callees promoted void may be declared s32 at
     capture sites (fn_80183A64/fn_80186BF8/fn_801869EC, recipes 87/119);
     file-scope `register s32 g31 __asm__("r31");` reserves a dead stmw
     slot (§6s-6); pin the OTHER variable when pinning demotes a value to
     memory.
