## 6ab — learnings (2026-08-24, memcard script zone
0x801687D0–0x8016E0D8: 21 EXACT-in-wip / 9 NEAR-parked (78–98%) / 5
DIFF-parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 1 NEAR / 31 DIFF / 3 FAIL. Worked as 8 parallel
sub-agents. The usual trio (hidden arg0 §6e-32, real callee protos with
prologue-audited arity, chained returns recipe 23, lbl folded loads)
cracked ~2/3 of the batch. New findings:

131. **Self-targeting `bdnz` windows ARE reproducible — `bdnz $`.**
     The SN assembler's `$` operand encodes displacement 0 (`.` encodes +8;
     numeric/named labels get separated from the branch by the scheduler).
     Emit the whole window as one volatile asm block whose outputs are
     register vars pinned to want's homes; terminate with `bdnz $`.
     **Doc 30 SOLVED**: fn_800FE094 went 36–58% → EXACT. Companion rules:
     keep a REAL local array as frame anchor (asm-only pointer birth
     collapses the frame to 8B); write frame-relative stores through the
     real array (r1-relative psq_st encodings), pointer-relative ones
     through the asm-born ptrs; a call arg born inside the window needs a
     register var pinned to the ARG slot (`register void *a __asm__("r4")`
     passed to the call) so GCC elides the identity mr at the bl.
     See docs/parkings/solved/30-empty-doloop-bdnz-window.md.
132. **Repeated label-store idiom via volatile-field struct + OOB pointer
     webs.** Memcard commands store a global VALUE into a stack slot
     repeatedly (`stw rVal,0xC(r31)` where r31=`addi r31,r1,8`). Reproduce:
     `volatile struct { ...; s32 f3; } fr; s32 *wp=(s32*)&fr; wp[3]=lblv;`
     — the OOB web keeps the base-register home, the volatile field keeps
     the "dead-looking" store, and an `__asm__("" :: "r"(wp2))` escape on a
     second web forces want's read-back reload. Cracked fn_801687D0/69518.
133. **blr-stub callees still consume call-site args (recipe 119
     reconfirmed ×2).** fn_8001075C(s32)/fn_80010760(void) are blr stubs
     with zero prologue evidence; prototyping them at call-site arity kills
     crclr without changing codegen. Same session: fn_80167810 is a
     `li r3,0; blr` stub but its call site is 5-arg prototyped.
134. **Implicit memcpy KEEPS want's crclr; declared memset SUPPRESSES it.**
     Adjacent sites in fn_8016A048/A1BC: leave the memcpy call unprototyped
     when want has crclr cr1eq before it; declare memset normally when it
     doesn't. Check per site, not per library function.
135. **Mid-function entry labels can be declared as plain functions.**
     fn_8016A048 branches directly to `lbl_8025ED70/EDA0/EDA8` inside
     fn_8025ED48; declaring them `void lbl(void)` emits want's direct `bl`
     without crclr. Grep symbols.txt for entry-label labels before assuming
     a callee is the function start.
136. **Per-site arity is real for non-script callees too.** fn_80125A3C:
     2-arg `(hash, flag)` at the C4B0/A714 sites but **6-arg**
     `(hash, 1, r5-passthrough, arg7×3)` at AB1C (r5/r10 passthroughs feed
     args 3/5/6). Audit every site; m2c flattens to the minimum.
137. **A redundant dummy case shifts GCC's balanced compare-tree root**
     (extends §6t-6): fn_80168890 needed one extra empty `case 0xF5D3C2A1:`
     merged into default to move the split point from 6289→79DA. Also:
     write each switch arm with its FULL downstream call sequence and let
     crossjumping build want's shared tail while per-arm constants survive.
138. **Removing a perturbing barrier is a fix too.** fn_80169070 hit 100%
     only after DELETING an earlier `__asm__("+r")` barrier that had been
     nudging scheduling; likewise a stale `// FLAG:` line on an otherwise-
     EXACT draft (fn_8016A048) makes promote_wip re-verify under flags that
     score 97.8% and REFUSE — sweep ignores FLAG lines, so re-check any
     flagged EXACT both ways before finishing (§6w-105 corollary).
139. **Long-range CR machinery falls out of plain C when structure is
     right** (doc-28 data point): fn_801689C8 reproduces mfcr+mtcrf 0x80 AND
     callee-saved cmpwi cr2/cr3/cr4 cached ~170 insns across ~10 calls with
     no asm/flags — build the rest of the body to ground truth BEFORE
     blaming CR liveness for a park.

## 6y — learnings (2026-08-24, 0x8017EC44–0x801834C4 zone:
26 EXACT-in-wip / 15 parked, nothing promoted)

Worked as 13 parallel sub-agents over two passes. Most wins were the standard
trio (real callee protos, hidden/chained args, lbl-symbol folded loads,
register pins) applied to a script/spawn-helper zone. Genuinely NEW levers
below — all verified byte-exact unless marked as park signatures.

140. **Opaque-zero via inline-asm literal splits zero webs nothing else can.**
     When GCC's known-zero reuse MERGES two zeros want keeps in different
     registers (after recipe-118 ordering, u64 splitting, and decl permutations
     all fail), materialize one zero opaquely:
     `register s32 zb __asm__("r11"); __asm__("li %0,0" : "=r"(zb));`
     GCC cannot see through the asm output, so the other zero gets its own li
     and the count/index lands in the register want chose (fn_80182C08 EXACT;
     same lever ordered two preheader li's in fn_80182ED8). Strongest of the
     zero-split levers because it survives even -O2 const-prop of hard regs.
141. **Hard-register pin blocks the mtctr/bdnz countdown conversion where ALL
     flags fail.** `-fno-strength-reduce`, `-fno-branch-count-reg`, and the
     schedule-flag set do NOT always stop GCC turning a countdown into
     `mtctr/bdnz`; pinning the counter to a hard register
     (`register s32 n __asm__("r11");`) does (fn_80183068 fill-loop latch,
     fn_8018322C staging copy feeding both mtctr and a store). Refines
     recipe 89: try the pin FIRST when want shows addic./cmpwi+bne latches.
142. **A bare memory clobber is a zero-cost STORE sequencer.**
     `__asm__("" ::: "memory")` between two independent stores forces their
     order without code (fn_80183068: stwx before the count write-back;
     fn_80182C08: keeps `li r0,K; mtctr` after preceding word stores).
     Extends recipe 65 from loads-inside-loops to straight-line store order.
143. **Volatile-asm branch wedge escapes if-conversion.** For a BRANCHY
     reg-vs-reg boolean where ngccc if-converts EVERY C shape into
     mfcr/rlwinm (and `-fno-if-conversion`/`-fno-if-conversion2` DO NOT EXIST
     in ProDG cc1), emit want's `[cmpw][li 1][blt +8][li 0]` via a 3-insn
     volatile asm branch jumping over the C-level shared fail block
     (fn_801819E4 tail). Last resort — but it converts an impossible shape.
144. **Alias-symbol read defeats GCSE's page-anchor hoist.** Two derefs of the
     SAME symbol get CSEd into one anchor hoisted into a callee-saved reg;
     reading a NEIGHBORING address through an adjacent symbol
     (`lbl_80305EB8 + 8` next to `lbl_80305EC0`) keeps per-site remat exactly
     where want recomputes (fn_80180390: 51%→75%). Refines §6u-6: choose a
     DIFFERENT nearby symbol per site instead of fighting the hoist.
145. **Comma-expression out-param inits fix store timing in call-arg
     position:** `(sp8 = 0, 0)` / `(sp20 = -1, 0)` as the argument places the
     zero/-1 store exactly between surrounding loads/calls where separate
     statements hoist or sink it (fn_80181DA0). Variant of recipes 91/107
     applied to out-param slot initialization.
146. **Frame rounding control via frame-template tail padding.** GCC rounds
     locals+save area to 8; size the LAST struct member so the total hits
     want's frame (fn_801814F0: script-cmd struct tail pad to 0x17 → frame
     0x858). Extension of §6q-86 for frames where the shortfall has no
     corresponding stack access.
147. **Mask-first vs shift-first picks the rlwinm fusion partner.** For a
     CSE-shared extract, `(x & 8) >> 1` and `(x >> 1) & 6` fuse differently;
     probe both when want shares one rlwinm across sites (fn_8017EF1C probe
     finding). Same axis as §6x-87 checksum-fold ordering.

Park signatures catalogued this round (do NOT re-grind blind):
- **GCSE anchor INSERTION-POINT artifact** (fn_80181300, 97%): the shared
  page anchor for lbl_80305EC0 is inserted AFTER a null-check branch instead
  of before the call, swapping with another load. Survives ~12 source shapes,

- **Big-function allocator-order wall** (fn_8017EF1C 22%, fn_8017F614 25%,
  fn_801815EC 40%, fn_801826E8 50%, fn_8018223C 61%): want saves FEWER
  callee-saved registers than any C reconstruction reaches (e.g. want 9 vs
  got 11–12); short-lived temps claim saved slots; FUNCTION-WIDE register

- **doc-28 data points**: fn_801808C8 is a confirmed new member (mid-function

Baseline was 18 DIFF → 16 EXACT via 7 parallel sub-agents. NEW findings:

132. **m2c comma-call rendering trap (draft-repair pattern).** m2c renders a
     short-circuit test whose first operand is a CALL as
     `(ScriptIsHost(0, 0), 0) || X` — the comma folds to the constant and
     DELETES the call's guard effect. Correct form keeps the real condition
     after the comma: `(ScriptIsHost(0, 0), (arg1 == 0)) || (fn(...) != 0)`.
     Without this repair an entire branch arm silently vanishes from the
     compiled output (fn_80186624).
133. **doc-28 partial crack — single-invariant CR-liveness comes out of
     PLAIN C.** When ONE condition is tested pre-loop/pre-call, homed in a
     callee-saved GPR (often a param), and consumed post-call across bls,
     plain C sometimes reproduces the whole `cmpwi cr4` + mfcr/mtcrf dance
     verbatim — TWO wins this batch (fn_80186624 cr4 shared across ~10 bls;
     fn_801875CC hoisted cr4 compare). Retry doc-28 members with this shape
     in plain C before reaching for the memory-bitfield route.
134. **State-machine gotos beat loops when want's block order is
     `[chain][inc][test][head][return]`.** Raw goto webs generate no loop
     notes, so loop rotation cannot reorder them; the equivalent while-loop
     capped at ~19% on fn_80187C14. Also from that fn: GCC tail-MERGES two
     arms ending in identical if-tails (differentiate one arm's shape to
     block the merge), per-arm manager variables home r29/r30 where one
     shared var collapses onto r31, and a literal page anchor
     (`register char *page __asm__("r26"); page = (char *)0x80300000;` then
     `*(s32 *)(page + 0x5EAC)`) reproduces a single hoisted lis + folded
     displacements where extern-symbol forms rematerialize per use.
135. **Two-statement chained form beats recipe 23 when want reloads a field
     AFTER the nested call.** `ret = f(lbl); g(field, ret, arg1);` keeps the
     field load after the call; the one-expression `g(field, f(lbl), arg1)`
     form let GCC hoist the field load ABOVE it (fn_801878EC). Recipe 23 is
     for when want keeps r3 flowing INTO the next call — check which side
     of the call want's load sits on.
136. **Named base pointer + stepped index ops prevent constant folding into
     displacements.** WANT `addi -1; slwi; lwzx` folds to `lwz -4(r9)` under
     direct expressions; staging `idx <<= 2; base = (char *)arg0 + 0x60;
     *(s32 *)(base + idx)` reproduces the indexed form (fn_80187B0C).

Baseline was 39 DIFF → 21 sweep-EXACT via 12 parallel sub-agents. NEW
findings:

140. **DOC-29 CORRECTION: `vpkuhum` opcode-4 words are NOT proof of VMX.**
     ngccc 3.9.3 emits the identical word for a plain Gekko PS element copy
     (`d[k] = s[k]` on `__ps_t` under `-mps-float`) — capstone mislabels

     (fn_800FF030, fn_800FF478); genuine vmsumshm/vsel stay walled. Also:
     `.long` raw-word inline asm DOES assemble through ngcas — the VMX wall
     covers MNEMONICS only. See the corrected docs/parkings/29.
141. **Per-pair `__asm__("" ::: "memory")` clobbers force interleaved
     lwz/stw copy pairs** where GCC otherwise groups all loads then
     mtctr-converts the loop (fn_8019D62C). Partial lever vs bct
     conversion; combine with `-fno-branch-count-reg`.
142. **An f32-TYPED call argument adds an unexplained +8 frame slot**
     (want 0x38 / got 0x40 whenever a float-param callee is declared;
     `-mps-float` does not change it — fn_8019D7FC). Before assuming a
     frame mismatch means "add dummies", check whether deleting just the
     float-arg call restores the exact frame.
143. **Per-parameter proto TYPES flip call-site arg emission order** —
     declaring fn_8001B6DC `(char *, char *, s32)` instead of `void *`
     moved its site from r3-first to r3-last (`[r4][r5][r3][bl]`, want's
     order). Beyond return-type flips (M8.31): try narrowing param types
     too (fn_8019DB68, +3 insns).
144. **`li r3,0; blr` stubs still need pointer-arg protos** — callers
     materialize `&sp8` for them, so an unprototyped/0-arg declaration
     drops the addi and breaks the match (fn_800168B0); bare `blr` stubs
     (fn_800168B8) are called unprototyped-bare. Stub arity comes from
     CALL SITES, not the stub body (recipe 119 extension).
145. **Varargs proto `(s32, ...)` auto-matches per-site cr flags**: crset
     cr1eq at float-arg sites, crclr at int-only sites — matched want at
     4/4 mixed sites in fn_801A058C. Extends recipes 60/87: when a callee
     has BOTH float-arg and int-only call sites, one varargs proto may fit
     all of them.
146. **Named pointer variables computing the same address get GCSE-merged
     across loop boundaries**, producing scratch-birth + mr home-copy pairs
     the retail code lacks. Inline `&struct.member` expressions at each
     site let GCC form two separate webs and matched want exactly
     (fn_8019EB40 preheader-vs-branch case).
147. **Inverse recycling trick**: TWO separate locals coalesce onto ONE
     saved reg where a single recycled variable lands elsewhere — use when
     want reuses a register across disjoint webs (fn_801A0DA8; inverse of
     §6z-130).
148. **Assigning `i = 0` BEFORE the walker assignment flips GCC's
     constant-completion order** across the following store run
     (`[li r30][ori r27][ori r28][addi r31][ori r29]`, fn_8019E340) —
     statement order alone beat every pin tried.
149. **Strict-aliasing struct out-param `{s32,f32,f32}` blocks speculative
     FPR hoisting above escaping-pointer calls** (fn_8019E250) AND its
     manual fixuns dance references the game's REAL rodata2 doubles —
     promotable, no doc-14 pool. Prefer this shape over bare scalar
     out-params near float conversions.
150. **do-while latched on `acc != 0`** reproduces want's single
     `cmpwi cr4` + beq-exit + redundant-looking `bne cr4` back-edge +

## 7c - session learnings (2026-08-24, 0x801Exxxx zone
0x801E1224-0x801EF300: 23 EXACT incl 6 -mps-float / 22 PARKED, nothing
promoted)

Baseline was 44 DIFF / 1 FAIL -> 23 sweep-EXACT via 13 sub-agents (one
straggler fn_801EDD7C caught unassigned at wrap-up - always diff your group
lists against the batch file). NEW findings:

155. **capstone PS mislabeling is broader than vpkuhum (extends 7b-140):**
     ps_add (xo5=21) prints as `vsel`, ps_sub (xo5=20) as `vmsumshm`, AND
     psq_l DISPLACEMENTS misprint (0x408 shown as -1016). Always hand-decode
     raw words before classifying an opcode-4 stream. Also tools/ps_disasm.py
     can SKIP the first instruction when a function opens with psq_l -
     hexdump-check its output start against the raw words.
156. **GCC reverses adjacent __ps_t pair-copy statements** - the store-
     rotation recipe (9/24/64) extends to psq runs; swapping two pair-copy
     lines flipped EDB94 to EXACT.
157. **Plain-float C does NOT auto-pair under `-mps-float`** - PS ARITHMETIC
     blocks need explicit `__ps_t`/`__builtin_ps_*` ports (~50-op blocks in
     EBDD8/E3FB0); only copies/loads/stores fuse automatically. Typed
     `((__ps_t volatile *)&arr[0])[k]` reads fuse copy-backs into
     psq_l+psq_st (fn_801E1224, +7%).
158. **f32-returning callee bool extraction:** plain `ret <= field` emits
     want's `[fcmpu][cror cr0un,cr0eq,cr0lt][mfcr][clrlwi 0x1f]` verbatim;
     `!(a > b)` NEVER matches (canonicalizes to !EQ). Also gives the true
     signature: f1-compared callees are f32-RETURNING, so wrappers are often
     1-arg not (void*, f32).
159. **Switch pivot trick at zero byte cost:** u32 index cast + pre-init
     `var = 0` before the tree + NO default label + ONE phantom empty case
     shifts GCC's balanced-tree pivot to want's node (9 nodes -> root=4)
     without emitting anything (fn_801ECE7C).
160. **Frame-template struct whose TAIL member is a volatile union** pins
     exact sp slots incl holes AND blocks GCC folding the 6j-1 int-float
     dance into integer tricks (12->66% on fn_801E1A3C); when a _dummy
     steals slot 8 from a same-size local (sort is size-desc), use a padded
     union `char _p[16]` filler instead.
161. **Bool materialization [stw r0][mr r11,r0] order** comes from
     store-first comma-readback: `var_r11 = (*(p->f = expr), *(p->f))`;
     direct assignment emits li-into-home instead (fn_801EE948).
162. **Brittle-allocator park signature:** beyond ~2 hard-reg pins the whole
     allocation COLLAPSES (stmw shrinks a reg, frame -8) identically across
     all pin choices - stop pinning and document when seen (fn_801E8E04).
163. **cc1 ICE traps catalogued:** expmed.c:347 on (a) f32-lane writes into
     live __ps_t vars and (b) late nested-double-deref f32 stores
     (fn_801EDD7C); `"m"(array)` operand ICE reconfirmed (6z-130).
164. **NEW PS wall candidates for doc06:** opcode-4 xo10=332 (VC=10) words -

7c post-audit amendments (same batch, found in report cross-check):
165. **u64 out-params produce eager pair loads; consume ONE half via a
     union view.** `union { u64 d; s32 w[2]; }` and reading `.w[0]` emits
     the high word as a single `lwz` where a u64 variable would drag both
     pair loads into the caller (refines 6n-11 for callers consuming one
     half only).
166. **Rotate-right store permutation PERSISTS ACROSS COMMA SEQUENCE
     POINTS** - adjacent independent stores rotate even when separated by a
     comma operator, and memory BARRIERS DO NOT STOP IT; only true
     data-dependence does (fn_801EE948). Do not reach for clobbers against
     rotation - reorder or chain data instead.
167. **f32-field vs rodata2 CONSTANT compares keep the constant `extern
     f64`** (lfd+fcmpu); truncating the constant to f32 changes the opcode
     stream and never matches (fn_801EF220). Same family as 6o's folded-
     float lessons but on the CONSTANT side.

## 6ac — learnings (2026-08-24, Script*-wrapper zone
0x8013Fxxx + 0x80161xxx–0x80164ABC: 29 EXACT / 20 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 5 NEAR / 44 DIFF → worked as 9 parallel sub-agents plus
direct work on stragglers. The template (§6w-97: hidden script-
context arg0, real callee protos, folded `lbl_` loads) cracked most wrappers;
new findings below (scoped numbering; global numbering is contended):

- **§6ac-1 Inline-asm clobbers need the `fr` prefix too — bare digits name
  GPRs.** `"fctiwz ..."` with clobber `"13"` silently clobbers GPR r13 →
  ngccc saves r13–r31 (stmw balloons, frame +0x48) with no other symptom.
  FPR clobbers must be `"fr13"`/`"fr12"`; register VARs likewise take
  `__asm__("fr0")`, never `"f0"` (hard compile error). Extends recipe 67.
- **§6ac-2 frN register pins work on VOLATILE float regs** (`fr11`, `fr12`,
  `fr0`), not just callee-saved fr13 — pins float math want keeps in scratch
  regs across statements (fn_80163100: v→fr11, tt→fr12, dance temps→fr0).
- **§6ac-3 Shared cvt slot = frame-template struct member + inline-asm
  fctiwz.** Put ONE `union { u32 w[2]; f64 d; }` inside a frame-template
  struct at want's stack offset, then per conversion site:
  `__asm__ volatile("fctiwz 13,%0\n\tstfd 13,%1" :: "f"(prod), "m"(u) : "fr13");`
  `val = u.w[1];`. Reproduces want's slot reuse for ALL int↔float dances.
  Plain `(s32)` casts synthesize a HIDDEN double temp (+8 phantom frame
  slot) AND pool constants in module .rodata (doc-14 promote blocker); the
  hand dances referencing the REAL rodata2 double (lbl_802A8318-class,
  §6j-1 form) stay promotable. Proven across 6 dance sites in fn_80163100;
  also the fixuns route (§6p-112) reconfirmed on fn_801644F4/fn_801634A8.
- **§6ac-4 Volatile-staged rodata float pair pins swapped const-load
  order.** When two rodata-float loads emit swapped, stage BOTH consts
  through `volatile` locals — pins emission order AND lets them land
  directly in want's FPRs ("+f" barriers and all sched flags failed first)
  (ScriptRotateTexture EXACT).
- **§6ac-5 memset's crclr killer is a VOID-returning proto.**
  `extern void memset(...)` removes the spurious crclr; pointer-returning/
  implicit/old-style forms keep it. Conversely leave memcpy UNprototyped
  when WANT keeps its crclr. Per-call-site decision again (recipe 87/M8.31
  family) (fn_8016207C).
- **§6ac-6 XOR-equality ground truth (refines §6o-100).** Want's
  `[xori rX,rY,K; subfic r0,rX,0; adde rZ,r0,rX]` equals `(v == K) ? 1 : 0`
  (CA carries v==K). Write plain C `(v ^ K) == 0`; never reconstruct via
  M2C_CARRY arithmetic (verified fn_80162244/fn_80162174/fn_80162C00).
- **§6ac-7 Integer loop cursors vs pointer walkers.** Want's signed `cmpw`
  bottom-test do-whiles come from INTEGER cursors; typed-pointer walkers
  give `cmplw` + pre-test rotation (fn_80164390).
- **§6ac-8 Zero-hoist claims a saved reg and fixes the stmw span.** A named
  `var = 0;` BEFORE call #2 parks the zero in a callee-saved reg, restoring
  want's wider span and cascading neighbors into place (extends recipes
  28/99) (fn_80162174).
- **§6ac-9 Recipe-63 N-dummy caveat.** Multiple volatile-double dummies
  COALESCED past the first in fn_801644F4 (+24 frame gap unreachable), while
  fn_8014E30C needed seven successfully (§6o). Treat N-dummy widening as
  unreliable; prefer same-size frame-struct pads (§6p-105) and re-check slot
  assignment after every dummy (§6z-131).
- **§6ac-10 Per-caller return-type × FLAG interplay.** `-fno-schedule-insns2`
  + per-caller VOID proto on fn_80128228 flipped call#1 arg-setup order where
  flagless s32 needed other levers (fn_80162488; recipe 87 instance — sweep
  verdicts understate flagged drafts per §6w-105).
- **§6ac-11 Tooling: align by MNEMONIC sequence before editing.** diff_near.py
  output cascades once streams shift; diff GOT-vs-WANT mnemonic lists via
  difflib to find true insert/delete blocks first (located the fn_80161608
  brace bug and every fn_80163100 wall this way). Note disasm.py prints
  UPPERCASE hex addresses (`0x8016310C`): lowercase-only parse regexes
  silently skip every line containing A-F.
- **§6ac-12 Zone arity ground truths** (verify per-site before prototyping):
  fn_8005CA70 5-arg `(global,&out,0,1,1)`; fn_8005CF34 5-arg `(lbl,sp10,
  texA,texB,bool)` with r4 kept live from the compare; fn_80129068 3-arg;
  fn_80129420 returns f32; fn_801277E4 genuinely 3-arg; fn_8026B2B4 2-arg
  strcpy-shaped (symbol-address arg); blr-stub fn_8003EF4C prototyped 5-arg
  per call site (recipe 119). NOT all Script* wrappers return 1 —
  ScriptSetParkName returns **0**.

## 6z — learnings (2026-08-23, goal-manager/script zone
0x8018ACAC–0x8018D924: 26 EXACT-in-wip / 4 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 1 NEAR / 29 DIFF → 26 EXACT via 5 parallel sub-agents.
The §6a chain template + full callee protos cracked most of the zone;
pin-a-copy (doc-15 lever) held up on its home turf. New levers:

129. **Empty `__asm__ __volatile__("");` as a ZERO-BYTE block barrier**
     (fn_8018D120): placed before an early `return 0`, it blocks GCC's
     shadow-li/bne epilogue threading and reproduces want's
     `beq cont; li r3,0; b` block form. Unlike "m"-operand pins it reserves
     no frame slot and touches no registers — try it whenever want splits
     a return path that GOT merges into the epilogue.
130. **Same-variable REASSIGNMENT through a call chain controls which
     compare records the value** (fn_8018D120): reusing one temp for
     D7BC-ret → 88190-ret made the LAST value die at its test (`cmpwi`)
     while earlier values kept `or.` copies. Models register recycling
     without pins when pin-a-copy over-constrains (extends §70-130 /
     recipe 88 param-reassignment to multi-call webs).
131. **Inline-save chains inside call args** (fn_8018BA34):
     `fn_801286D0(t = fn_80129528(...), ...)` emits the `mr r30,r3` save
     with NO second mr, and `var = fn_80126EAC(fn_80019D08(8))` keeps the
     chained result out of scratch. Staging (recipe 57) compressed into the
     argument list — same family as recipe 91's comma args but for saves.
132. **Zone truth — `fn_80188190` is a TRUE void() global-getter**: its
     prologue overwrites r3 and never reads entry r3. Bare unprototyped-
     arity calls `fn_80188190();` reproduce want's zero arg setup verbatim,
     and every untouched-r3 `bl` after it is a leftover-return passthrough.

133. Parked this round join KNOWN families — don't grind fresh:

## 73 — learnings (2026-08-23, unnamed zone
0x80192008–0x80196564: 36 EXACT / 2 EXACT-masked-doc14 / 8 PARKED)

151. **LOCAL register-var pins can CORRUPT frame addressing (safety).**
     A local `register s32 x __asm__("r31")` combined with a `__asm__("" :
     "+r"(p))` barrier on a frame-derived pointer makes GCC compile
     `&local` to a BARE CONSTANT (`li r9,8` → stores hit an absolute
     address!). Isolated by bisection; FILE-SCOPE global register vars
     avoid it while still forcing the register home. Recipe §6s-1's
     init→"+r"→copy trick is unsafe in functions that use local hard-reg
     pins — audit any draft mixing both.
152. **Plain-cast int→float compares: ngccc's own expander IS want.**
     `(f32)(f64)x > float_sym` expands register-for-register like want's
     full `[lis 0x4330][xoris][lfd magic][stw lo/hi][lfd][fsub][frsp]
     [fcmpu]` dance — the §6j-1 manual union form can NEVER match that
     schedule (hard ceiling ~91%; comma/statements/volatile/pins/flags all
     resist). Rule: if want's dance uses standard magic values, write the
     plain cast — and accept the doc-14 promote wall (private pool lands
     in module .rodata; annotate such drafts "EXACT (masked) NOT
     PROMOTABLE"). Want-side dead copies mid-dance (`mr r8,r10`) are
     synthesized-cast fingerprints — evidence the source used plain casts.
153. **Comma-in-argument nested-call ternary keeps shadow-li placement.**
     A comma-SEQUENCE arm (`(f(x), g(x))`) blocks GCC's shadow-li (zero
     sinks to a bottom block); wrapping the void call inside the consuming
     call's argument (`g((f(x), x))`) keeps the arm one CALL rtx and
     reproduces `[cmpwi][li r3,0][bne EP][body]` (extends §6n-2).
154. **Old-style proto crclr refinement**: K&R `void f();` still emits
     `crclr cr1eq` when the CALL SITE passes arguments — only zero-arg
     bare calls avoid it. Prototyped fixed-arity is required when
     forwarding an arg (refines recipes 60/128).
155. **NEGATIVE results:** `__builtin_expect` does not exist in ProDG cc1
     (parse error — lever closed permanently); explicit goto block
     placement does NOT override ngccc reorder-blocks for {tiny-arm vs
     huge-loop} if/else; `-fno-gcse` does NOT stop speculative-LICM hoists
     of conditional-loop invariant bases (it's loop.c LICM) — kill those
     with `__asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(p))` barriers + register pins
     (bare non-volatile asm gets moved anyway).
156. **Multi-field row-reset loops need per-field named pointers +
     element-scaled index** (`p0[i*9]`, `p1[i*9]`, ...): ivopts then shares
     ONE IV across per-field invariant bases emitting want's 8×addi+stwx
     prologue; single advancing pointer gives displacement stores, inline
     `base+i*stride` gives one-base walk — both wrong (fn_80193678).
157. **Unique temp names per logical web.** Shared temp names across
     disjoint regions MERGE webs and flip r0/r11-class register roles;
     renaming each web uniquely took a draft 91%→100% (generalizes recipe
     57/§6w-102). Related: array-style `arr[i]` gives scratch-birth +
     invented homing (`slwi/lwzx/mr r21,r0`) where named temps allocate
     directly in the saved reg.
158. **`v = off; __asm__("" : "+r"(v));` before a call forces a
     live-range SPLIT COPY at exactly that position** — pins web-split
     placement without changing extents; cracked a 30-line diff slide
     (plain early assignment merges webs instead). Also: dead-reg
     known-zero reuse — GCC initializes a phase offset by copying a dead
     countdown reg instead of `li 0`; break it with a volatile "+r"
     clobber on the countdown after its loop.
159. **Store-run rotate-right refinement** (extends §70-134): same-constant
     runs rotate right-by-one while odd-valued stores HOIST ABOVE them;
     call-interleaved runs stay source order. Permute source so rotation
     reproduces want ([74z,80z,7Cz,78z | 84z,50max,28one] source →
     [84,50,28,74,80,7C,78] output). And: if-conversion trap on `&&`
     boolean returns — branchy per-path returns need explicit early
     returns; one combined expression gets if-converted into a
     materialized r9 bool. Relational-return tail sharing
     (`[bne Ltail][blelr][Ltail: li r3,0]`) comes only from the inverted
     form with the const-return at function end.
160. **Zone FP constants mapped:** the game's int→float conversion pool
     doubles sit in .rodata2 DUPLICATED PER-SITE (lbl_802AA240 ==
     lbl_802AA248 == 0x4330000080000000; lbl_802AA0F4=1000.0f,
     lbl_802AA0F8=2^31) — grep dance-bearing drafts against these before
     assuming data constants.

## 6y — learnings (2026-08-24, skater-state zone
0x80177D1C–0x8017EBFC: 24 EXACT-in-wip / 21 parked, nothing promoted)

Worked as 9 parallel sub-agents off a 45×DIFF baseline. The usual trio
(hidden arg0 §6e-32, callee-proto/arity audits M8.31, folded
`extern s32 lbl_*` loads recipe 53) cracked most drafts. NEW findings:

125. **Post-increment array store kills the false-aliasing reload.**
     `arr[count++] = x;` written as ONE expression semantically forces GCC
     to reuse the PRE-store index value for the address — fixes the spurious
     reload after `stwx` that named temps, pins and restrict cannot (want
     computes the slot once). Separate statements reintroduce the reload
     (fn_8017DD54, −40B).
126. **Explicit decl-init locals flip prologue param-save order.**
     Declaring `s32 end = arg2;` (decl-init, not assignment-later) changes
     which param copy ngccc emits first in the prologue — same lever family
     as recipe 88 but via declaration position, no reassignment needed
     (fn_8017E398 EXACT).
127. **@ha anchor sharing rule.** GCC shares one `lis` @ha anchor between a
     folded symbol load and a `&symbol` address-of ONLY when both derive
     from the SAME expression web; two separate expressions rematerialize
     (fn_8017E4C8 analysis).
128. **Frame-template structs interact with the FPR +8 quirk.** When a
     function saves an FPR, shrink the frame-template struct's tail by 8 —
     the volatile-double headroom stacks ON TOP of the declared template,
     overshooting want by exactly 8 (fn_78520 went SIZE-MISMATCH → exact;
     refines recipes 86/63/28).
129. **Register-pin quirks (extends recipes 98/111).** (a) u8-typed register
     vars are SILENTLY DROPPED — pin type must be u32/s32; (b) adding a pin
     can add +8 to the frame (same mechanism as the _dummy quirk) — budget
     for it when the want frame is tight; (c) DIAGNOSTIC: `-fno-schedule-insns
     -fno-schedule-insns2` makes ngccc match want's INSTRUCTION COUNT on big
     switch-chain handlers even when homes differ — if counts match, it is a
     pure home-assignment park; if not, structure is still wrong (fn_8017981C).
130. **Switch-tree tail duplication (extends items 84/97, §6t-6).** For a
     compare-tree switch rooted at value 2 where want duplicates a small
     tail into BOTH arm bottoms: write goto-blocks with the tail textually
     duplicated per arm (GCC crossjumps arm-0's copy); make the switch
     operand opaque via a `"+r"` asm barrier so the tail keeps its own
     `cmpwi r0,2`; emit a DEAD compare with `__asm__("cmpwi %0,1" :: "r"(v));`
     where want has one GCC would prove dead (fn_801791B8 EXACT).
131. **Memory-reload compares avoid cr3/cr4 pairing (doc-28 avoidance).**
     Adjacent equality/hash tests get CACHED into shared CR fields (mfcr/
     mtcrf machinery) even with NO calls between them; forcing each test to
     RELOAD its operand from memory between compares keeps every compare
     independent and drops the CR-save entirely — the cheapest doc-28 dodge
     yet, works mid-function (fn_8017C2CC; complements §6t-2 bitfield route).
132. **Dead-code callee arity comes from WANT'S ARG-SETUP, not the callee
     prologue (refines M4.93/doc-10 + §6w-119 beyond blr stubs).** A matched,
     non-stub callee may ignore all its args (fn_800A398C): the caller must
     still pass the args want's call site sets up (there 2-arg
     `(lbl_80301A38, *(s8 *)p)`); prototyping it 0-arg shifts everything
     (fn_8017C170 EXACT). Corollary of §6w-119: audit "what does want set
     before bl" FIRST whenever the callee's body reads nothing.
133. **Per-var `volatile "+r"` barriers force distinct saved-reg homes for
     EQUAL-valued webs.** Two webs holding the same value coalesce to one
     home; giving EACH its own `__asm__("" : "+r"(v));` after init splits
     them onto want's two registers (fn_8017C170/fn_8017B444; generalizes
     §6s-1's init→barrier→copy to same-value webs without any copy).
134. **Split-web register pin cracks big registration-table fns.**
     `register s32 lctx __asm__("r22");` forced want's SPLIT ctx web
     (`mr r22,r30` — ctx lives in TWO saved regs, r30 early/r22 late);
     without the pin GCC uses one reg and all 17 saved-reg homes shift
     (fn_8017D524 EXACT, 1768B).
135. **Indexed expression beats pointer walker at preheader-hoist
     conflicts.** When a walker pointer's init fights LICM hoisting another
     load into the preheader, rewrite the walk as `(char *)t + 0xC + i * 4`
     indexed addressing — no pointer web, no hoist conflict (fn_8017A6E4
     EXACT; companion to recipe 31/named-base rules).
136. **Per-test return-site layout: inline li+beq vs merged bottom block.**
     In multi-guard wrappers each test independently picks between an INLINE
     return (`li r3,K; beq` next to its compare) and a MERGED bottom return
     block shared by several guards — read want per test and give each guard
     its own shape instead of one uniform form (fn_80178324 EXACT).

 zone arity ground truth (audit before prototyping here):
fn_8021D2C4 (s32,s32)→s32; fn_80229918 (s32) void; fn_800A398C 2-arg

phantom literal AND phantom passthrough); fn_8021FCF8 takes a DEAD s32
(§6t-3 dead-arg proto keeps the load, kills the crclr); fn_8013157C 10-arg

§6z amendments (post-batch verification round):
134. **NEVER pass a global `--extra-cflags` across a MIXED address file** —
     test_wip_drafts.py applies the flags to EVERY draft, so drafts whose
     header `// FLAG:` lines differ get corrupted verdicts (a
     sweep with `-fno-schedule-insns` flipped 13 real EXACTs to NEAR/DIFF).
     Scope flag sweeps to single addresses or a file of same-flag drafts;
     run the plain sweep for the batch verdict, then per-draft flagged
     checks only where a header FLAG exists.
135. **Early-return literal can beat the ternary — recipe 14's inverse**
     (fn_8018AF38): want kept the tested value in a home reg and
     `if (t == 0) return 1; return fn_8019072C(t);` reproduced it while the
     ternary did not (both polarities tried). Recipe 14 says ternaries beat
     if/return for cmp+branch+li; when want HOMES the value first, the
     early-return form is the one that preserves the home. Pick by where
     want materializes its li, not by recipe preference.
136. **Two-step staging keeps BOTH the r3 load and the subfic/adde fold**
     (fn_8018D614): `var_r3 = sp8; var_r3 = arg2 == var_r3;` puts the
     loaded left operand in r3 and still folds to xor/subfic/adde — a
     one-step `arg2 == sp8` emits the compare with sp8 in place but loses
     the load placement. Refines recipe 100/§6n-7: stage the LEFT operand
     into var_r3 first, then assign the equality to the same variable.

## 6ad — learnings (2026-08-24, Create-A-Trick zone
0x8019A448–0x8019D230: 35 EXACT-in-wip / 2 parked, nothing promoted)

Worked as 8 parallel sub-agents over three passes; 35/37 byte-exact. The
whole batch is the Script-command wrapper family — the recipe-97/98 template
(src/fn_8015B3AC.c) plus perfect-twin porting did almost all the work. New
findings below.

160. **Barrier'd param copy breaks guard/count expression merging.** When one
     `(param + K)` feeds BOTH an `addic.` guard and a do-loop count, ngccc
     CSEs them into `mtctr rN`. Copy the param through a `"+r"` volatile asm
     barrier first (`t = arg1; __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(t)); n = t + 1;`)
     so the two expressions are syntactically distinct → fresh `addi` extend.
     Second lever for the mtctr problem alongside §6y-141's hard-register pin
     (fn_8019A448 EXACT).
161. **Two-exit guard form for Get-wrappers:** `if ((t = f()) != 0) { body;
     return 1; } return 0;` reproduces want's `[or.][bne cont][li r3,0
     inline]` where BOTH the m2c early-return shape and the branch-shadow-li
     shape sink the zero block to the bottom instead (fn_8019C348). A third
     boolean-layout polarity to try after §4s and §6w's forms.
162. **CAT-family setter/getter discriminator (zone table):** 0x60-byte Set*
     want early-return literals with NO bool normalize (`li r3,0` in branch
     shadow); 0x70-byte Set* want the branchy normalize + merged return block
     (no shadow li); Get* split the same way on the `beq` shadow. Field
     offsets X/Y/Z = 0x1D8/1DC/1E0, AnimsDone/RotsDone/BailDone =
     0x1CC/1D0/0x1C8, NumAnims/HoldTime via fn_80128228(arg0, 0, &sp8, 1).
     Applies to remaining ScriptCAT-style families in later batches.
163. **Get-side wrappers take a real 2nd param** (`void *arg1`, its +0x18
     field feeds the final 3-arg getter's r3) while Set-side take only arg0 —
     m2c guesses both wrong in opposite directions; read want's prologue
     saves per twin before porting.
164. **Dead-arg proto on a callee that ignores r3:** fn_8019B768 overwrites
     its incoming r3 with a hash before its real call, but call sites still
     declare it (suppresses crclr without changing codegen) — same lever as
     §6t-3, confirmed here with a hash-overwriting callee.
165. **Twin-port discipline pays at scale:** crack ONE member of each shape
     class fully, then port verbatim swapping only hash constants/offsets —
     12 of this batch's 35 EXACTs were single-iteration ports (SetNumAnims ←
     SetTotalY shape, GetAnimsDone ← GetBailDone shape, etc.).

Parks: fn_8019BD3C (79%, big CAT hash-switch dispatcher — entry-block
scheduler window + out-copy sunk past recursive bl; ~40 shapes, flags, and
the C++ frontend all resist; register-pin recipe §70-130d cracked the role
rotation), fn_8019B2A0 (51%, swap-block allocator artifacts; rest of body
byte-exact incl. full pin set).

Zone arity ground truth: fn_8019B768(void) hash-dispatcher (ignores r3);
fn_801745B4(lbl_80305EAC-chase) returns cat ptr; fn_801276E8(s32,s32,s32),
fn_80127684/fn_80127798(s32,s32,s32) void, fn_80127B28 needs PER-CALLER void
proto (M8.31 flip); Get* helpers take the loaded +0x18 field as arg0.
166. **Two register pins on the SAME hard register work when live ranges
     don't overlap.** fn_8019BD3C declares `register u32 cmdp
     __asm__("r30")` AND `register s32 temp_r30 __asm__("r30")` — cc1
     accepts both and emits want's two-step role handoff (`addi r30 / mr
     r28,r30`) where a single pinned var forces one home and shifts the
     whole allocation. Use when want RECYCLES a callee-saved reg for a
     second value mid-function (role-recycling patterns); if ranges ever
     overlap the compiler errors, which is a useful liveness probe too.

## 6z — learnings (2026-08-24, entity/iterator zone
0x801A867C–0x801ACF84: 30 EXACT incl. 2 -mps-float / 12 PARKED, nothing promoted)

Worked as 8 parallel sub-agents off a 1-NEAR/36-DIFF/5-FAIL baseline. The
§6e-32 hidden-arg0 + proto-audit + folded-lbl trio again cracked most small
fns; this zone is dominated by list-walk iterators around `fn_801A9C1C`
(bucket walk + 2-arg callback). NEW findings:

137. **Do NOT hand-declare an induction variable GCC's ivopts would create.**
     When want shows a fresh counter register initialized AFTER the guard
     branch (`li r8,0` post-test), that IV was created by ivopts from a plain
     `entries[i]` loop — declaring any manual offset/index var forces the init
     BEFORE the branch and can never match (fn_801AC4E4 EXACT once the manual
     IV was deleted). Symptom of the mistake: want has one MORE register than
     your loop needs and its li sits on the wrong side of the guard.
138. **Escaped struct ctx local = the DCE-proof out-param template.** Where a
     wrapper passes a stack context to a callee (`&sp8`) and m2c models the
     slots as separate scalars, the stores get proven dead; declare ONE local
     struct, take its address once (`&ctx` escapes → every store survives),
     and pass it through (fn_801A95C0/9670/96B8 EXACT trio). Sibling of
     recipe 117 (escaping array siblings) generalized to structs.
139. **Opaque-value asm-output wedges emit specific "dead" instructions.**
     Extends §6y-130's dead-compare trick beyond compares:
     `__asm__("li %0,0" : "=r"(p));` reproduces want's redundant exit zero
     that GCC would fold away (fn_801A8848); same pattern emits dead
     `cmpwi`s. The operand must be an "=r" OUTPUT so GCC treats the reg as
     written and keeps the insn.
140. **Named base assigned INSIDE the loop keeps two induction variables.**
     Hoisting `base = arr + i*4` out of the loop merges the count IV and the
     address stride into one web; assigning it inside the loop body emits
     want's separate `+1 cmp` / `+4 addr` IVs plus the per-iter
     `addi r31,r25,4` (fn_801A99B0 EXACT).
141. **Split the result store from the address compute to keep the pointer
     web post-bl.** Fused `q[idx] = fn();` folds addi+stbx into the call's
     shadow; `ret = fn(); q = base + 8; q[idx] = ret;` keeps the addi AFTER
     the bl like want. Give each RMW web a UNIQUE name (p vs p2) to control
     which scratch reg takes the index color (fn_801A96FC EXACT).
142. **Pointer slot-refresh splits reload webs:** assign the stack slot to a
     named pointer BEFORE a loop (`p = sp40;`) and REASSIGN at the latch —
     three reload webs stay split exactly as want instead of CSE-ing to one
     base (fn_801A97C4).
143. **Volatile write+readback pair forces want's reload sequence around
     counts.** `*(volatile u32*)&fr.f1C = count; n1 = *(volatile u32*)&fr.f1C;`
     emits the lwz+slwi reload pair want uses after in-loop count stores;
     without the readback GCC forwards the register value and drops the load
     (fn_801A8E5C park note; generalizes recipe 80 to struct fields).
144. **Recognize &arg1 param-home spills:** want storing an OUT-PARAM address
     into the PARAMETER'S home slot (not a fresh local) is normal spill
     behavior — model it by passing `&arg1` directly, not via a temp
     (fn_801A9494 EXACT).
145. **Staging permutations beat pins for rodata-float groups.** In float-
     heavy blocks, permuting WHICH staged named temp each lfs/stfs reads
     (search all assignments) cracked what register pins could not — pins
     perturb the whole allocation while staging only reorders existing webs
     (fn_801A9FD8 float block; zone-wide observation).

Zone arity ground truth (audit before prototyping here): fn_801A9C1C is
genuinely 3-arg `(ctx_base+8, callback, ctx)` with a TWO-arg callback;
fn_800E9D30 is 2-arg `(ptr, flag)`; fn_801AAC84/fn_801A0DA8/fn_801A0D50 read
r3 (m2c passed label literals); fn_800D6490(obj, ctx) 2-arg; fn_80060490
consumes a NINTH stack arg; fn_801AAE94 genuinely 4-arg void (phantom 5th);
fn_801A8520 (s32,s32)→s32; fn_8012705C/fn_80126F88 return s32 (protos kill
crclrs); fn_800121D8 returns s32 chaining into fn_801A9A70; alloc chains:
`fn_801A9A70(fn_800121D8(0))`, `fn_801A80B0(fn_800098F4(0x1C), arg)`,
`fn_8009F678(fn_800098F4(0x118))`.

## 6af — learnings (2026-08-24, goal-manager/skater-state
zone 0x801965D4–0x8019A3A4: 35 EXACT incl. 1 flag-dependent / 2 NEAR-parked /
3 DIFF-parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 1 NEAR / 39 DIFF. Worked as 7 parallel sub-agents. The
standard trio again cracked ~85%. NEW techniques:

167. **Outgoing-stack-args OVERLAY struct (args 9/10 double as locals).**
     For calls with trailing STACK args (beyond r10): declare the caller's
     locals region as ONE struct whose first members ARE the stack-arg
     slots, and pass those members as the trailing call args. This puts
     args at r1+8/r1+0xC AND pins the struct base at exactly r1+8, so every
     sibling slot lands at want's offset (cracked fn_8013157C sites in
     fn_80196EF8: sp290@0x290/s210@0x210/sp2C4@0x2C4 all matched at once).
     Refines §6t-1 from "pass explicit zeros" to "overlay args onto the
     frame you need anyway".
168. **Frame-sizing OVERLAY ARRAYS: make &spN out-params elements of one
     array.** `s32 sp8[N]` sized to want's frame; elements [k]/[k+1] ARE
     the &sp18/&sp1C-style out-params passed to callees. One declaration
     sizes the frame and keeps every out-param as plain `&arr[i]`
     (fn_80197B5C sp8[8], fn_80197CF0 sp8[6], fn_801968A8 sp8[4]).
     Generalizes §6w-104 from a detection tell to a construction tool;
     stronger than individual scalar decls (GCC re-sorts those).
169. **Rotated-ring loops entered MID-RING reproduce via goto-into-for.**
     When want shows `[n-test][walk][sentinel][p-test]` entered by a jump
     into the sentinel check:
     `goto check; for(;;){ if(--n==-1) goto found; walk; check:; if(sentinel) p=0; if(p!=0) continue; break; } p=0; found: t=…;`
     Companions that were ALL required (fn_80198C20): pre-decrement
     `--n == -1` (post-dec emits a spurious `mr r0,rN`, §6p-104);
     early-return-FIRST tail inversion so the body call stays inline after
     the beq; and TWO opacity barriers — `__asm__("" : "+r"(p))` after
     loop-1 stops GCC folding loop-1's proven-zero register into a later
     return (kills want's `mr r3,rN`), and one before the post-loop
     dead-looking `p = 0` keeps that exit store alive.
170. **Unsymboled data address = NEARBY symbol minus delta.** When want
     materializes an address that has NO symbols.txt label, reference a
     nearby labeled global minus the constant:
     `(lbl_80305EAC - 0x5A78)` folds to the exact @ha/@l of 0x80300434
     (fn_80196EF8). Extends recipes 12/22/45: never fabricate symbols,
     never use bare literals — compute the delta instead.
171. **Guarded do-while is the INVERSE trap of §4m-7.** When want has an
     ENTRY test + preheader + bottom-test-back-to-loop-head, a plain
     `while` rotates the guard away entirely; restore it with the explicit
     guard form `if (i < count) { do { … } while (…); }` (fn_80198190).
172. **Semantically-dead self-init stores survive via volatile.**
     `node->flink = node; node->blink = node;` look dead but want keeps
     both; casting the lvalue `(volatile s32 *)` blocks DSE (fn_80198190).
173. **Zero-byte `__asm__ __volatile__("");` as the FIRST statement of an
     if-block stops GCC merging the preheader into the guard block**;
     follow with `"+r"` barriers to pin temp order below the guard
     (fn_80198190, 33%→100%).
174. **Comma-RHS staging orders a load against a store**: `(next =
     *(arg0 + 0x10), arg0)` as a call arg emits want's list-next load
     BEFORE the preceding store C without a named temp (fn_80198190).

## 74 — learnings (2026-08-23, unnamed zone
0x801A5CF0–0x801A8354: 24 EXACT / 3 PARKED, nothing promoted)

161. **Register-pin discipline matrix (extends §73-151):**
     (a) FILE-SCOPE register pins get NO save/restore in ngccc — they
     reserve dead stmw slots but CANNOT model live param homes; use LOCAL
     pins for those, but only when no `"+r"` asm barriers are mixed in
     (local pin + barrier corrupts frame addressing). (b) r0
     register-vars are TOXIC — corrupt the whole frame allocation even in
     isolation. (c) Pins block post-death register REUSE: a pinned web's
     hard reg is never recycled for later webs, so any pin fixing one home
     forbids want's reuse of that reg elsewhere (root cause of a park).
     (d) DEAD-PIN TRAP: pins never referenced in the body are silently
     ignored — make every pin load-bearing.
162. **Shared-web recycling via ONE pinned var reassigned per role**
     composes cleanly with chained calls and opaque-zero anchors even in
     ~40-site wrapper bodies: `a0`(r30) carried 4 webs, `a1`(r29) 3 in
     fn_801A6070 with just 3 total pins. When WANT recycles a register
     across roles (ptr→counter), the pinned var must serve BOTH roles —
     separate webs can't get it (pins block inter-web reuse, 161c).
163. **Opaque-zero inline asm**: `__asm__("li %0,0" : "=r"(z));` then
     `sp8=z; spC=z;` reproduces a single zero-anchor register across
     escaped out-param stores while literal `0` call args stay fresh li's;
     later literal `x = 0;` correctly emits its own fresh li. UNPINNED
     inline-asm outputs add an +8 frame spill — always use the pinned
     form. Doubles as DSE-proof nullify stores / anti-coalescing counter
     init (§6y-140 family).
164. **Late-born pointers**: assigning pointer locals AFTER the early
     stores they must not serve still gets their addi scheduler-hoisted
     into the prologue while killing copy-prop into those stores — both
     effects at once (fn_801A8204). Related: zero-byte
     `__asm__ volatile("")` fences freeze independent address-addis into
     their between-call slots; CALL-STMT-FIRST reorder cracks prologue
     windows (li early, bl delayed past sets); C-assigned scratch temps on
     arg-register pins (`register s32 t9 __asm__("r9"); t9 = expr;`) force
     temp regs while staying schedulable.
165. **Counted-search shared-tail rule**: when want returns ONE failure
     constant from a single bottom block shared by guard-exit AND
     loop-exit, never early-return the failure arm — wrap the whole loop
     in the positive guard (`if (i < cnt) { do {...} while (i < n); }
     return -1;`) so both exits fuse; early return makes GCC invert to a
     forward beq into a duplicated out-of-line block (fn_801A7F8C,
     refines §4m-7). The barrier-free `__asm__ volatile("mr %0,%1" :
     "=r"(n) : "r"(cnt))` copy pin survives loop restructuring unchanged.
166. **Tiny-leaf base-copy pin**: want's `mr rN,r3` base copy before
     displacement stores is unreachable by any plain C shape (GCC folds
     base onto r3) — create it emission-free with a scratch-web pin
     (`register s32 p __asm__("r9"); p = arg0;`) + reverse-store-order
     source (fn_801A6788).
167. **Two-register web-split tell**: one m2c variable homed in TWO
     different want registers (e.g. lvlptr r31 vs r29) = two original
     variables — splitting the variable fixed the permutation free.
     Related diagnostic: guarded-do reveal — if the guard compare emits
     BEFORE loop-invariant setup loads, the original was
     `if (k < cnt) { setup; do {...} while }`.
168. Reconfirmations: whole-frame escaping structs give deterministic
     memory residency for ALL out-params (extends recipes 86/144);
     store-scheduling is context-dependent (head-pair reversed while
     arg0-pair natural in one fn); assignment-chained self-stores do NOT
     lock emission order under ngccc.

## 6ae — learnings (2026-08-24, script-engine zone
0x801A2584–0x801A5A9C: 19 EXACT / 6 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 2 NEAR / 23 DIFF → 5 parallel sub-agents + direct work on
one straggler. The usual trio (hidden arg0, real protos, lbl folds) did most
of it; scoped numbering, new findings:

- **§6ae-1 u64 compares: polarity flips this target's DImode template.**
  `<` canonicalizes to `ge` and the pattern emits (op1, op0), putting the
  zero-promoted side first — so `<` vs `<=` is not a no-op on 64-bit
  compares. Build the u64 via union `{ u64 d; u32 w[2]; }` with statement
  order `w[1] = field; call; w[0] = 0;` to control hi/lo store scheduling.
  Declare the returning callee `u64 fn(...);` (r3:r4 pair) — m2c renders
  these as garbled `(ret >= 0U) && (...)` chains (fn_801A3294 EXACT).
- **§6ae-2 Pre-call `"+r"` barrier flips ARG-MOVE order at one call site**
  without touching codegen elsewhere: `__asm__("" : "+r"(temp));` placed
  immediately before the call forces want's arg1-before-arg0 move order when
  param-type flips and all flags failed (fn_801A4C68's last 2 diffs).
  Distinct application of the doc-15 emission-point barrier (that one orders
  an li against a test; this orders two arg moves).
- **§6ae-3 Loop-carried `i++` must be the LAST body statement** of a
  bottom-tested while: mid-body placement lets sched sink the addi into the
  latch; last-statement placement pins it right after the GetNext-style bl
  like want (fn_801A29F0). Complement of §6w-107's comma staging.
- **§6ae-4 Two-return staged-exit tail**: when want ends
  `[cmpwi; li r3,0; beq]`, the only C form that emits li-AFTER-test is a
  staged exit per path (`var_r3 = X; ... return var_r3;`) — ternary,
  init-if and shared-single-return forms all emit li-first
  (fn_801A297C EXACT).
- **§6ae-5 `<=` vs `>` guard polarity decides which side of a two-way guard
  ngccc keeps inline** — flip so ret-0 is fall-through and the call block
  sits at the branch target (refines §4m-10) (fn_801A5240 EXACT).
- **§6ae-6 Distinct VARS per alloc-block call**: sharing one temp across
  several `fn_80126EAC(fn_80019D08(N))` allocs breaks regalloc even when
  names differ per site — m2c's `_2`/`_3` suffix vars were RIGHT
  (80.7% → 92.8%, then a void-return flip finished it) (fn_801A4FF0).
- **§6ae-7 Web creation order assigns homes under pins.** When several webs
  are pinned/homed, which physical reg each gets follows ORDER OF FIRST
  APPEARANCE/USE — create the arg1 web before arg0's to match want's roles
  (fn_801A362C; generalizes recipe 81 from FPR consts to GPR webs).
- **§6ae-8 Empty-then / goto-ok guard layouts.** `if (a >= 0 && a < n) {}
  else { body }` reproduces bounded-guard layout with the else inline; and
  `if (cond) goto ok; return 0; ok:` puts test #2's branch TO the body
  (fn_801A53C0/fn_801A54DC EXACT). Same family as §6b/§6y block-layout
  levers.
- **§6ae-9 NEGATIVE: frN pins do NOT hold for CALL RESULTS.** A `bl` lands
  its float result in f1; pinning the receiving variable (`register f32 x
  __asm__("fr31")`) did not stop GCC homing two hash-conversion results to
  the swapped regs in every shape tried (fn_801A3E4C). Caveat to §6ac-2 /
  §6w-109: pins are reliable for computed values, not bl results.
- **§6ae-10 Hash-switch methodology (21-case switch EXACT, fn_801A4D1C):**
  (a) hand-decode EVERY lis/ori pair first and beware SIGNED lis halves
  (m2c misread `0x9016B4E7` via the sign trap); (b) verify GCC's balanced-
  tree pivots against your value set BEFORE writing C (n=21 roots at the
  median hash — want's tree matched exactly); (c) write each arm with its
  FULL downstream call sequence so crossjumping builds want's shared body
  blocks for you (§6s-7), ordering the arms to place blocks like want.
- **§6ae-11 Park signature — unfolded index materialization**: want computes
  a loop-store index pre-loop as `[li r30,1][slwi r30,r30,2]` (NOT folded to
  `li 4`) and recycles the register across four webs; every C form folds it,
  recomputes it in-loop, or inflates the saved-reg span (fn_801A59B4).
  Related to recipe 60's dead-magic materialization.
- **§6ae-12 Zone arity ground truths**: fn_80127684 is GENUINELY 3-arg
  (prologue mr r29,r4/mr r28,r5 — refines the doc-15 "proto
  tension" entry which only varied return type); fn_8001448C returns a u64
  r3:r4 pair; fn_801ADCD0 2-arg with FIELD-passed r4 (recipe 18);
  fn_80124F44 0-arg; fn_801F0610 `(s32 ptr, hash)` → f32; fn_801A275C 2-arg
  passthrough; wrappers pass just-loaded fields THROUGH to
  fn_80009AAC/fn_80009C84 (r3 untouched-at-bl means passthrough here too,
  not always hidden-arg0).
- **§6ae-13 doc-28 counter-evidence**: `mcrf cr4,cr0` + double `beq cr4`
  consumption of one null-check fell out of PLAIN C written as nested
  `!= NULL` with bottom return-0 (fn_801A2F2C) — long-range CR machinery is
  reachable without asm wedges when both consumes sit close together;
  extends §6t-2's memory-backed-flag route.

## 70 — learnings (2026-08-23, skater/trick zone
0x801AD3DC–0x801B063C: 36 EXACT-in-wip / 9 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 2 NEAR / 40 DIFF / 3 FAIL → 36 EXACT via parallel
sub-agents (two network-error retries; one group needed a second pass).
Chained-r3 audits + per-caller protos cracked most; a five-member
"walk-template" family fell to one shared recipe. New levers:

144. **Asm-anchor SANDWICH splits a symbol address around an unrelated
     insn** (fn_801AF244): `__asm__ volatile("lis %0,%1@ha" : "=r"(a) :
     "s"(lbl));` … plain-C `zero = 0;` … `__asm__ volatile("addi %0,%0,%1@l"
     : "+r"(a) : "s"(lbl));` places want's `li r8,0` exactly BETWEEN the
     @ha and @l halves. Generalizes the §6u-3 anchor from load-emission to
     PLACEMENT control — use whenever want interleaves an independent
     instruction inside a lis/addi (or lis/ori) address pair.
145. **Inline-asm constant BIRTH defeats known-zero reuse** (fn_801AD448):
     `__asm__("li %0,0" : "=r"(cnt));` on a pinned register both EMITS the
     li and makes the value opaque, so GCC births a fresh zero instead of
     reusing a known-zero register. Distinct from barriers (no emission)
     and from §6c-28 (source-order hoist): this is for pinned/asm contexts
     where the compiler would otherwise fold the constant away entirely.
146. **PIN CAVEAT — hard-reg pins can backfire via scheduler hoisting**
     (fn_801AF004): pinning arg0 made ngccc hoist an independent `li r0,1`
     ABOVE the `mr r27,r3` home-copy; declaring arg0 as a PLAIN local let
     GCC home it itself and matched. When a pin introduces hoisting diffs,
     drop it and try plain-local first — pins are a lever, not a default.
147. **Bit-clear-by-variable emits li -2 + rotlw** (fn_801AECA4): a missing
     param masked as `x & ~(1 << arg1)` reproduces want's
     `li r0,-2; rotlw` idiom verbatim — check for variable-bit mask params
     before assuming m2c's flat `arg & ~msk` shapes.
148. **Walk-template family (5 fns cracked: AF5DC/AF638/AF6CC/AF730/
     AF780)** — root cause everywhere: GCC coalesces the scratch walker
     web into a saved-reg web. Recipe: pin the scratch
     (`register s32 w __asm__("r9")`), COPY then test-the-copy-target so
     combine fuses `or. rD,rS,rS`; a `"+r"` barrier blocks arg-leak.
     Count-return variant (fn_801AF688): pin the RESULT web to r3
     (`register s32 var_r3 __asm__("r3")`) → early `li r3,0` + `beqlr`
     guard + bare `blr` falls out naturally. Extends §6p-111 call-slot
     pins to loop walkers and return values.
149. **Value-returning WRAPPER rewrite reorders epilogue arg-setup**
     (fn_801AFCBC): converting a discard-call wrapper to
     `return fn(...);` (semantically identical) flipped the final
     [ori]/[li r6] order that all schedule flags resisted. Byte-neutral
     semantic changes are legitimate scheduling levers — try make-it-
     return before flag ladders (complements M8.31/M8.33 proto flips).
150. **Duplicated fixup blocks let crossjump build retail's shared tail**
     (fn_801AF37C/fn_801AF434): write the sentinel/entry fixup TWICE
     (before the loop AND at the bottom); GCC's crossjumping merges them
     into one block exactly like want. Inverse warning from the same fn:
     goto-loop form may be needed to STOP rotation first.
151. Zone truths: fn_80019D08/fn_801AED74 take per-caller s32 protos here
     despite void promotion elsewhere (recipe 87 again); fn_80127684 is
     3-arg at these sites (r3 leftover); s8 loop counters emit extsb
     (AF4A8). Parks joined known families: ADCE4 doc-29 VMX wall,
     AD5DC doc-06 XO5=8 wall, AFA18 M4.18 pattern-10 or.-fusion + LICM
     rodata-anchor remat (frame 0x48 vs 0x38), AEE7C single scheduler
     slot-fill (94.7%), AE4CC/AE5A4 PS fmuls-batching, AEBA4 FP allocator
     tie-breaks, AE688 saved-reg web-shaping under -mps-float, AE11C
     CR-save-complete but spill-pressure slot differences (51.7%).

## 6aa — learnings (2026-08-24, script-wrapper zone II
0x801B6004–0x801BB4A0: 32 EXACT incl. 1 -mps-float / 12 PARKED, nothing promoted)

Worked as 9 parallel sub-agents off a 2-NEAR/33-DIFF/9-FAIL baseline — best
hit rate yet (73%). The §6w-97 Script template + proto audits cracked most;
twins of promoted siblings (fn_801B8598) fell verbatim. NEW findings:

146. **Volatile cvt halves + `"+f"` asm barriers force the int→float-dance
     INTERLEAVE.** The game's sinf/cosf-style blocks interleave the two cvt
     stores and their lfs/lfd consumers ([stw w1][lfs][stw w0][lfs][lfd]);
     plain C statement ordering cannot reach it because GCC keeps the union
     stores adjacent. Fix: make each dance half a VOLATILE u32 store through
     the frame struct (`*(volatile u32 *)&fr.cvt.w[1] = ...`) and put a
     `__asm__ volatile("" : "+f"(temp))` barrier between every consumer —
     the "+f" operand makes the scheduler treat each float as re-computed,
     pinning the exact emission order (fn_801B608C/61B0 EXACT; applies to
     the remaining sinf/cosf-series twins DOL-wide).
147. **An empty case label placed in a VALUE GAP steers balance_case_nodes
     for free.** Adding ONE `case 0xE0000000u:` (empty body) between real
     hash cases shifted gcc's split point so EVERY subtree root landed on
     want's pivot, while the empty case's own compare was bounds-eliminated —
     zero bytes, whole tree fixed (fn_801B67CC EXACT). Refines §6u-5/§6t-6:
     the steering label need not be inside the real case range; compute the
     split index per §6t-6 and drop an empty label at the gap nearest it.
148. **Input-only asm barrier blocks STORE-UPDATE fusion.**
     `__asm__("" :: "r"(p));` after a walker bump stops ngccc fusing the
     next store into `stfsu/stbu` form (distinct use from recipe 77, which
     blocks const-folding; fn_801B62EC EXACT).
149. **Script-ctx passthrough can come from own ARG1.** Variant of §6w-97:
     when want shows r3 untouched at three consecutive fn_80128xxx calls but
     the wrapper's prologue saved arg1 (`mr r31,r4`), the ctx passed as
     callee arg0 IS the wrapper's own arg1 (fn_801B98B4 EXACT). Check WHICH
      incoming register survives to the call before assuming arg0.
150. **Outgoing stack args can CARRY HOISTED VALUES.** §6t-1 refinement:
     m2c modeled fn_8013157C's args 9/10 as sp8/spC "locals" whose values
     were actually a hoisted zero living in r28 across earlier calls — widen
     the proto AND pass the hoisted named local explicitly
     (fn_801B6690 EXACT).
151. **__ps_t pair copyback can FIX FPR allocation.** In PS drafts where
     scalar stw runs give the wrong callee-saved FPR split, rewriting the
     tail as `__ps_t` pair copies changed allocation to want's 6-callee-saved
     layout even beyond the copy sites themselves (fn_801BB4A0 EXACT; also
     reproduced doc-30's delay window verbatim — recipe transfers cleanly).

## 6ag — learnings (2026-08-24, PS-saturated script zone
0x801CB7B8–0x801D0BCC: 23 EXACT incl. 3 -mps-float + 1 flag / 21 parked)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 2 compile-FAILs / 42 DIFF → 7 parallel sub-agents. The
zone is dominated by paired-single math; opcode EMISSION is solved (doc-06
M5.0q) and the residuals are scheduler/allocator walls. New findings:

- **§6ag-1 Goto-dispatch chains beat BOTH switch and if-chain forms** when
  want's compare tree is signed-root with unsigned prune (or any layout the
  two structured forms invert): explicit `goto label;` dispatch mirroring
  want's block order keeps shared stores mid-function and places bodies
  out-of-line byte-exact. Cracked fn_801CF370 (100%) and took fn_801CE65C
  from 68.9%→99.0%. Try it before grinding switch-tree shaping.
- **§6ag-2 test_wip_drafts.py SKIPS drafts whose header still says
  family=stub or family=tp** (tool line ~190) — a filled body with a stale
  stub header silently never sweeps. Relabel to family=m2c when filling.
- **§6ag-3 Empty-asm "=r"/"0"-matched init pins a hard-reg home cleanly**:
  `__asm__("" : "=r"(dst) : "0"(arg0));` creates dst IN arg0's register with
  no redundant mr — used for GPR pin homing and to steer an unpinned web
  onto r31 from function top (fn_801CDE04/fn_801CCF08/fn_801CB7B8).
- **§6ag-4 "+r" barrier between var=1 and a FLOAT compare blocks
  if-conversion** → want's `[li r3,1][fcmpu][bgtlr][li r3,0]` verbatim,
  no asm needed (extends §6y-143 from integer to float compares)
  (fn_801D08D4 EXACT).
- **§6ag-5 The cvt union for int↔float dances needs a VOLATILE f64 member**:
  without it GCC (a) TBAA-eliminates the lo-store/hi-store pair and
  (b) routes the conversion through a `__floatundidf` libcall when only
  u32 members exist. With it: exact `[xoris][stw-lo][stw-hi][lfd]` dances
  (fn_801CDC64/fn_801CCF08; refines §6j-1/§6ac-3).
- **§6ag-6 FPR-frame dummy placement**: the volatile-double dummy works as
  FIRST LOCAL of the function (not file-scope) — recipe 63 placement note
  (fn_801CCF80).
- **§6ag-7 Opposite-polarity duplicated arms as crossjump bait**: encoding
  the same test branchy in one arm (`v=0; if(g!=0) v=1;`) and value-folded
  in the other (`(g == 0)` → subfic/adde), tails duplicated textually, lets
  crossjumping place both exactly like want (fn_801CEF90 EXACT). Same
  family as §6s-7 per-arm call sequences.
- **§6ag-8 Barrier semantics refinement**: `"+r"` identity barriers do NOT
  block known-zero register propagation — only `"=r"` RE-BIRTH does
  (want tested a stale r27 3×, so the init had to be a memory store
  `sp8[0]=NULL`, fn_801CB7B8). Also asm-literal `lwz` wedges force
  scratch-then-addi shapes that C-level casts coalesce away; SN assembler
  takes `.long`, not `.word`, for raw insns.
- **§6ag-9 Capstone traps in PS zones**: (a) psq_l/stw displacement fields
  print in DECIMAL (`928(r1)` = 0x3A0); (b) on big bodies capstone mislabels
  primary-opcode-4 words as VMX names (vmhaddshs/vsel/maddhd) — they are
  paired-single; (c) decode discipline per doc-06 M5.0q: re-decode as BOTH
  X-form and A-form before ever parking on "undecodable opcode-4".
  `__builtin_ps_muls0` emits ps_muls0 natively (fn_801CCF08 EXACT) — manual

## 75 — learnings (2026-08-23, float/PS zone
0x801C2548–0x801CB6B8: 24 EXACT incl. 2 -mps-float / 19 PARKED, nothing promoted)

169. **`-fno-sched-spec` fixes param-home ALLOCATION-ORDER swaps** (extends
     §4r to a new class): ngccc speculatively hoists the ENTRY param-copy
     above the first call (sched1), making the param pseudo allocate FIRST
     (r31) instead of after statement webs (r30) — want homes arg0→r30 /
     global-chase web→r31 and only the flag reproduces it. Distinct from
     §4r's arg-MOVE reordering; this is register ASSIGNMENT order.
170. **capstone mislabels plain PS ops as VMX — decode raw words before
     declaring a doc-29 wall.** Opcode-4 words printed as vmsumshm/
     vmhaddshs/vsel are often ps_sub/ps_add/ps_merge00/ps_sel; undecoded
     words with xo(bits21-30)=72 are `ps_mr`. Route through
     tools/ps_diff.py's dec() first. Word-level proof standard for real
     VMX walls (fn_801C9464: 13/31 opcode-4 words have NO valid Gekko-PS
     encoding, e.g. xo5=25 with frC≠0, xo5=16 absent from PS map).
171. **Empirical ProDG 3.9.3 PS opcode map** (probed via volatile-store
     builtin isolation): sum0=10 sum1=11 muls0=12 muls1=13 madds0=14
     madds1=15 mul=16 div=18 sub=20 add=21 sel=23 merge00=25 msub=28
     madd=29; xo5=8 remains unemittable (doc-06). GCC 2.95 ICEs (expmed.c)
     on f32-lane reads through `(__ps_t *)` casts — use SN_PS_type
     `.flt.hi/.flt.lo`.
172. **`volatile T *arr[n]` is silently ignored by ProDG cc1** (qualifies
     the POINTEE): stores through it get DCE'd. Must write
     `T *volatile arr[n]`. This alone blocked a pair-store/reload idiom.
173. **Fence semantics ladder**: bare `asm volatile("")` stops reg-op
     reordering but lfs/stfs/psq_l cross freely — only `"memory"`-clobbered
     fences hold FLOAT MEMORY ops. `__asm__ __volatile__("" : "+r"(v))`
     AFTER a load forces the following copy's emission position
     (non-volatile "+r" does not). Empty NON-volatile asm shifts GLOBAL
     allocation — stray barriers are load-bearing hazards; remove stale
     ones. Split-fence trick for bdnz windows over real PS code:
     `asm("li 0,4; mtctr 0")` early + C body +
     `asm volatile("bdnz $" ::: "memory")` late (generalizes doc-30).
     Asymmetric fences flip block-local FPR naming parity ("m"-input fence
     orders dead-store-vs-copy AND flips the following v-temp f12↔f13;
     register-input-only fence orders without color disturbance). GCC 2.95
     asm operand limit = 10 (split "m"-pin batches); leading same-size
     `"m"` pins fix whole out-param frames.
174. **vcall arity = count of WRITTEN arg regs only** — a leftover pointer
     sitting in r9 does not make a 3-arg call when r5 was never written
     (sharpens recipe 86). Guard-value-through extends §72-143: at tail
     guards the tested value loads INTO r4 BECAUSE the guarded callee reads
     r4 (`if (*(arg0+0x1C) != 0) fn(arg0, *(arg0+0x1C));`) — one edit
     flipped two twins 97.1%→100%.
175. **Evaluation-order staging vs byte loads**: writing
     `byte != f(...)` forces the byte into a saved reg across the call;
     staging `t = f();` first then `*(u8 *)entry != t` lands it in scratch
     r0 — pick by where want holds the value (fn_801C5AA0).
176. **Crossjump granularity control**: identical arm bodies written
     through ONE shared variable merge under crossjump where want keeps
     them separate; giving each branch its own carrier var with identical
     single-store tail labels makes GCC merge exactly what want merges and
     keep the rest inline (fn_801C2870). TBAA notes: pointer-typed loads
     are immune to intervening s32* stores (blocks store-killed CSE);
     __ps_t* pair-copy stores do NOT force int-load reloads on other webs
     (want reloads — park reason at ~96%). u32 switch index applies even
     to dense small ranges 0..7 (signedness flips bgt→cmplwi/ble).
177. **File-scope/local pin call-clobbering + page-anchor routing**:
     file-scope register pins ARE call-clobbered — GCC sinks/reloads
     pinned values across bl, so they can never model values LIVE ACROSS
     calls; route those through shared variables instead (assign
     `(void *)0x80300000` to the mgr var and load via `+0x5EC0` offsets —
     reproduces want's @ha anchor without pins). Duplicate a division into
     BOTH if/else arms to get want's duplicated `[lis;lfs;lfs]` arms +
     shared fdivs/stfs tail.

     ALSO the route to muls0-shaped words (GCC canonicalizes

     mul→merge00→madd→sum0→rsqrte→res IS emittable — doc-06 walls there are
     scheduling, not emission.

     switch arm's float operand as its own local forces in-arm `lfs`, so GCC
     crossjump merges ONLY the `[li r5; bl]` tail like want (fn_801C0FF4);
     shared locals let it merge too much or too little.

     page reg once (`lis r9,lbl@ha`) then folds per-site (`lfs @l(r9)`):
     `__asm__ volatile("lis %0,%1@ha" : "=r"(page) : "s"(lbl_X));` before the
     store and `... "lfs %0,%1@l(%2)" ... : "s"(lbl_X), "r"(page));` after
     reproduces both halves exactly (fn_801C1A9C EXACT, 28B).
182. **Wrapper twins pass BOTH own args through** when want shows r4 untouched
     at the bl — `(void*, s32)` not `(void*)` (fn_801BF438/C1B40/C0DD0;
     extends §6e-32 to arg1).

     -mps-float): N const-float stores to consecutive offsets first, THEN the
     psq pair copies → arg0+off; place pair #1 AFTER the f13 singles so GCC
     hoists its psq_l between them; permute the tail store run
     ([b0,7c,a8,ac]←source [7c,a8,ac,b0]) until the scheduler emits want's
     order. Calls go LAST (arg setup hoists into the float block).

Gekko PS A-form words because frC sits at bits 21–25 where VMX has VC; the

167. **Two-form decode discipline for EVERY opcode-4 word before any park.**
     Decode as X-form (VD VB / XO10@21-30: 72=ps_mr, 528/592=merge00/01,
     abs=264 nabs=136 neg=40) AND A-form (VD VA VB VC@21-25 xo5@26-30:
     sum0=10 sum1=11 muls0=12 muls1=13 madds0=14 madds1=15 merges=c16-19
     sel=23 res=24 rsqrte=26 sub=20 add=21 mul=25 madd=29). Only park if the
     word fits NEITHER table. Genuine walls still exist: fn_801B1278 holds a
     real unknown op (101DF00C/109DF00C XO10=6 + F00E Rc=1 variants) — that
     is doc06's original xo5=6/7 class, NOT VMX.
168. **madds0's multiplier pair is the THIRD builtin arg** — operand order in
     `__builtin_ps_madds0(a,b,c)` differs from the encoding's visual A,B,C
     (cracked fn_801B19DC). Probe encodings with ps_diff.py when unsure.
169. **frN register pins only stick on psq_l-FED values; pinning
     builtin-result webs collapses allocation** (fn_801B19DC: pins held on
     loads a→fr13/b→fr11/cc→fr12, failed on computed temps). Same-register
     DOUBLE pins poison global allocation — never pin two live webs to one
     frN (both B19DC and B4404 independently hit this).
170. **Doc-30 empty-doloop windows are reproducible via split volatile asm
     fragments ending in `bdnz $`**, and SHORT instruction runs can be frozen
     as raw-word asm blocks with real `bl` mnemonics swapped in for REL24
     relocs — SMALL WINDOWS ONLY inside genuinely reconstructed C (doc-30
     spin loops; a recycled-register tail). This is NOT a license for
     whole-body or majority-body transcription: see recipe 180's hard rules
     and the §4g ASM_FUNC ban. (fn_801B23FC's heavy use of this was judged
     over the line in the 2026-08-25 audit and refilled.)
171. **SN cc1 rejects the `'s'` asm constraint on f32-typed externs**
     ("inconsistent operand constraints") — declare rodata symbols
     `extern char lbl_X[]` when feeding lis/lfs asm fragments (fn_801B4404).
172. **File-scope register pin beats local pin when want's saved-reg value
     feeds a stack load**: a local r31 pin corrupted one sp8[3] reload
     (`psq_l ...,0x20(r31)` instead of `(r1)`); moving the SAME pin to file
     scope kept the frame intact since r31 saves anyway (fn_801B27F8).
173. **Under `-mps-float`, EVERY function-scope `__ps_t` local reserves a
     dead frame slot (+8 each)** — nesting into expressions doesn't remove
     them; budget this when matching PS-frame sizes (fn_801B1D00 park note).
174. **Hash literals stay BARE when want materializes THEM via lis+ori** —
     the extern-lbl rule is only for symbol ADDRESSES (data/function/string);
     QB hash constants compared/stored as values keep ori form (fn_801B0B3C).
     Inverse tell: want lis+addi ⇒ lbl symbol; want lis+ori ⇒ bare literal.

## 7d — learnings (2026-08-25, list-walk/manager zone
0x801FA318–0x801FD03C: 32 EXACT incl. 4 -mps-float / 6 PARKED, nothing
