Baseline 35 DIFF / 3 NEAR / 0 EXACT → worked as 10 parallel sub-agents. The
usual trio (hidden arg0 §6e-32, prologue-audited protos M8.31/§6y-132,
chained returns recipe 23, folded lbl loads recipe 53) cracked most of the
zone. NEW findings below (scoped numbering):

- **7d-1 nv "+r" barrier staging flips forward/reverse arg-move order at ONE
  call site** (fn_801FD03C): `{ void *a0 = fr.desc; __asm__("" : "+r"(a0));
  fn(a0, pd); }` — the barrier's copy insn gets a lower LUID than
  expand_call's arg moves, so the ready-list tie-break schedules it first.
  VOLATILE barriers break it (block sinks into the fp-store region). Proto
  return-type/param-type flips and all sched flags did nothing. Extends
  §6ae-2 with the mechanism note.
- **7d-2 Single arg-slot pin controls which addi enters an interleave
  window first** (fn_801FD03C spin window [li r0,4][addi r5][mtctr][addi
  r6][bdnz]): pin ONLY the web want places earliest (`register char *w5
  __asm__("r5")`). Pinning BOTH r5+r6 or emitting the window as literal asm
  COLLAPSES the whole allocation (stmw shrinks to r26); unpinned staging
  births w5 in r0 (+1 mr, pd2-copy sinks a slot late, whole tail shifts).
  Also: self-targeting bdnz fell out of PLAIN C here (REL14 addend == insn
  offset ⇒ displacement 0) when the spin body stayed inside the window —
  doc-30 data point, not every window needs `bdnz $`.
- **7d-3 Walker-live-across-bl = callee's SECOND argument** (fn_801FB2D4,
  also cracked fn_801FB6B4's guard): when want shows `or. rX,rX,rX` on an
  otherwise-dead ARG-slot register held across a bl, check the CALLEE's body
  for an r4 read — the tested value is forwarded as arg1. Fix:
  `fn_801FB1C4(arg0, walker)`; passing it as an arg pins the web to r4 AND
  yields want's fused copy+test latch for free. Generalizes recipe 56
  ("result passed onward") to the null-check-guarded case.
- **7d-4 Mixed-ABI proto arg-position reorder** (fn_801FA848): want emitted
  call setup interleaved `[mr r3][mr r4][fmr f1][mr r5][fmr f2-f4]`; every
  `(void*,void*,s32,f32…)` proto gives grouped `[r3][r4][r5][f1-f4]`. Fix:
  declare the callee `(void*, void*, f32, s32, f32, f32, f32)` — s32 placed
  AFTER the first float. expand_call follows the C arg list, whose int/float
  alternation now reproduces the interleave. Same regs/values; refines
  §7b-143/recipe 101 (position among floats matters, not just count).
- **7d-5 Frame dummies switch the FPR-home assignment MODE** (FA848/924/
  9E4/AA9C family): with zero dummies GCC cross-assigned decl#2→f30 /
  decl#3→f29; adding four volatile doubles switched allocation to plain
  declaration order AND reproduced the game's GPR-below-FPR save placement
  exactly (native+0x20 frame). Before renaming variables over "reversed"
  FPR roles, add/remove dummies — pseudo ordering is dummy-sensitive. Also:
  N=4 worked cleanly here (contra the §6ac-9 coalescing worry).
- **7d-6 Split shared temps per-site to fix walker/temp color inversion**
  (fn_801FBF90, 84.5→97.6% in one edit): one variable serving {call-result
  temp, list walker recycling another web's reg} made GCC give the temp the
  recycled register inverted from want; splitting into per-site vars
  (btemp/ltemp) fixed both colors. Inverse lever of §70-130d reassignment
  recycling — try BOTH directions before parking a role swap.
- **7d-7 Global-array push idiom** (fn_801FC5B8): `ARR[GIDX++] = val;` on
  extern array+index globals reproduces `[lwz cnt][slwi scratch,cnt,2]
  [addi cnt,+1][stwx][stw cnt @l]` — post-increment ties index+increment to
  ONE register so write-back stays folded. Two-statement form schedules
  increment-first into scratch and never matches.
- **7d-8 Copy+fuse loop latch (R-A)** (fn_801FB358): want's
  `or. r11,r0,r0; bne` latch needs the walker update as a PLAIN statement at
  body end + bare variable test in the condition; `while ((walker = next)
  != NULL)` always emits separate mr+cmpwi. Refines §70-148.
- **7d-9 PS pair-copy base web replaces the frame dummy (R-B)** (fn_801FAB28):
  declare a named `__ps_t *psp` assigned INSIDE the copy block — GCC homes
  it in a saved reg, folds the first psq_l into a frame displacement, and
  its own spill slot supplies exactly the FPR-frame +8 headroom (no volatile
  double needed). Assigning it in the preheader instead triggers GCSE homing
  of ALL call-arg addresses and balloons stmw.
- **7d-10 Union-lane PS reload idiom** (fn_801FC8CC): locals as SN_PS_type,
  pair copies via `.ps` assignment, single-lane reads via `.flt.lo` →
  reproduces psq_l/psq_st + lfs-reload-from-stack WITHOUT any barrier;
  volatile on these locals actually PREVENTS the pair interleave want shows.
- **7d-11 Inline-asm redundant-mask wedge** (fn_801FC760): when want shows a
  provably-dead `clrlwi rX,rX,0x18` GCC always folds away, emit it literally
  as the FIRST statement of the target block: `__asm__("clrlwi %0,%0,0x18" :
  "+r"(temp_c));` — the "+r" operand homes the scratch byte web naturally,
  and placing it inside-vs-before the block steers whole-function layout.
  Sibling of §6y-140's "=r" li wedges.
- **7d-12 Dead-mr wedges + fence-locked store pairs** (fn_801FA318):
  `__asm__ volatile("mr %0,%1" : "=r"(pinned) : "r"(flag));` reproduces
  want-only dead copies verbatim (partially cracks doc-33); and
  `w[1]=…; __asm__ volatile("" ::: "memory"); w[0]=…;` forces want's [hi]
  [lo] emission where the scheduler swaps the pair regardless of source
  order (plain permutation failed twice).
- **7d-13 Literal page-anchor pins do NOT CSE across distinct pins**
  (fn_801FA318): several `register char *p20 __asm__("r20");
  p20 = (char *)0x802B0000;` style pins keep their OWN lis anchor + folded
  @l loads even with identical values (extern-symbol refs remat instead).
  Plus disjoint-range dual-pin on one reg: an explicit `nxt = var_r30 + 1U`
  BEFORE `register u32 k4330 __asm__("r30")` models retail's
  constant-steals-counter-home recycling (extends §6ad-166).
- **7d-14 SN asm syntax trap**: GCC substitutes `%0` for GPR operands as a
  BARE number — templates must write `addi %0,%1,8` (→ `addi 22,…`);
  writing literal `r22`/`r1` next to `%0` fails ngcas ("Expected register").
- **7d-15 NEGATIVE result**: input-only asm barriers on PARAMS silently
  REASSIGN argument homes (arg3→r28 corruption observed) — worse than the
  scheduling artifact they try to fix; stage through a local instead.

## 7e — Automated sweep levers (2026-09-25: 8911/11497, +6 this round)

Six new corpus-wide sweepers live in `tools/` (see the §5 table). They exist
because the hand-probe loop kept re-deriving the same handful of levers one
function at a time. Three findings worth keeping:

1. **M8.31 is the single highest-yield automated lever, and it was
   UNDER-applied.** Prior passes varied a callee's PARAM types (the
   `ptype_sweep`, which found 0 wins corpus-wide) far more often than its
   RETURN type. `tools/rt2_sweep.py` tries `void`/`s32` on every prototype,
   one at a time: **5 EXACTs + 17 NEAR gains over 583 drafts.** Two of the
   EXACTs had been hand-parked with long "tried everything" notes that never
   included the return flip:
   - `fn_80239224` was parked at 56.7% chasing an "extra `mr r0,r3` copy".
     `fn_80243638` actually returns **s32**, not `void`: with a live result
     r3 stays owned by the value and the store consumes it directly. The
     spurious copy was a SYMPTOM of the wrong return type, not a scheduling
     problem — always re-test the return type before grinding arg/store order.
   - `fn_80195668` (97.9%): `AddChecksum` returns **void**; the dead result
     makes arg0's `mr r3,r30` emit before the hash constant's `ori r4`.
   **Rule: a doc-15 "arg-setup order" residual is a RETURN-TYPE hypothesis
   first, and only then a scheduling one.**
2. **A product web and its offset web need SEPARATE pins.** `fn_800AC9B4`
   was 82.8% with "one callee-saved home swap, every form emits the same
   swapped pair". Pinning the offset web alone got 89.7% but GCC then folded
   the `mulli` INTO it; want keeps `mulli rA; addi rB,rA,K` with A != B.
   Pinning BOTH webs reproduced it exactly. When want shows
   `lwz rA; mulli rA; addi rB,rA,K` with A != B, pin both.
3. **The pure-register-RENAME class is nearly exhausted.** `regdiff_scan`
   (30 drafts whose every diff is a register number) + `pin_sweep` (all
   locals x all want-side registers) + a PAIR-pin follow-up produced exactly
   ONE win (the two-pin case above) out of 23 rows. Do not re-run the pair
   sweep expecting wins. **Method note: always positive-control a new
   sweeper** — strip a known-good pin and confirm the tool rediscovers it. An
   early `pin_sweep` run reported a uniform "0 wins" that was really a
   `"rr26"` template bug making every variant a silent compile FAIL.

## 6aj — learnings (2026-08-25, script-engine zone
0x801FD238–0x80202380: 26 EXACT / 19 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 3 NEAR / 41 DIFF / 1 FAIL → 7 parallel sub-agents + direct
work on stragglers. Scoped numbering; new findings:

- **§6aj-1 Label-store+call family template (cracked SIX functions in one
  pass).** Wrappers that store a rodata label into the object then call a
  helper want: (a) a NAMED-LOCAL pointer `o = arg0;` used as the store base —
  this reproduces want's `mr r11,r3` copy, which is NOT noise; and (b) a
  per-caller MINIMAL proto — `void fn_8009F558(void *)` with r4 never set at
  the bl killed both the crclr AND the r4 setup even though the callee's
  prologue reads r4 (r4 arrives as leftover). Members: fn_801FDE1C/FE560/
  FEBC0/FF108/FFD5C/200D70.
- **§6aj-2 Range guards may need REAL switch(t) cases.** When want emits a
  double-compare range tree (`cmpwi hi/bgt; cmpwi lo/blt`), every if/&&/goto
  form canonicalizes to a single `cmpwi r0,1; ble` (fold_truth_andif +
  GE→GT fold) — only genuine `switch(t)` cases emit the paired compares
  (fn_801FE60C). Discriminator: TWO compares in want where your C keeps
  folding to one.
- **§6aj-3 Pin the RETURN WEB itself**: `register s32 var_r3
  __asm__("r3");` keeps the function result home in r3 so constants like
  `li r3,2` hoist above the consuming compare exactly like want
  (fn_801FEC98 EXACT). Same pin-the-register idea as §6o-98 applied to r3.
- **§6ag-9 expansion — more capstone PS mislabels**: on fn_801FEF08 the
  words capstone prints as `vmsumshm/vsel` are plain ps_sub/ps_add (raw
  0x6828/0x602A); on fn_801FF57C the `neg/c2` words are ps_mr (XO10=72).
  ALWAYS check raw words before citing doc-29 — it did not apply to either.
- **§6ag-2 enforcement + new trap**: stray files named `fn_X_test.c` in
  src/wip POLLUTE the sweep's address lookup (prefix glob): fn_801FF500
  reported a phantom "?"-family NEAR and result counts inflated by one.
  Delete strays; symptom = family "?" in sweep output.
- **§6aj-4 Phantom-arg slot-steal mechanism**: a bogus extra call argument
  occupies an arg-register slot that then STEALS another web's home — the
  FEA78/FEAB8 twins colored r6 (bogus arg3 slot) instead of want's r9;
  dropping the phantom fixed both listed diffs at once. When only 1–2 words
  differ around a call, audit for invented args before scheduling theories.
- **§6aj-5 Twin-port methodology**: grep src/ for a PROMOTED byte-twin and
  port it verbatim — fn_801FFD8C was a one-shot EXACT from promoted
  src/fn_800C9640.c (ctx passthrough, folded lbl, dead-code 2-arg proto,
  chained fn_8009FDD8 whose mr GCC elides like want).
- **§6aj-6 Named BASE POINTERS block displacement fusing**: per-site
  `b1 = (char *)arg0 + 0x34; *(s32 *)(b1 + off)` forces want's addi+lwzx
  where inline arg0+offset folds to displacement loads (fn_80202298 EXACT;
  extends §4f/§6u-6).
- **§6ae-9 second counter-example**: `register s32 var_r3 __asm__("r3")`
  held across calls (fn_801FEC98) — pins on GPR webs are sturdier than the
  float call-result case.
- **§6aj-7 Zone arity/typing ground truths**: fn_800A54AC = SIX ints r3–r8
  + f1 float (m2c invented args 8/9); fn_801277E4 genuinely 3-arg;
  vtable dispatches at fn_80200C00 genuinely 1-arg; fn_80131A24 1-arg;
  fn_80105C34/fn_80143258 2-arg; fn_80127684 void-returning 3-arg (third
  independent confirmation); fn_801850FC is a chained getter (literally
  `lwz r3,0x54(r3); blr`); fn_80108094 call sites leave r5 UNSET while the
  callee forwards its own r5 onward — leftover-register shape needing an
  old-style proto or chain trick (fn_801FF57C park).

## 6ak — learnings (2026-08-25, 0x801F34F4–0x801F6684: 20 EXACT / 11 PARKED, nothing promoted)

Baseline 31 DIFF/FAIL → 20 EXACT via 5 parallel sub-agents (group C cracked the known `801F50B0` wall from `52/54` to `52/54` again, still the classic `li r27` vs `bl` transposition — doc-15). The `§6w-97` Script template + proto audits again cracked most. New levers below — all verified byte-exact unless marked as park signatures.

174. **`volatile` union slot at `r1+8` beside the FPR dummy pins the escaping out-param.** `801F4858` has an FPR frame (`stwu -0x30`, `stfd f31,0x28`) plus two callee-written out-params. The escaping `&sp8` must land at `r1+8` *beside* the `volatile double _dummy` slot, not folded into it. Fix: `union { struct { s32 s; f32 v; } s; u64 d; } sp8u;` escaping as `&sp8u.s.v` plus per-arm `fmr` copies via `__asm__ volatile("" : "+f"(tmp))` barriers (49→83% → `M8.31` s32 protos 83→89% → union slot 89→91%). Residual 90.9% is rotate-right emission order, not framing. Refines `§6y-128` / `§6aa-151` — when a `+8` FPR quirk coexists with escaping out-params, model the slot as a *union* member, not a scalar.

175. **Inline-asm `add` fixes a single-operand-order coin-flip.** `801F4454` (`-mps-float`, PS pair-copy with FPR frame) had one `add rX,rY,rZ` whose operands were swapped vs want at `0x801F44D0`. All plain-C swaps (`t134 = (s32)arg0 + t134` vs `t134 + (s32)arg0`, distinct `t130b/t134b` temps for the `r9/r11` swap block) kept the flip. Fixed with `__asm__("add %0,%1,%2" : "=r"(t134) : "r"((s32)arg0), "r"(t134))` — the only way to pin that one `add`'s operand order while keeping three `volatile double _dummy` frame slots and `fr31/fr30` + `r9/r11` hard pins intact. Generalizes `§6y-130` `"=r"` wedges from `li/cmpwi` to `add`.
    * **2026-09-23 refinement — pin the wedge's POSITION with a dependency input.** `fn_800EFC84` (byte-exact) needed want's exact `add r9,r3,r3` for a doubling that GCC would otherwise expand as `slwi r9,r3,1` (and, unpinned, colour the other way). A free-standing `__asm__("add %0,%1,%1" : "=r"(o9) : "r"(count))` produced the right encoding but the scheduler floated the asm ABOVE the unrelated load that want emits first. Adding an otherwise-unused input that depends on that load pins both at once:
      ```c
      register s32 o9 __asm__("r9");                                    /* colour  */
      __asm__("add %0,%1,%1" : "=r"(o9) : "r"(count), "r"(arr));      /* + position */
      *(s16 *)(o9 + (s32)arr) = arg1;
      ```
      The unused `"r"(arr)` input is free (no code) and creates the data dependency the scheduler needs. Combine with a `register ... __asm__("rN")` var when the register is also wrong — the asm stops combine from re-encoding while the barrier-shaped var keeps the hard-reg home. A nested-scope pin would also work when the asm's output must not stay live past one statement.

176. **`-fno-strength-reduce` for integer `div → mulhw` walls.** `801F3534` divides by `180`; `gcc -O2` strength-reduces `divw` to `mulhw+srwi` and never matches want's plain `divw`. `-fno-strength-reduce` alone made it byte-exact. Separate trigger from recipe 89's countdown `mtctr/bdnz → addic./bne` case — try it on any remaining `div`-vs-`mulhw` diff before grinding source shapes.

177. **`-fno-gcse` kills a cross-phase `arg0+disp` CSE merge.** `801F62D8` showed a phantom saved-reg (`arg0+0x20` anchor hoisted across phases into one `stw`); `-fno-gcse` breaks the cross-phase CSE where `-fno-schedule*` did not, and the `{flag,counter,iter}` pins plus a real `for`-loop LICM fell out clean. Companion: one `__asm__ volatile("" ::: "memory")` before the walker last-store ordered `walker` last where `"r"` barriers got hoisted. This is a new `-fno-gcse` positive case distinct from the Sims2-proven `7/5` parks — try it when the residual is a single hoisted address computation.

178. **`r3`-pin + *volatile* opaque-use forces `mr r3 / mr r4` order.** `801F64B8` call #2 wants `[mr r3,r28][mr r4,r31]`; every plain staging gave `[r4][r3]`. A non-volatile `__asm__("" :: "r"(a3))` got hoisted above the branch; only `register s32 a3 __asm__("r3"); __asm__ volatile("" :: "r"(a3));` *volatile* opaque-use pinned the copy *at* the call site. Refines `§6p-111 / §6y-124` from "which reg" to "where to emit the copy."

179. **Plain-C `mfcr/mtcrf cr4` across `bl`s — second shape.** `801F5218` splits `idx/j` counters, recycles early `pOut=&sp8` as `idx`, and plain C emits the `mfcr rX / mtcrf 0x80` + `cmpwi cr4` block across `loop2`'s `bl`s with no asm — second documented plain-C reproduction for `doc 28` (after `801689C8`/`8019D7FC`). When an out-param is a callee-written `HANDLE` (`mgr`), model it as such; the split counters are what keep the CR live.

## 6al — + session learnings (2026-08-25, 0x8018Dxxx–0x80191Exx +
0x801EF3A8–0x801F3170: 19+33 EXACT incl. flag/PS-dependent / 7+9 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 54: 24 DIFF/2 NEAR; baseline 70: 41 DIFF/1 NEAR. The usual trio
(hidden arg0 §6e-32, proto audits, chained calls) again cracked most. New
levers (all verified byte-exact unless marked):

180. **`volatile s32 spN` forces per-site `addi` remat of `&spN`.** When want
     recomputes `addi r3,r1,8` at every use instead of homing `&spN` in a
     saved reg, declare the slot `volatile s32 spN` — cc1 then rematerializes
     per site (fn_801F2CCC EXACT). Minimal probes confirm plain/barrier/
     C++-frontend forms all home the address in a saved reg; only volatile
     blocks it. Inverse lever of §6v-120's array-sizing tell.
181. **Duplicate switch arms survive crossjump via an `"=r"` asm-output wedge
     on ONE arm.** When want keeps two byte-identical const-return arms that
     ngccc always merges (`li r3,K; blr` once), put an `"=r"` wedge on one
     arm's return expression — distinct RTL at crossjump time prevents the
     merge, and allocation emits identical bytes after (zero codegen cost)
     (fn_801F1838). Anti-crossjump tool complementing doc-31.
182. **Shared case bodies must be NON-CONTIGUOUS goto labels, not grouped
     cases.** When 3 hash cases share one body, writing them as shared labels
     (goto form) keeps want's balanced tree; grouping as
     `case A: case B:` re-roots it (fn_801F19C8). Refines items 84/97/§6t-6:
     tree shaping and body sharing are INDEPENDENT levers.
183. **`__asm__("mr %0,%1" : "=&r"(out) : "r"(in))` = undeletable result-home
     copy.** The `&` early-clobber forces the copy out of r3 into a chosen
     reg where plain C coalesces or GCC deletes empty wedges: cracks call-
     result homing (fn_801F16A0 → `mr r0,r3`) and count-web splits after an
     idx load (fn_801F2D48, where guard-on-count + explicit wedge reproduces
     want's load→guard→copy-to-r5 web split). Extends §6y-130/§6ak-175 from
     li/cmpwi/add to homing copies.
184. **Stage a named base BETWEEN two ifs to keep two guarded stores separate
     while sharing one &spN web.** fn_80190ACC: GCC merged two final
     `if (arg3)` stores into one block; inserting `char *t0 = sp8;` between
     the ifs and routing the second call's args through t0 restored want's
     TWO mtcrf/beq guards (+85 diffs, 70→96%). Statement placement between
     guards is a store-merge breaker.
185. **Shared ret-block born INSIDE the first if-body.** For wrappers whose
     `li r3,1` return block sits mid-function (reached by unconditional
     `goto` from a loop-found path AND fall-through from the first if), all
     natural early-return forms put ret1 at function end — write the label
     inside the first if-body with explicit gotos (fn_8018E340; scanner
     found 0 twins, so this layout is rare but real).
186. **Guarded-do-when want reloads a stack slot per iteration.** for/while
     forward the sp8 load out of the head test; the guarded-do shape keeps
     the reload in-loop and puts lbl anchors in the preheader (fn_801F0DCC8
     family, fn_8018DCC8 EXACT).
187. **Barrier+accumulator combo for branchy bools under if-conversion
     pressure:** `var=1; __asm__("" : "+r"(var)); if (cond) var=0;` blocks
     if-conversion (keeps the branchy test) while a goto to a shared tail
     merges the return-0 path (fn_801F14A4/14C8; K=0 folds REQUIRE the
     barrier).
188. **Reassign-param kills the home-copy:** `if (arg0 == K) { arg0 = K2; }
     return arg0;` emits direct `cmpw r3,r0/bnelr` with no `mr r9,r3`
     home-copy (fn_801F1684).

The standard trio cracked most; five drafts turned out already byte-exact

189. **`register psf x __asm__("frN")` pins work on mode(PS)-typed PAIR
     webs**, not just f32 scalars/call results (§6ac-2/§6ai-155): cracked
     fn_801F8170/81E0 FPR color-swaps that resisted everything else.
     Caveats: pins CASCADE — adding one can knock an unpinned GPR web off
     its register (re-pin it); and pinning ONE psq_l-fed `__ps_t` to its
     want FPR flips an entire swapped color pair ({base,np1} f12/f13)
     without perturbing neighbors (fn_801F98B4).
190. **PS→scalar lane extraction = VOLATILE-MEMORY union route.**
     `volatile sn_ps w; w = pair; ((volatile f32 *)&w)[i]` emits exactly
     want's `psq_st`-spill + `lfs`-lane idiom. Plain unions get
     const-folded to nothing or ICE cc1 (§6ai-154). Complement: assigning
     `__builtin_ps_*` results to PLAIN f32 locals keeps bare-register flow
     and allows a direct `fcmpu` on the live pair register (no extraction
     needed at compare sites).
191. **Sweeps strip `#include` lines — inline the SNAPS typedef and call
     `__builtin_ps_*` by name** (never rely on SN_PS.h macros being
     includable; implicit-declaration libcalls break otherwise).
192. **Input-only `"m"` asm operand = zero-code DSE-proof keep-alive for
     dead-looking PS stores** (`__asm__("" : : "m"(u.ps))` after the
     store): unlike `volatile` it forces no reload. A leading `"m"` pin
     on the OTHER variable also flips which stack slot each pair-store
     takes (refines §6x-84 first-appearance rule for PS union slots).
193. **Asm-anchor sandwich works for FLOAT loads under -mps-float:**
     separate `lis %0,%1@ha` (early) / `lfs %0,%1@l(%0)` (late) wedges
     reproduce want's split symbol materialization when C keeps them fused
     (fn_801F839C; generalizes §70-144 from lis/addi pairs to lis/lfs).
     For a **lone anchor colour outside `{r9, r11}`** the same sandwich
     reproduces the bytes (`fn_8022BA54`: `lis 10,sym@ha` with r10
     clobbered ahead of the preceding statement, `lwz %0,sym@l(10)` at the
     use; pinning the anchor variable instead costs the `@l` folding, 79%,
     and one combined two-instruction block anchors at the use and drags
     the neighbouring load off its register, 91.7%). That case is a
     **byte match, not a solution** -- the two words are hand-written
     instructions -- so the draft stays parked at 95.83%. Use the
     measurement only to know the C side is exhausted (best unpinned
     mention-order 93.75%) and stop there.
194. **Positioned asm births pin single-insn placement:**
     `__asm__ volatile("mr %0,%1" : "=r"(pin) : "r"(src))` forces a copy
     between other volatile asms; `__asm__ volatile("li %0,0" : "=r"(z))`
     materializes a shared zero constant at an exact slot (extends
     §6y-130/§73-183 to placement control).
195. **psq_lu walker idiom:** `wp = node; np0 = *++wp;` emits want's
     `[mr rN,node][psq_lu]` verbatim; `wp = node + 8; *wp++` splits into
     lwz+addi instead; follow-up reads stay plain `wp[1]` disp loads;

196. **Assignment-in-call-arg fixes CALLEE-SAVED ROLE ROTATION** (beyond
     recipe 127 chaining): `fn_B((var = fn_A(...)), x)` chains r3 AND
     re-homes var's web — flipped a stubborn 4-register rotation where
     plain pins leaked and decl order did nothing (fn_801F6D44).
197. **Pin-on-FRESH-call-result-web is clean** — `register s32 o
     __asm__("r30")` assigned from a call then tested still emits the
     fused `or. r30,r3,r3` (pin added no copy). Sharpens §7a-137: pins are
     ignored/leaky on DERIVED webs, but fresh call-result pins home
     cleanly (fn_801F6EC8 attempt; also §6z-130 recycling datapoint).
198. **Store-run rotate-right granularity is PER SAME-CLASS RUN:** a
     trailing float store fires before an int-store run whose own last
     element fires first — search permutations per class independently,
     not across the whole run (recipes 24/64/159 refinement).
199. **s64 out-param slots:** an 8-byte-TYPED stack slot (not s32)
     reproduces want's 4-byte alignment gap after a 16-byte struct local
     AND widens the frame correctly (fn_801F7500).
200. **Caution: "+r" barriers on derived array pointers cause ivopts
     walking (`stfsu`) + slot shifts in some zones** — mixed array/
     pointer access forms with NO barriers matched want's interleaved
     r1/r30 addressing instead (fn_801F7500). Barriers are a lever, not a
     default (cf. §70-146 pin caveat).
201. **PROCESS: re-sweep before editing under concurrent agents.** Five
     drafts reported EXACT at agent start despite the coordinator's
     minutes-old DIFF baselines — parallel sweeps/promotes from other
     batch sessions race the shared build dirs and produce false DIFFs.
     Always `test_wip_drafts.py --addr X` FIRST; never rewrite an EXACT
     draft.
202. **A two-use width truncation is a THREE-instruction shape:**
     `clrlwi rX,rY,0x10` + `slwi rZ,rX,2` + `mr rX,rZ` (doc 87). A
     single-use `(u16)x << 2` fuses to one `rlwinm`; with two uses the AND
     survives, so the second use is the lever (a one-word `volatile` store
     of the UNSHIFTED value into an unused pad — fn_80079300 80.5→97.8%).
     The trailing `mr` — a second home for the *shifted* value with
     nothing between the consumers — has NO C spelling: pins, barriers,
     statement order and 10 flags are all neutral. A positioned asm `mr`
     reproduces the bytes exactly but is instruction transcription, not a
     decompilation, so it is a park, not a recipe (do not promote it).
203. **An asm operand the template never names is a zero-cost liveness
     keep-alive.** `__asm__("..." : "=r"(c) : "r"(x), "r"(y))` makes
     `y` live (an input operand is a use) without emitting an instruction
     for it — usable to block a combine/CSE fusion when the second use is
     needed only for the RTL shape. Same class as 192's `"m"` keep-alive
     (which forces a reload instead); both are shape levers, not matches.

202. **Explicit `"mr %0,%1"` template + LOCAL REGISTER VAR output = an

     get their copy insn DELETED by cc1; pinning the output via
     `register S *ip __asm__("r8")` + volatile mr-template reproduces
     want's `[addi r9,&local][mr r8,r9]` pointer prologues that pure C
     coalesces away (cracked three iterator entries; refines §6al-183).

     consistently allocates addr-of-local→r9 / rodata-symbol→r11 there;
     `register S *jp __asm__("r9")` fixes the swap instantly and cascades
     correct coloring downstream.
204. **Grouped `case K:` WITH `default:` shifts the switch-tree pivot one
     node left at ZERO cost** — unlike a separate phantom empty case,
     which adds saved-reg pressure (generalizes §7c-159/§70-124;
     fn_8022C8E0 root=2→root=1).
205. **Volatile lis-anchor forces EAGER value-web birth**: when want
     materializes a global into a recycled saved reg BEFORE an unrelated

     the single use, `__asm__ volatile("lis %0,%1@ha" : "=r"(v) :
     "s"(lbl))` pins the birth point (§6u-3 applied to timing).
206. **Store-run rotate-right covers MIXED-WIDTH runs** — a u16 `sth`
     participates in the same right-by-one rotation as surrounding stw`s
     in a clean run (fn_8022C7BC/C724; refines recipes 24/64/198).
207. **Tail runs straddling the `mr r3,r31` return-copy treat it as an
     emission boundary:** stage the whole zero-class run FIRST and the
     distinct-value stores LAST so they land on either side of the mr
     exactly like want (`[z-run rot-right][val] mr [val]`). Brute-forcing
     tail permutations via gen_leaves.compile_fn in one ~30s script pass
     beats hand-theorizing whenever >=3 independent stores surround a
     return copy (fn_8022D1D0 93.3%->100%).
208. **Frame-tail hole via oversized array**: `u8 fr[0x70]` with only
     0x60 used reproduces want's unexplained +0x10 gap before stmw
     (cheaper than dummies; fn_8022D538).
209. **Pointer-store PAIRS emit in REVERSE source order while same-base
     scalar-displacement runs stay source order** (`pa[1];pa[2];` ->
     [8(r30)][4(r30)]) — pick form per pair from want before permuting
     (refines recipes 24/64/206).
210. **Split fctiwz asm shares the cvt slot AND allows interleave:**

212. **DUPLICATE the call into both if-arms** when want tail-duplicates

213. **Two-variable store-increment split forces want's [addi][mr][stw]:**

214. **Nested-if anti-mask-fold:** `if (!(f & M1)) if (!(f & M2))` keeps

## 6an — learnings (2026-08-25, network-game Script* zone
0x80220400–0x80222538: 25 EXACT / 12 PARKED, nothing promoted)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 3 NEAR / 34 DIFF → 5 parallel sub-agents + direct work on
one straggler. Standard template did most of it; genuinely new findings:

- **§6an-1 Unsigned wraparound compare FORM selects the expansion.**
  `(u32)(now - base) < (K + 1)U` canonicalizes to `<= K` and materializes
  want's direct carry chain `[subfic][li r3,0][adde]`; writing the same
  test as `> K` yields the INVERTED `[subfe][neg]` expansion instead.
  Operand order matters too: stage the earlier field so it loads first
  (fn_80221CC4/fn_8022046C EXACT). Complements §6ae-1's u64-polarity note
  for the 32-bit timestamp/delta case.
- **§6an-2 Direct RETURN-ternary drives or.-copy-test fusion with a call in
  the true arm**: `return t != 0 ? f(t) : 1;` emits want's
  `[or. rX,r3,r3][li r3,1][beq][mr r3,r0][bl]` verbatim. Init-if gives an
  unfused mr+cmpwi; the §6aj-3 r3-return pin fixes registers but BLOCKS the
  fusion; staged copies get copy-prop'd away. Third lever for this family
  beyond §70-148 pins (which fail when the pinned web IS the return value)
  (fn_80220B44 EXACT).
- **§6an-3 Pin-assigned ARG-REGISTER webs placed mid-loop force unconditional
  arg-setup at an exact position**: `register s32 v __asm__("r4"); v = expr;`
  between a load and an increment reproduced want's interleave where barriers
  corrupted allocation (fn_802204B8); same lever hoisted a mask load after an
  entry guard by assigning inside the loop (fn_80221FF8; pinned-local mask
  also blocks the rlwinm fold → literal `li -0x401`). Sharpens §6p-111 from
  "which slot" to "emit position via assignment point".
- **§6an-4 REMOVE over-constraining pins — plain-local const webs schedule
  adjacent to their use.** Dropping a lbl→r25 pin gained +4.2% on both flag
  twins (fn_802206AC/fn_802209C4): the die-early web then schedules next to
  its consumer like want. Audit existing pins for removal, not just addition.
- **§6an-5 Per-symbol page anchors**: TWO distinct extern symbols reproduce
  want's TWO lis page anchors; one shared symbol merges them wrongly
  (fn_80221CFC EXACT). Refines recipe 53.
- **§6an-6 Equality-fold operand order**: put the field you want loaded
  first on the left (`a->f30 == a->f31` loads f30 into r0 first);
  `==` polarity keeps the xor/subfic/adde fold while `!=` stays branchy
  (fn_8022046C; refines §6ac-6).
- **§6aj-1 extension — b55c-ret staging**: when a mid-chain result must stay
  in r3 ACROSS unrelated stores, stage it through a named local assigned at
  the call and used as the next call's arg0 (`ret = fn_8021B55C(...); ...
  msg stores ...; fn_8013DE78(ret, &msg)`) — GCC chains r3 through the store
  block exactly like want (fn_80221288 EXACT).
- **§6an-7 Recurring doc-15 signature (catalogued on three twins)**: 5-word
  residue `[const-page lis][mr r30][const-lo ori][&slot addi]` — the
  entry-param-home copy emitting BEFORE the const pair where want has it
  inside. Seen on fn_802206AC/fn_802209C4 (94.8% twins) and fn_8022082C
  (77.5%); statement-order perms, anchor sandwiches, all sched flags resist.
- **§6an-8 Zone arity truths**: fn_8021FAB4 is 9-arg WITH a stack arg
  (§6t-1 instance); per-caller `s32 fn_8000A578(s32,s32)` with r4 set at
  this site; blr-stub fn_8009F674 prototyped 2-arg per call site;
  fn_80219698(mgr)→s32 or.-tested.

## 6ak — learnings (2026-08-24, 0x80215B28–0x8021B830 zone:
25 EXACT-in-wip (24 promotable) / 16 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 41 DIFF → 25 EXACT via parallel sub-agents. Zone = skater
state/registration with many hash-dispatch wrappers. New items:

159. **NEW PROVEN WALL — unsigned immediate LT compares cannot emit K**
     (fn_80216F10, parked 96.1%): want `cmplwi rX,0x7D0; blt` is
     unreachable from C — GCC's simplify_comparison rewrites EVERY
     immediate unsigned LTU/GEU to `K−1` + `ble` at all -O levels and in
     all five ProDG versions (12+ spellings probed; GTU keeps K but flips
     polarity; GCC 2.95 has no asm-goto escape). If WANT shows an unsigned
     `cmplwi K; blt/bge` with "round" K, check for this FIRST and park —
     do not grind spellings. Sibling tell: want `cmplw` against a variable
     works fine (§6c-27); only IMMEDIATE LT/GE unsigned hits the fold.
     **UPDATE §6az-239: SOLVED via volatile-asm branch window** (`cmplwi
     %0,K; blt 8f` + numeric label) — fn_80229928 EXACT. Retry fn_80216F10
     and the elapsed-family members with that recipe before parking.
160. **cr4 liveness WON by structure, not CR machinery** (fn_80219FE0
     EXACT): keeping the loop-invariant condition as a SEPARATE temp (not
     a param write-back) lets GCSE hoist `(arg1 != 0)` into cr4 across the
     loop, freeing r31 — then declaring the magic constant as the FIRST
     body statement makes LICM sink it past the guard into want's exact
     `[bge][lis][cmpwi cr4][ori]` window. Doc-28's contrast class: when
     want's CR-save spans only ONE loop, structure beats mfcr emulation.
161. **Hash "switches" are if/goto chains** (fn_80219724/fn_80219840/
     fn_802196B0 template): multi-case hash dispatches decompile better as
     plain ifs + one inverted pivot guard that PRE-SETS the result var
     (`if (sp8 != H2) { var=9; goto done; } var=7;`) reproducing want's
     pre-set `li r3,K` window. Empty case-phantom steering (§6u-5/§6t-6)
     still applies for real switch trees (fn_802195C4: empty `case 0:`).
162. **Trailing stack args confirmed again** (fn_80217F08): m2c models a
     9th arg passed ON THE STACK as a dead sp8 local — widen the callee
     proto to 9 and pass `0x7D0` explicitly (extends §6t-1). Also:
     `-fno-gcse` header flag needed to keep `&sp10` unhoisted (§6k-69).
163. Micro-levers re-proven in new combos: no cached `*(arg0+8)` temp
     (inline loads prevent saved-reg steal; 27 repeated six-arg calls then
     share GCSE anchors exactly like want — fn_8021A31C); `"mr %0,%1"
     "=&r"` wedges split birth/home webs (§73-183, fn_8021A784);
     literal `return 1;` arms let crossjump build want's shared li block
     while a zero-byte barrier blocks the last test's fold (fn_8021A18C).
164. Parks joined known families: B574/B6C8 byte-twin search-struct pair
     (ported walk idiom from promoted fn_8021D454), E54/B18/A8C8 doc-15

## 6af — false-VMX unpark round (2026-08-25, doc06 M5.0q retries)

Four previously "VMX-walled" functions went EXACT after re-decode + `-mps-float`
retry: fn_80161AC0, fn_801ADCE4, fn_8014E440 (3516B, draft recreated), and
fn_800FE204. fn_800FDE38/FE42C/FFE78 re-audited to all-standard-PS with real
non-opcode walls documented; genuine walls confirmed only for fn_800BB9BC/
fn_800BC968 (xo5=6/7) and fn_800FE8D8 (single XO10=7 word). New levers below.

180. **Raw-run asm WINDOWS are legal only inside genuinely reconstructed C —
     never as whole-body substitutes (INCIDENT 2026-08-25).** Small frozen
     fragments remain sanctioned: doc-30 empty `bdnz $` spin windows, short
     register-recycled tails, and mid-function runs that join C labels via
     file-wide numeric labels (`bne 4f`) with real `bl` mnemonics for REL24
     relocs. BUT eleven drafts (AC66C/ACBC0/ACF84/AC9CC/B7C80/B99A8/B9FD0/
     B8678/BA464/ADCE4/B23FC) escalated to transcribing 77–100% of the body
     as `.long`/mnemonic asm — that is the banned ASM_FUNC pattern (§4g):
     objdiff scores it EXACT while nothing is decompiled. ALL ELEVEN WERE
     REFILLED to honest m2c baselines. Hard rules: asm ≤ a small minority of
     instructions, C must carry the semantics, and any draft whose asm share
     exceeds ~30% of the function's instructions is invalid regardless of
     its verdict. Measure before claiming: count `\n\t`-joined asm insns +
     `.long` words vs symbols.txt size/4.
181. **Explicit `asm("mr %0,%1")` where silent wedges get coalesced.** When a
     call result must land in a pinned var via a visible copy, plain
     assignment/barriers let GCC skip the `mr` (assigns straight to the pin);
     an explicit output-input `mr` asm forces it (fn_800FE204 r9-pin case).
182. **`*(s32 *)&lbl_X` vs bare `*(s32 *)lbl_X`:** with `extern char lbl_X[]`,
     the bare form adds a spurious deref level; take the address first
     (fn_80161AC0). Same family as recipe 53's fold rules.
183. **Tooling caveats:** tools/ps_disasm.py can DROP a word mid-stream on
     large PS functions (fn_801BBAE0 @BBD34) — cross-check raw words around
     any suspicious label; and verify size arithmetic from symbols.txt hex
     yourself (0x2BC8 = 11208B). Also: `-fno-schedule-insns` HELPS some PS
     drafts (fn_801B19DC) and HURTS others (fn_801ADCE4 100%→97.8%) — test
     per-function both ways before keeping a FLAG line.
184. **Crashed-session recovery check:** before recreating a "missing" wip

## 76 — learnings (2026-08-23, ring-buffer/trick zone
0x80206F7C–0x8020CD04: 34 EXACT incl. 2 -fno-gcse-flag / 9 PARKED)

178. **Pointer-typed register pins are SILENTLY DROPPED by ProDG cc1**
     (extends §74-161a beyond r0/u8): `register void *p __asm__("r29")`
     compiles as if the pin never existed — and the resulting misallocation
     looks like random "pin corruption". ALWAYS pin an `s32` alias
     (`register s32 a0 __asm__("r29"); a0 = (s32)arg0;`) and cast at deref
     sites. This explains most historical pin-mixing failures.
179. **`-fno-gcse` kills THREE distinct codegen classes** (two EXACT drafts
     are flag-dependent on it): (a) GCSE-PRE induction-variable renaming —
     the "compute i+1/off+4 into fresh registers early + copies at latch"
     pattern is partial redundancy elimination, not scheduling; no source
     shape or schedule flag fixes it; (b) GCSE extending short-lived
     loop-body pointer webs around the back edge into callee-saved homes —
     the root cause of phantom stmw widening; (c) reassociating
     `(base+K)+idx*S` into one shared base+idx register + displacement
     loads — without it, independent per-site `addi rX,rN,K` bases +
     shared scaled-index lwzx come out naturally. Companion lever: hoist
     the loop condition's memory reload into the body (`t = *p; } while
     (i < t);`) — one web live across the back edge kills both GCSE copy
     pseudos AND the LICM hoist.
180. **Guarded-do-while is UNMATCHABLE for duplicated-header loops**
     (minimal-probe proof): GCC 2.95 always re-merges `if(c){do{}while(c);}`
     into a rotated `[b][body][test]` while. Want's
     `[entry-test][preheader][body][latch→body]` shape only comes from a
     goto state-machine web (`if(c==-1) return; again: … ; goto again;`) —
     raw gotos carry no loop notes so rotation can't touch them.
     Corollary: when only ONE path should loop, every other arm needs an
     explicit `return;`.
181. **NEW PARK CLASS — `cmplwi rN,0x3e8;bge` canonicalization wall.**
     Want compares >= 1000 via `cmplwi 0x3e8;bge`; every C predicate form
     (`>= 1000`, `> 999`, unsigned tricks) canonicalizes to
     `cmplwi 0x3e7;bgt` on ALL five ProDG versions. Only ~12 such bge
     sites exist DOL-wide, none promoted — if want shows an 0x3e8 compare,
     don't grind predicates; park fast (fn_80207574/fn_8020773C).
182. **NEW PARK CLASS — indexed-store address-slot permutation**: the
     base/product operand assignment INSIDE `stwx rS,rA,rB` when both
     address operands are non-r0 reload regs is a per-site reload-phase
     tie-break: sites whose product lands in r0 emit base-in-rA; products
     in r9 emit product-in-rA. Resisted named bases (all scopes), int/ptr-
     first sums, barriers, volatile, struct-entry arrays, asm wedges,
     9 flags (fn_80206F7C). Related: x-form store operand order — `p[i]`
     array syntax emits index-first stwx; named scaled index + `(char*)p+i`
     emits base-first.
183. **Result-variable-as-guard-operand extends to non-counter
     accumulators** (§6c-27 family): want's loop guard can compare the
     just-zeroed RESULT accumulator against the count
     (`if (result < count)`); a LOCAL register pin on the constant-zero
     accumulator web works (not just param copies). Related: m2c renders
     guard+fallthrough as flat "||" chains — check which failure edges
     jump INTO the loop guard vs past it to recover the real structure.
184. **Declaration-order allocation steering** — declaring locals in want's
     REGISTER-PRIORITY order (the recycled-chain variable FIRST) fixes
     arg0↔web home swaps with NO pins or flags; decl/birth order is a
     first-class allocator lever. Also: hoisted-const register roles
     follow source order of their defs; minimal pinning beats pin-sets
     (one a0→r28 pin beat an 11-pin set that corrupted allocation).
185. **asm-li birth pins loop-invariant constants into saved regs at exact
     preheader slots**: `__asm__("li %0,1" : "=r"(v));` after the entry
     guard reproduces `li r25,1` where literal stores and "+r" barriers
     fail to hoist. Walker-init-after-entry-guard: write the INDEXED form
     and let ivopts invent the preheader IV init — hand-declared pointers
     land in the guard block instead.
186. **Shared-exit + ternary-placement shapes**: several early returns
     funneled into ONE bottom constant → single textual return at function
     end with forward gotos (labels inside ifs invert to bne+inline);
     explicit-goto early-return wrappers defeat branch inversion; want's
     default-li BETWEEN cmpwi and beq (`[lwz][cmpwi][li r0,0][beq][lwz]`)
     is unreachable in plain C — small volatile asm window with "+b" input
     reproduces it verbatim. Volatile asm-wedge materialization
     (`__asm__ volatile("lis %0,hi\n\tori %0,%0,lo" : "=r"(k))`) pins
     constants that float above conditional branches. Dead-compare switch
     trees reproduce WITHOUT a real switch (genuine empty switch gets
     DCE'd): hand-build the tree as if/else+gotos, route every leaf's
     constant through ONE carrier variable, emit the provably-dead final
     compare as `__asm__("cmpw %0,%1")`. Mega-asm windows may include LIVE
     bl calls captured via `"+f"(pinned_frN)`.
187. **Misc one-liners:** extern float-symbol refs schedule their lis+lfs
     AFTER independent int-arg setup (literal `*(f32 *)0xADDR` hoists
     early, never matches); unnamed shared-subexpr guards — write
     `(base+K)` textually at EVERY use (named temps collapse
     `[addic. rScratch][mr rHome,rScratch][beq]` to direct-home addic.);
     float-typed store of an s32 zero emits the whole xoris/lis-4330 dance
     — keep zero stores s32-typed; trust m2c rlwinm single-bit shifts
     ((v>>k)&1 compiles SH=32−k, NOT 31−k); `-mps-float` controls
     anon-conversion-slot ALIGNMENT (cvt slot 0x38→0x40 + hole); leftover
     temp ≠ argument (dying named temps model want's dead loads); mid-body
     store-run order can be a hard permutation (brute-force all N!).
188. Zone arity truths: fn_80125954(field-value,0) field-pass;
     fn_80209C1C(obj,id,s16,flag) 4-arg; fn_80209E50(obj,entry,flags)
     3-arg; fn_8020989C(void*,s32,s32,s32) 4-arg void; fn_801F0E84 1-arg
     here; fn_800145AC(void)→s32 timestamp getter (its call doubles as a
     memory barrier forcing field reloads); fn_80206F7C(s32,s32)→ptr;
     fn_8009D29C(s32)→s32 handle; fn_80207430(s32,s32,s32)→void;
     fn_80207080/fn_8020740C (s32,s32)→void; fn_8020C604(obj,dst,max)
     3-arg ABI-passthrough into fn_801A99B0; fn_8009F054 4-arg w/ dead f1;

## 6ap — learnings (2026-08-25, skater/list-walk zone
0x8021B9E8–0x8022004C: 16 EXACT / 13 NEAR-parked / 5 DIFF-parked, nothing
promoted)

Baseline 33 DIFF / 1 FAIL → worked as parallel sub-agent groups + direct
work on stragglers (provider outages forced fallback). The usual trio
(hidden arg0 §6e-32, prologue-audited protos §6y-132, chained returns
recipe 23, folded lbl loads recipe 53) cracked the small wrappers; NEW
findings below:

- **6ap-1 Countdown-var RECYCLING blocks CTR conversion AND fuses
  addic. latches** (fn_8021EB8C, 41→67% in one edit): make the fill-loop
  countdown variable THE SAME variable later reused as the outer loop's
  index (`v = nn; do {...} while (--v != 0); ... v = 0; while (v < nn)`).
  Retail recycles one register across both roles; with a shared web ngccc
  emits want's `mr r31,n` copy + fused `addic. r31,-1 / bne` latch. With
  separate vars it converts to `mtctr/bdnz` — and NONE of
  -fno-branch-count-reg / -fno-strength-reduce / -fno-schedule-insns stop
  that here (ProDG cc1 has branch-count-reg; formation ignores it for this
  shape). Extends §6y-141 with a source-shape lever when pins are too
  invasive.
- **6ap-2 Double-GPR pin splits two-web frame addresses** (fn_8021BC54,
  22 diffs → 5): `register T *itv __asm__("r9");` (birth web = want's
  scratch) + `register T *it __asm__("r21");` (home web born at EXPAND time
  via char*-hop + barriers between). Without pins, web-splitting creates
  the home as a late-numbered splitter pseudo → wrong saved reg and every
  hoisted constant shifts one slot. Also: PINNED DEAD LOAD —
  `register s32 mgr __asm__("r3"); mgr = *(s32 *)lbl_X;` with the inline
  expr still at the call site keeps want's global→r3 load alive with zero
  arg-setup. NOTE §73-151 pin+barrier frame corruption did NOT fire here;
  still re-diff whole body after every pin.
- **6ap-3 Opaque symbol-address rebirth needs a REAL asm template**
  (fn_8021D184): plain C refs let GCC join ALL uses of a symbol into one
  saved-reg web (front-end const-prop; `-fno-gcse` does NOT help) when want
  rematerializes per site. Only an actual template is opaque:
  `__asm__ volatile("lis %0,%1@ha\n\taddi %0,%0,%1@l" : "=r"(t) :
  "s"(lbl_X));`. Empty-asm `"=r"` re-birth is NOT opaque (GCC folds through
  it). Companion: page-anchor subtraction — pinned page reg fed by the
  opaque lis template, then `(s32)(page - delta)` reproduces want's
  [hoisted lis][exit addi] split verbatim.
- **6ap-4 Typed-header load + asm-born zero for rotated-loop heads**
  (fn_8021E0E0): when want shows `[fresh-zero li][bound lwz][init stw]`
  after a call and got (a) reuses the counter's zero for the init store or
  (b) sinks the store before the guard load: 1) `__asm__("li %0,0" :
  "=r"(spN));` births an opaque zero (no known-zero reuse); 2) declare the
  walked pointer TYPED (`hdr->count`) instead of char*-cast loads — char*
  loads alias the spN store under TBAA and lock store-before-load order.
- **6ap-5 Cold-path "m" pin = invisible frame widening** (fn_8021C9B8):
  pads referenced ONLY by an empty `__asm__("" : : "m"(padN))` inside a
  rarely-executed branch reserve exact locals bytes while early/trailing
  pins perturb the init-store cluster and volatile pads steal slot +8.
  Companion empirical frame rule (held across this zone):
  locals_end = 8 + 4·nScalar; stmw offset ≈ round_up(locals_end, 8)
  (+4 when LR sits inside the frame) — verify per function.
- **6ap-6 OOB-ness gates base-reg materialization** (sharpens §6x-85):
  in-bounds `s32 arr[5]` + `(char *)&arr[0]+8` folds to displacement
  stores; only OUT-of-bounds arithmetic on a small scalar keeps the
  pointer web (base-addi + displaced stores like want).
- **6ap-7 char*-hop two-web idiom** (group D): type-change hop defeats FRE
  so early uses land on the birth reg and late uses on the copied reg:
  `T *ip=&obj; barrier; cp=(char*)ip; barrier; T *iq=(T*)cp;`. Plain twins
  coalesce; twin-decl-init+barriers splits but INVERTS roles.
- **6ap-8 Callee return-type liveness flips first-call prologue windows**
  (fn_8021DAD4): declaring a strcpy-shaped callee s32-returning instead of
  void made its call result live and flipped the ready-list fill so
  arg-setup `addi`s emit AFTER param-home copies like want — fixed a
  4-word doc-15-class window that resisted barriers/staging/reordering.
  Byte-neutral semantic proto changes remain legitimate scheduling levers
  beyond M8.31/§149.
- **6ap-9 Hash-switch case duplication steers balance_case_nodes**
  (fn_8021DAD4): writing `case K:` out with a DUPLICATE of default's body
  changed node count → pivot moved to want's root, which then reused a
  GCSE-cached cr4 compare as tree root. Extends §6t-6/§70-124 phantom-case
  levers (duplicate-body variant).
- **6ap-10 `(dp++)->v[N]` struct-row post-increment** (fn_8021F120): blocks
  ivopts final-value precompute where standalone `p += K` gets hoisted as
  loop-invariant finals + bottom copies. Related negatives from same fn:
  `__asm__("li %0,K": "=r"(cnt))` opaque counters kill the entry guard but
  ADD final-value precompute; transparent counters do the inverse — only
  post-inc walkers got both right. Mask splitting
  (`m=0xFFFF0000; ... m|=0x7FFF`) places the ori completion mid-store-run.
- **6ap-11 Memory-barrier store→load round-trip** (fn_8021FE30): when the
  original reads back a just-stored stack field (`iter.f4 = list; ...
  bucket = iter.f4->next`) GCC forwards the known value and hoists the
  load above the store; `__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory")` between
  store and readback restores the dependency and ordering at zero code
  cost. Volatile self-init stores survive DSE the same way (recipe 172
  reconfirmed on node inserts).

## 6aq — learnings (2026-08-25, skater-state zone
0x8023F980–0x80243638: 22 EXACT incl. 2 -mps-float / 19 PARKED, nothing
promoted)

Worked as 6 parallel sub-agents off a 39-DIFF/2-NEAR baseline. The usual trio
(hidden args §6e-32, proto audits M8.31, chained returns recipe 23, twin-porting
§6ad-165 — one setter template cracked 6 twins) did most of it. NEW findings:

217. **Post-increment-through-memory AS A CALL ARGUMENT reproduces the
     expand_call copy-before-update window in plain C** (TWO agents converged
     independently: fn_80242EA0 EXACT, fn_802428BC/fn_80240F6C family).
     `fn(mgr, mgr->count++)` emits want's exact `[lwz old][mr rArg][addi][stw]
     [bl]` verbatim — no pins, no barriers. Separate statements double-load or
     reorder; this is the call-arg sibling of §6y-125's post-inc array store.
     Try it FIRST when want shows [load][arg copy][increment][store-back] around
     a bl.
218. **Scaled-offset hoist tell for offset-first addressing (extends §6k-66).**
     When WANT completes `slwi` BEFORE a call, the saved web is a byte-OFFSET
     variable (`off = idx * 4`), not a raw element index: declare `off` as its
     own statement and access via `(char *)(off + (s32)dst)` -> stwx/lwzx with
     off in the rA slot. Companion: declaring base BEFORE off flips anchor/base
     saved-reg roles without pins (setter family, 6 fns EXACT).
219. **-mps-float PS copy locals must be SCALARS.** Struct/array aggregate
     locals fold the address webs away entirely (displacement stores); scalar
     decls + explicit `(__ps_t *)((char *)&sp + OFF)` casts keep want's per-arm
     addi/mr webs (16-byte struct copy, fn_802415C4 EXACT). Related TBAA hazard:
     f32 scalar stores consumed ONLY through __ps_t pun-reads get DCE'd under
     -mps-float — keep them alive in displacement form with a zero-code `"m"`
     asm pin.
220. **`"+r"` barrier as a COLORING lever, not just ordering** (fn_802432E8):
     barrier'ing a saved-copy temp makes its web opaque so GCC colors it into
     scratch r0 (want's `mr r0` / `or. r3,r0,r0`) instead of merging it into the
     adjacent walker register.
221. **Negative result refining §6al-180:** volatile-scalar per-site remat does
     NOT extend to struct addresses — fn_802413C0 needed dual hard-reg pins plus
     binding the store pointer before the arg copy instead.
222. **Guarded-do head test may use the NON-IV accumulator** (fn_802431F0):
     `if (count < field) { do {...} while (j-test); }` with the induction check
     only at the latch — widens §6af-171's guarded-do family. And reconfirming
     §6ad-138: REMOVE a stale FLAG line the moment the draft is exact flagless.
223. **QB-hash decode trap instance — header was RIGHT, agent was wrong**
     (§6o-102 hazard-in-reverse, now with verification protocol): an agent
     misdecoded want's `lis -0x509e` page as 0xAF61 and concluded
     qb_constants.h QB_RESET (0xAF6240B2) was misapplied. Verified against BOTH
     the raw pair (`lis -0x509e`=page 0xAF62 + `ori 0x40b2`) AND the game hash
     table via tools/qb_hash.py ("Reset" -> 0xAF6240B2): header correct, draft
     fixed. Protocol: negative lis immediates decode as `(imm & 0xFFFF)`, i.e.
     ADD 0x10000; when a draft literal disagrees with a QB_ macro, verify both
     halves against the DOL before trusting either. A batch-wide lis/ori-half
     audit of all 41 drafts found this one error.

## 6ar — learnings (2026-08-25, Script*-command zone
0x80222660–0x802273FC: 36 EXACT incl. 1 -mps-float+flag / 13 PARKED, nothing promoted)

Baseline 49×DIFF (mostly SIZE-MM statics-DCE husks) → 36 EXACT via 5 parallel
sub-agents. The §6w-97 template + proto audits + frame-template rebuilds
cracked most; new findings:

222. **QB_* macros can diverge from bare literals under hard-reg pin
     contexts.** fn_80225E70's hash site only matched with the BARE
     `0xAF86421B` literal — the `QB_CROWN` macro form (same value!) produced
     different codegen once register pins/reassignment were present. Hazard:
     a future `apply_qb_constants.py` sweep can BREAK previously-matching
     drafts. If a hash site resists everything else, try swapping the macro
     back to the bare literal before blaming scheduling. Extends §6o-102
     (verify constants) with a codegen-divergence caveat, and §6ae-63's
     "hash literals stay bare" rule.
223. **`-fno-gcse` DOES stop LICM homing of escaped `&spN` addresses**
     (second confirmation, fn_80225E70 + fn_80224BB4 attempts). Refines
     §73-155's negative ("does not stop speculative-LICM"): that holds for
     conditional-loop invariant BASES, but escaped out-param ADDRESSES are
     GCSE/LICM-homed and the flag breaks it. Add `-fno-gcse` to the ladder
     when want recomputes `&spN` per site.
224. **Operand-swapped latch kills the post-increment temp**: writing the
     loop latch as `0x31 != idx++` (constant on the LEFT) instead of
     `idx++ != 0x31` suppresses the post-inc `mr` temp entirely
     (fn_80225E70). Same family as §6y-125 but for countdown latches.
225. **Early-clobber `"=&r"` addi wedge** fixes dec-path dest registers the
     same way §6al-183's mr wedge fixes homing copies — any single-insn
     arithmetic wedge with `&` works where plain C coalesces
     (fn_80224968/fn_80225E70).
226. **`(one << (s8)i)` forces extsb on the SHIFT COUNT only** — casting
     the shift amount to s8 emits want's extsb-before-slw without widening
     anything else (fn_80222930 EXACT). Micro-tell: want extsb feeding slw.
227. **PROCESS: baselines go stale under concurrent multi-batch work.**
     Six drafts whose baseline read 17–30%/SIZE-MM were already byte-exact
     when the sub-agents re-scored (concurrent commits swept fixes in; one
     agent's /tmp addr file was also clobbered by another agent). Always
     RE-SCORE before editing, and namespace your /tmp files
     (`/tmp/opencode/<batch><group>_...`), never shared names like
     `batchNN_addrs.txt`.

## 6as — learnings (2026-08-25, PS/skater-state zone
0x8022EF68–0x80233BB8: 32 EXACT incl. 3 -mps-float / 11 parked incl. 1
EXACT-masked-doc14)

Baseline 0 EXACT / 3 NEAR / 39 DIFF → 7 dispatch waves (two provider outages

- **§6as-1 Cast-expander DEAD-COPY TRIO (doc-14 advance).** On int→float
  conversion sites, letting ngccc synthesize `(f32)(f64)(s32)v` spawns — in
  addition to the private .rodata pool — a trio of dead copies
  `[mr r8,r10][mr r7,r10][mr r5,r10]` that want also carries. Empirical rule:
  ≥2 synthesized casts spawn the trio; a single cast does NOT. Consequence:
  the promotable manual §6j-1 dance (empty .rodata) can reach text-match but
  LOSES the trio; asm-mr wedges recover order but not homes. fn_802327E0 is
  now masked-EXACT .text 152/152 on this route (was 97% stale draft). See
  doc-14 update. Before choosing synthesized vs manual on any site, count
  want's dead-copy trio words.
- **§6as-2 PS pair copies INSIDE argument lists**: pass pair stores as comma
  expressions in the call args — `(sp8[0] = a, sp8[1] = b, sp8)` — the
  scheduler then interleaves psq_st with arg setup exactly like want
  (fn_8022F434 EXACT under -mps-float). Extends §6z-128 from scalar spills
  to PS pair stores.
- **§6as-3 CR-cache via LOGICAL NESTING**: an outer `next != 0 || x < 0`
  with inner `next == 0 && x < 0` reproduces want's `[cmpwi cr7][bne cr7]`
  cached-compare reuse verbatim — no asm needed (fn_8022F5B0 EXACT). Third
  plain-C shape for doc-28-family CR machinery (after §6t-2 memory-backed
  flag and §6ak-179 split counters).
- **§6as-4 Wedge + DUAL-PIN for IV/latch splits**: when the latch re-homes a
  web (`[addi r0][mr r4,r0][stw r0]`), neither lever alone works — pin alone
  fuses the webs, wedge alone picks the wrong scratch. Combine an explicit
  `__asm__("mr %0,%1" : "=r"(dst) : "r"(src))` wedge WITH two disjoint-range
  register pins (`register s32 iv __asm__("r4")` alongside the other web's
  pin) (fn_8022F5B0 EXACT).
- **§6ag-9 expansion — bool-return decode idiom**: on cmpw+mfcr boolean
  returns, rlwinm shift field encodes the comparison: sh=0x1e ⇒ `>`,
  sh=0x1d ⇒ `<`. Flip the C comparison polarity instead of grinding masks
  (fn_802339F8/fn_80230990 EXACT via `<` flip).
- **§6as-5 OLD-STYLE protos on 0-arg global getters preserve raw r3 at every
  bl**: declare `s32 fn_X();` (no param list) for getter callees whose result
  is dereferenced inline — new-style arity-matched protos inject arg-register
  setup. Pairs with dead-arg calls to force per-use reloads
  (fn_80232D14/fn_80232DFC EXACT).
- **§6as-6 "=&r" early-clobber constraint wedge**: `__asm__("mr %0,%1" :
  "=&r"(end) : "r"(src))` reproduced want's scratch-r0 → mr-r10 re-home where
  plain "=r" got scheduled differently (fn_80230A68 EXACT). Reach for "=&r"
  when the wedge output must not share a reg with any input.
- **§6aj-1 extension — ONE pinned var recycled across ROLES**: assigning the
  same pinned variable successive roles (arg0-home → base web) keeps a single
  hard reg across role changes like want's recycling
  (fn_802336D8/fn_8022F840, §70-162 family).
- **§6an-3 PS-context instance**: named staged webs + `register s32 acc
  __asm__("r5")` forced want's slwi→psq_l→add→addi→disp-store shape and

## 6au — learnings (2026-08-26, texture-decode/allocator zone
0x80243788–0x8024C5E8: 19 EXACT incl. sdata-route link-exacts / 23 PARKED)

Two NEW parking docs: **doc 37** (inline-expanded memset doloops — ~27 DOL
sites, proven unreachable from plain C on all five ProDG versions; freeze via
short asm, `bdnz+` hint bit when WANT's BO=17 is set) and **doc 38**
(call-crossed-param homing residue — no-call fn wants callee-saved home WITH
save; every pin/clobber emits the home without the save). New tools entry:
`tools/sda_verify.py` (promote-grade SDA21-aware verify for §5q drafts).

189. **Subfic/adde bool feeding an INDEXED LOAD needs three-statement
     staging**: inline `*(p + K + ((flags==0)*4))` gets if-converted into a
     branchy address select in every spelling. The matching form:
     `s32 sel = (flags == 0);` (value-context bool FIRST) →
     `s32 *e = (s32 *)(slot + 0x14);` (entry pointer) → `if (e[sel] ...)`
     (element index) — reproduces `[subfic][adde][addi][slwi][lwzx]`.
     Reconfirms only `== 0` folds. Unsigned variant: `(idx <= 3)`
     materialized on a u32 also folds.
190. **`"=r"` re-birth wedge blocks if-conversion** of `ptr[(x == 0)]`
     adjacent-offset selects ("+r" identity barriers do NOT): 
     `__asm__("" : "=r"(b) : "r"(x == 0))` keeps the subfic/adde idiom while
     making the index web opaque. Creation-order steering extends to "=r"
     outputs: an `"=&r"` wedge placed textually before the sibling load puts
     its product in r0 vs r11 at zero cost; a "+r" barrier BETWEEN two
     independent defs sequences their loads/subfic emission-free.
191. **Goto webs whose TEXTUAL ORDER matches want's physical layout force
     out-of-line-before-latch arm placement** — but EVERY exit must reach
     the shared tail or DCE silently eats initializers (a missing path
     dropped an `lfs f0` without any error). Also fixes GCSE address-split
     copies (`mr r8,r31`) that ~30 loop shapes + -fno-gcse could not.
192. **f32-returning protos are load-bearing in float zones**: an implicit-
     int proto for a float-returning callee produced the whole xoris/4330
     dance; declaring `f32 fn_X(s32,s32)` deleted it. Mixed-ABI param
     DECLARATION ORDER drives prologue save order — `(void*,void*,f32,s32)`
     with the float declared before the last int reproduces want's early
     `fmr f31,f1`.
193. **Phantom LOW-side empty case** (`case -0x40000000: break;` BELOW the
     real range) steers switch-tree pivots — want's {1,2,3} right-linear
     chain + `blelr` default-return reuse came from this; extends §70-124's
     high-side phantom to the low side.
194. **`-fno-schedule-insns` ⇒ independent stores emit in EXACT source
     order** (rotation is a scheduler artifact) — matched lever pair:
     without it clean runs rotate right-by-one, so pair the flag WITH
     rotate-left source order. A non-volatile `"+r"` barrier immediately
     BEFORE a call flips doc-15 li/mr arg-setup transpositions at that site
     but RE-ENABLES store rotation — the two levers compose, not substitute.
195. **extsb lever**: plain C never emits `[extsb][stb]`; an asm-INPUT use of
     an s8 temp (`s8 b = v; __asm__ volatile("" :: "r"(b)); *p = b;`)
     forces it verbatim. Double-extsb byte-modify needs an s8 named temp
     assigned as a separate statement (volatile lvalue does NOT work).
196. **volatile on a message/object POINTER blocks address-CSE across
     calls** → fresh `addi r3/r4` per call site (matches promoted twins);
     non-volatile merges one early-born saved-reg web — that merge is the
     wall behind several parks where WANT re-births `&spN` at call #1 and
     rematerializes fresh at call #2 (no source spelling splits them).
     Related: two DISTINCT uses of the same offset (`arg0+0x48` pre-loop vs
     block-inline) must stay two webs — merging them shifts everything.
197. **Opaque cross-call counter web restores CR machinery**: a local
     assigned BEFORE a dispatch and consumed ONLY as an asm input stays
     unfolded in a callee-saved reg — alone reproduced want's mfcr/CR-save
     prologue + hoisted `cmpwi cr4,arg1` (+157 words in one edit). And the
     third boolean-layout polarity: `if (best != K) return best; return 0;`
     reproduces `[mr r3,r30][cmpwi r30][bne skip][li r3,0]` — the var-copy
     form tests the COPY register, not r3 (ternary fails).
198. **SDA-zone template (texture-decode/allocator zone)**: `.sdata`
     globals/fn-ptr tables (`lbl_803CA320/24/28/30/33/38`) → `extern s32
     lbl_X;` refs + per-object `-msdata=eabi -G4`; standalone sweeps show
     NEAR/DIFF only on type-109 SDA21 words (gen_leaves doesn't mask them)
     — verify with `tools/sda_verify.py 0xADDR src/wip/fn_X.c` (prints
     LINK-SIM EXACT); bss objects above the G-threshold keep absolute
     lis+addi form. Call-site truths: arg-ignoring callees still need the
     CALL-SITE arity prototyped to reproduce dead field loads without crclr
     (fn_8024EA74 4-arg site); alloc fn-ptr args arrive via leftover-r3
     passthrough of the just-loaded table value.
199. Misc one-liners: volatile scalars cost an 8-byte stack slot EACH in
     ngccc (use `"m"`-pinned same-size pads for fine-grained frames);
     packed-struct member access does NOT fold displacements (base computed
     in reg); int→float dances referencing REAL .data/.rodata2 constants
     are the promotable form (no pool synthesized — §6j-1 refined); plain
     casts match when want shows anonymous cvt slots + hoisted magic;
     per-phase web SPLITS of shared loop counters/item vars were worth +70%
     in one scalar rebuild (don't share counter webs across phases).

### 6au addendum (stragglers)

200. **Offset-first addition extends to stwx** (§6k-66 completion): both
     lwzx AND stwx take the offset IV in the rA slot via
     `(char *)(off + (s32)p)`; dual address webs (read-copy vs write-base
     from one addi+mr) need an s32-alias pin on the reader web.
201. **Before adding volatile-double dummies, check for a natural
     saved-GPR web** (refines recipe 63): fn_80245410's +8 FPR headroom
     came from `&sp8` legitimately claiming a 7th saved GPR (r30) — no
     dummy needed. Compute expected frame from saved-GPR count first.
202. **Per-site store-FORM control via "+r" birth barrier**: placing
     `__asm__("" : "+r"(spp))` right after an array-address birth blocks
     copy-prop so store #2 keeps pointer-form `psq_st 8(r30)` while store
     #0 folds to displacement — mixed displacement/pointer-form stores at
     one site are selectable this way. Similarly, a frame-template struct
     with a VOLATILE MEMBER reproduces param-home spills at exact slots
     (volatile member = forced memory residency inside the template).
203. **WORKFLOW HAZARD (multi-agent sessions): mid-edit sweep-up + revert.**
     A concurrent agent's periodic "up" commit can sweep up your HALF-EDITED
     draft; a later `git checkout`/revert then silently rolls back YOUR
     fixes while verdicts look plausible. This has bitten before.
     Rules: never `git checkout` src/wip paths you don't own; re-run the
     per-address sweep whenever a verdict shifts unexpectedly after a
     quiet period; diff your file against HEAD before declaring a verdict.
204. **PS-draft measurement gap**: test_wip_drafts.py and flagdiff apply no
     psq-aware masking and ignore `-mps-float` in FLAG lines — NEAR/DIFF
     percentages on PS drafts are unreliable. Measure with
     `tools/ps_diff.py`, or for SDA-zone drafts `tools/sda_verify.py`
     (LINK-SIM EXACT), before parking or promoting.

     Status, C_MTXFrustum, GQR setters…), port from tp/tww or libs/dolphin,
     verify under `build/compilers/GC/1.2.5n/mwcceppc.exe` + cflags_dolphin.
     Cracked/parked this way: fn_80261BE0 = VIGetDTVStatus byte-exact via
     existing libs/dolphin vi.c (needs symbols.txt rename + vi split ext to
     promote), fn_8025E774 = C_MTXFrustum (doc 39 updated — park confirmed,
     2 commutative fmuls swaps mwcc canonicalizes against every spelling;
     `__REGISTER f32 x = expr;` ICEs mwcc), fn_80269EC0/E98 GQR setters
     (best mwcc −O3 = 3 word diffs).
206. **ProDG NEVER performs sibling-call optimization — linker branch
     islands are not compilable C.** The five 4-byte `b <target>` stubs at
     0x8025CFFC..D00C are mwld LINK-TIME artifacts (docs/dolphin-sdk.md
     §8.13): typed (`u64 f(u64,s32){return g(...)}`) and void(void) tail
     calls both emit full bl+lr-save frames in every ProDG version;
     `__attribute__((noreturn))` and `(naked)` are silently IGNORED by ngccc
     (verified). Only byte-exact reproduction: one top-level
     `__asm__(".globl name\n.type name,@function\nname:\n b target")`.
     Relocation-masked compares pass; symbol resolves at link. All five
     EXACT (single-insn asm islands — disclosed in headers; these functions
     have no logic to decompile).
207. **NaN polarity from cror+bso fp-branches**: want
     `cror cr0un,cr0eq,cr0gt; bso Lslow` merges eq|gt into SO, so UNORDERED
     falls through to the inline block — the source test is `>=` with the
     slow body OUT-OF-LINE as the then-block (`if (f >= K) {slow} return
     (s32)f;`). Writing `<` flips NaN semantics AND block order (cracked
     __cvt_fp2unsigned fn_8025CFB4). Extends §6r-95/§6ai-156 to the
     branchy float-range-check family.
208. **@l folding wall for double constants**: references to an extern
     double (plain var OR array-decay) compile `lis @ha; lfd @l(r9)`; raw
     pointer literals give lis+ori. Want's `lis+addi(@l)+lfd 0(reg)` is
     unreachable in pure C — force it with the §6ah-181 anchor wedge: pinned
     r9 built by volatile asm `lis/addi`, constant fed onward as a pinned-FPR
     `"=f"` asm output (fn_8025CFB4; downstream compare/subtract/fctiwz-f13
     scheduling then reproduces naturally).
209. **File-scope global register var = save-free access to caller-carried
     registers**: `register s32 *ctx __asm__("r31");` at FILE scope emits bare
     `lwz/stw off(r31)` with zero prologue — READ-only uses are safe;
     assignment through it forces preservation code. Cracked fn_8025AF7C
     (prologue-free ctx reads). Positive technique version of §74-161a.
210. **Volatile `"=r"` li-birth wedges pin emission position** — non-volatile
     `"=r"` wedges still get scheduled early; `__asm__ volatile("li %0,0" :
     "=r"(z))` holds the li exactly where want has it (fn_8025ABB0: zero
     kept out of a lis/ori address pair). Refines §6y-130/§70-145.
211. **Two-phase asm-consumed dead values** reproduce `[load][andi.][li 0]`
     dead-op sequences no single C expression survives as: compute into a web
     consumed by an input-only barrier, second barrier consumes the overwrite
     value (fn_8025ABEC MMIO status read; extends recipe 77/§6x-89).
212. **Return-web register pins suppress zero_extract** (doc-22 strcasecmp
     SOLVED by this): when want ends in a "redundant" `clrlwi r3,r7,0x18`,
     DROP any pin on the return web — the hard-reg pin forces copy instead of
     mask, and a plain local emits the clrlwi naturally. Try pin removal
     before asm wedges.
213. **mflr caller-address args need literal asm** — `__builtin_return_
     address(0)` compiles to a frame-chain read, NOT mflr; use
     `__asm__("mflr %0" : "=r"(ra))` (fn_8026AA2C OSPanic assert; leave the
     panic callee unprototyped to keep want's crclr).
214. **Named-const-init + volatile `"+r"` barrier orders const-vs-load
     emission** (fn_8026AA08 LCG step: proven `lwz %0,-0x7e60(13)` r13-wedge
     + volatile barrier after the 0x41C64E6D init forces const-materialization
     before the field load).
215. **Param-reassignment pins counters into incoming arg regs** — reassigning
     the PARAMETER (`arg1--`) keeps the counter web in r4 → want's `or.
     r4,r4,r4` entry test + fused `addic.` latch (fn_8026B5B8 digit odometer);
     extends recipe 88 to counter webs.
216. **Small-data extern typing matters under `-msdata=eabi -G4`**: unsized
     array decls (`extern char lbl_X[]`) never go small-data; a SIZED scalar
     decl (`extern s32 lbl_X;`) emits the folded `lwz disp(r13)`. SDA21 reloc
     (type 109) needs mask 0xFFE00000 — gen_leaves/diff_near don't mask it,
     so sdata drafts sweep false-DIFF/NEAR; verify with tools/sda_verify.py
     (§204) and register manually like fn_80252C3C (vprintf fn_8026A024 is
     EXACT this way, awaiting manual registration).
217. **mfspr decode trap**: SPR field is `(w>>11&0x1F)<<5 | (w>>16&0x1F)`
     (value-bit order, easy to flip) — matters when hand-decoding GQR/HID
     setters; capstone also stalls/mislabels psq_l(56)/psq_st(60)/mfsr words.

## 6aw — learnings (2026-08-26, pool/bitstream zone
0x80250E6C–0x80256A54: 18 EXACT-in-wip / 25 PARKED, nothing promoted)

Baseline 42 DIFF / 1 NEAR → 18 EXACT via parallel sub-agents. Two
zone-level discoveries plus several recipe refinements:

173. **r13-SDA globals: inline-asm read is the ONLY verifiable form**
     (cracked 8+ functions this batch). Want reads the heap global as
     `lwz r3,-0x7f40(r13)` (lbl_803CA340, .sdata). Plain extern gives
     lis+addi+lwz (wrong); registering the object with `-msdata=eabi -G4`
     gives the right form but the standalone SDA21 object encodes rA=0 so
     compile_fn's masked compare can NEVER pass (the §5q limitation).
     SOLUTION: `__asm__("lwz %0, -0x7f40(13)" : "=r"(t));` at each use
     site — inline asm carries NO relocation so sweeps/promote verify it.
     Use the VOLATILE form when a non-volatile read sinks below an arg
     move. Same pattern generalizes to any r13/r2-relative global.
174. **lim-variable anti-fold = doc-34 counter-lever** (fn_80250E6C):
     naming the bound as a local (`s32 lim = 0x20; if (total < lim)`)
     BLOCKS GCC's immediate-LT→(K−1)+ble canonicalization and keeps raw
     K — works on SIGNED immediate LT too (doc-34 recorded unsigned only;
     its "no C spelling survives" claim needs this refinement). Try the
     lim-variable on ANY want `cmpwi/cmplwi K;blt/bge` BEFORE parking.
175. **Empty-template wedges get renamed away**: `"=r"(x)` asm with no
     input emits nothing; explicit `"mr %0,%1" : "=r"(out) : "r"(in)`
     with an artificial dependence emits a REAL undeletable copy
     (refines §70-145/§73-183; fn_80250EAC/53D10/EC64 precedents).
176. **Unsigned 3-way comparator idiom** (fn_80255FF4 EXACT):
     `return (a > b) - (a < b);` shares ONE cmplw and emits want's
     mfcr GT/LT-bit extraction pair verbatim — brute-forced 8 forms,
     single-expression folds die to arithmetic chains, only this shape
     keeps both extractions.
177. **NEW ZONE WALL — cr1-call-preserved + individual-save prologue**
     (fn_802511DC/50F2C family, 11 DOL sites all unmatched): want
     prologue `[stwu][stw rHigh,8 first][individual saves r14..r26]
     [mflr r27]` (zero matched exemplars DOL-wide) and the game treats
     cr1 as CALL-PRESERVED across bl (compare cached before one bl,
     consumed after another without CR save) — cc1 always moves it to
     saved-CR + mfcr/mtcrf. See docs/parkings/35.
178. **Split-function pairs are not matchable standalone** (A88/B70):
     caller half passes state in callee-saved regs across two bls of the
     continuation fragment which has NO prologue and reads preset regs —
     decompile the pair as one unit or park both citing this.
179. Misc: literal `ps_merge10 %0,%0,18` pins PS asm's hidden fr-register
     field, but an UNINITIALIZED callee-saved FPR input (fr18 in
     fn_80254CEC) is likely split-origin — don't chase register-var pins
     that force saves; `__builtin_alloca` (NOT plain VLA, which fuses a
     wrong rlwinm mask) reproduces dynamic `stwux` stack allocas
     (fn_80256458); two such dynamic allocas in fn_802556C4's husk are a
     likely new-wall candidate; want-extra-dead-insn §6x-89 reconfirmed
     (fn_80255E34: arg-slot r7 staged from entry-r8 while r6 does the
     dance lis — any prototyped call consuming r7 must consume r4-r6 too).

225. **File-scope ctx register var is ASSIGNMENT-capable** (extends
     §6av-209's read-only note): `register s32 ctx __asm__("r31")` with
