## 6ay — learnings (2026-08-26, heap/allocator + texture-upload
zone 0x8024C624–0x80250E24: 16 EXACT incl. 2 flag / 2 EXACT-masked-msdata / 30
PARKED incl. a whole hand-asm module, nothing promoted)

Baseline 47 DIFF + 1 stub → worked as 8 parallel sub-agents. Headline: the
~0x8024EF18–0x80250E6C region is HAND-WRITTEN ASSEMBLY (NeGo texture-upload
kernels) — five probe-proven fingerprints catalogued in the NEW parking doc 36;
park on sight. Matchable findings below.

227. **FILE-scope register vars = save-free temp homes for prologue-less
     fragments** (cracked fn_8024F5C0 39/39): LOCAL `register s32 x
     __asm__("rN")` pins force an stwu+stmw save/restore prologue; the SAME
     pins at FILE scope steer allocation identically but emit ZERO prologue.
     On PARAM registers they also force IN-PLACE param mutation
     (`g_a2 <<= 4` -> `slwi r5,r5,4`) where local pinned aliases split the web
     through r0 (fn_8024FD90). Extends §6av-209 to full temp-home control.
228. **FLAG PAIR `-fno-schedule-insns -fno-schedule-insns2` =
     "emission follows source order" for straight-line integer leaves.**
     When want's stream mirrors an obvious statement order but every
     independent-insn pair lands swapped — and commas, "+r"/memory barriers,
     per-site reorders all resist — run BOTH sched flags off; single flags
     each still reordered ~2 sites, the pair cracked 4 at once (fn_8024FD90).
229. **Non-volatile r13 asm + `-fno-schedule-insns` = schedulable SDA reads
     without msdata flags**: `__asm__("lwz %0,-0xN(13)" : "=r"(v))` floats
     above entry param-home copies exactly like want's real global loads;
     VOLATILE asm blocks that interleave. msdata route (`-msdata=eabi -G4`)
     caps at NEAR anyway — compile_fn's mask table lacks R_PPC_EMB_SDA21.
     Probing data: msdata emits SDA21 for plain `extern s32` reads but NOT
     fn-ptr derefs through `extern char[]`; SDA-fnptr calls need the load
     INSIDE the call expression or prologue homes preempt it (fn_8024EE00/
     EE6C are byte-exact under msdata except their one SDA21 word — promote
     via §5q manual registration, twin src/fn_80252C3C.c).
230. **s64 struct copy between pointers forces grouped [lwz][lwz][stw][stw]**
     where two-statement field copies get scheduler-scattered (fn_8024E114).
231. **Operand-order flip steers load order ONLY with a third independent
     chain between**: writing `*(u16*)arg2 + *(u16*)arg0` (b-first) emitted
     want's [a->r0][mulli][b->r9] interleave because the mulli sat between;
     without an intermediate chain the order is invariant. Companion: keep a
     raw sum UNCLOSED and cast only at first use (`(s16)s * arg4`) to get
     want's [sth raw][extsh->mul] two-web shape — cast-at-declaration merges
     webs (fn_8024DB0C).
232. **Exclusive-range multi-pin sets across if/else arms generalize the
     dual-pin trick**: disjoint arms can pin different webs to overlapping
     registers (dp->r8/sp->r10 in arms 1-2, d3p->r10/s3p->r11/i3->r9 in arm
     3); cracked all three loops' divergent maps at once (fn_8024DB0C;
     extends §6ad-166). Same mechanism opposite direction: two exclusive-path
     tables pinned r29/r30 made offset webs recycle each other's registers
     (fn_8024D2C8).
233. **Genuine `switch` on a u32 param reproduces want's compare-tree
     lowering where if-chains tree-ify differently** (+70% on fn_8024E2C8 in
     one edit). NEGATIVE documented: pre-switch `rc = row;` def does NOT
     block gcse merging the per-arm copies (fn_8024DD84 park).
234. **Shared-return `if ((a==K) || (ret==0)) return ret;` blocks guard
     constant-propagation** where separate if-guards let GCC materialize the
     known value (`li r3,0`) instead of want's shared `mr` block (fn_8024D61C).
235. **Input-only `"r"` barrier on an unscaled index forces `slwi` to copy
     into r0** instead of scaling in-place in the call-result register —
     frees r3 for the next call's field load, fixing operand reg AND
     load/deref order at once (fn_8024D418).
236. **Hand-written-asm fingerprints — MOSTLY DEMOTED 2026-10-03. DO NOT park on
     sight; several were false. Re-probed on ngccc 3.9.3 AND mwcc GC/1.3.2 + 1.2.5n.**
     Full writeup + THE WORKING RECIPE: `docs/parkings/41`.
     * (a) `mfctr rX`/`mtctr rX; blr` CTR save-pair — **DEMOTED, NOT A WALL:** 306
       sites inside **226 already-matched functions** (`fn_8001F738` has 11). Never
       use this alone as a park trigger.
     * (b) individual interleaved `stw` saves + LR-in-register dance (`mflr r15/r18`
       across bls) — **STRONGEST SURVIVING SIGNAL.** Even exactly 2 saved regs
       yields `stmw`, and ALL THREE compilers always save LR as `mflr r0`+`stw r0`,
       never into a callee-save. 66 such sites in all of `.text`, only 2 inside a
       matched fn (`fn_8025AFC0`, `fn_8025B180`).
     * (c) D-form psq_l/psq_st with I!=0 — **SOLVED, see recipe 239 below.** The
       "cc1 hardcodes I=0 / GQR unreachable" claim was WRONG.
     * (d) non-ABI fixed-reg interfaces (args in r11/r12/r15, float arg out-of-band
       in f8) — **NOT A WALL:** file-scope `register s32 x __asm__("r11")` pins
       reach them from C.
     * (e) ABI-conformance saves of never-used callee-saved regs — real but tiny
       (`fn_8024F4B0` is 3% asm); attempt it, don't park it.
     Screens: D-form psq I!=0 = **678** sites, `0x8024EFBC`–`0x80253B2C`, but you
     MUST count per opcode: `psq_l`(op 56)=400 in ONE cluster 0x8024EFBC–0x80250834;
     `psq_st`(op 60)=278 in TWO — 0x8024F0A0–0x80250854 (272) **plus an outlier at
     0x802538CC–0x80253B2C (6, fn_80253694)**. An op-56-only scan wrongly reports
     "one cluster" and misses the outlier. I=0 is 18,293 sites, 204 in matched fns.
     A bare GQR SPR 912–919 hit is NOT sufficient evidence — that traffic recurs in
     0x8012/0x8014/0x8024/0x8025/0x8026. Region boundary is 0x8024EF18–0x80250834,
     NOT the old 0x80250E6C claim.
237. **psq field-layout CORRECTION for hand-decoding:** true layout is
     `OPCD|D|rA|W(1b)|I(3b)|d(12b)` with I = `(w>>12)&7` — tools/ps_disasm.py
     printed a wrong I field (I=14-style readings); re-decode raw words with
     this layout before trusting "qr3"-style labels. GQR-census scan: sweep
     `.text` for mtspr/mfspr SPR 912–919 (`((w>>11)&31)<<5|((w>>16)&31)`) to
     map which quantization channels a region uses. Also another capstone
     mislabel: opcode-4 xo10=21 (ps_add) prints as `vsel`.
240. **GQR `psq` with I!=0 IS reachable — the "hardcoded I=0" wall was FALSE.**
     `include/dolphin/SN_PS.h` already wraps the cc1 builtins with an explicit I
     argument: `ps_l(v,w,i)`=`__builtin_psq_l`, `ps_st(d,v,w,i)`=`__builtin_psq_st`
     (also `ps_lu`/`ps_lx`/`ps_lux`/`ps_stu`/`ps_stx`/`ps_stux`). cc1's `psq_l`
     template is `psq_l %U1%X1 %0,0(%1),%2,%3` — it keeps your I but **hardcodes a
     0 displacement**; the plain `__ps_t` deref path is the only one that folds a
     displacement and it **hardcodes I=0**. So for a wanted `psq_l fN,d(rX),0,I7`
     with `d!=0`, take each half from a different path:
     ```c
     p0 = __builtin_psq_l((void *)(S), 0, 7);      /* d=0  -> builtin keeps I=7 */
     __asm__ volatile("psq_l 1,4(%0),0,7\n\t"        /* d!=0 -> raw asm keeps d   */
                      "psq_l 2,8(%0),0,7\n\t"
                      "psq_l 3,12(%0),0,7"
                      : : "r"((s32)(S)) : "fr1", "fr2", "fr3");
     ```
     **Stores need NO asm** — `__builtin_psq_st((void*)(D+2), p1, 0, 7)` emits the
     displaced I=7 store directly. Pin the PS regs with `register sn_ps p0
     __asm__("fr0")` (a declaration, emits 0 insns) and take caller-preset regs via
     file-scope `register s32 f_src __asm__("r6")`. `__builtin_psq_lux` ICEs in cc1

## 6az — learnings (2026-08-26, network/lobby Script* zone
0x8022755C–0x8022B5D0: 37 EXACT incl. 1 flag / 9 parked, nothing promoted)

Baseline 44 DIFF / 1 NEAR / 1 FAIL → 37 EXACT via 7 sub-agent groups + direct
work on fn_80229404. The §6w-97 template + proto audits cracked most; new items:

239. **SOLUTION to the §6ak-159 unsigned-immediate-LT wall — volatile-asm
     branch windows with numeric labels.** fn_80229928 EXACT: raw
     `cmplwi rX,K; blt` sites that C cannot emit (simplify_comparison folds
     every spelling) reproduce verbatim from a volatile-asm window:
     `__asm__ volatile("cmplwi %0, K\n\tblt 8f" :: "r"(v) ...)` + file-wide
     numeric label `8:` glued before the shared target block. Displacements
     are reloc-masked in sweeps; promote needs the label present in the same
     TU (header note added). RETRY UNPARKED: fn_80216F10 (parked 96.1% on
     exactly this wall) and elapsed-family members 0x80228A40 / 0x8022B550.
240. **Dead stores survive via raw `li/stw` asm pairs + `"m"`-pinned slot
     local** (fn_80229928's sp8=1): when even `volatile s32` ordering fails,
     write the store as literal asm with the stack slot pinned through an
     "m" operand so allocation keeps its address.
241. **Pin-to-ARG-register blocks emit want's exact arg-move interleave**
     (fn_8022A510): pinning values into ARG regs (r3-r7) makes each
     lis/ori/mr/li emit manually in want's order — cracks doc-15 windows
     where expand_call batching resists statement reordering. Extends
     §6p-111/§6an-3.
242. **Identity-pin keeps the caller's own arg live at bl without an
     equality-CSE copy** (fn_8022A8E8): callee genuinely 1-arg but want
     holds caller arg1 in r4 at the call — `register s32 a1
     __asm__("r4"); a1 = arg1;` emits no mr and blocks the fold. Also
     fn_8022B1B0 (ScriptNumServersInLobby): hidden arg0 whose prologue reads
     ONLY r4 → declare 2-param signature, count rides r5 as live third arg.
243. **Duplicating the final call into BOTH if-arms lets crossjump merge
     per-path staging** (fn_8022A04C): want shares one call+tail; writing
     the call in each arm lets GCC crossjump-build the merge itself while
     per-path arg staging survives — flip side of §6u-1 (which breaks
     unwanted merges with explicit exit labels).
244. **asm-born `li` blocks known-zero propagation** (fn_80229BAC): when GCC
     propagates a constant zero into what retail kept as a real register
     fill (`mr rN,rM`), writing the li inside asm forces the instruction;
     combine with accumulator tails for [li r3,K][bnelr][li r3,-1] shapes.
245. **Pointer pins are dropped by cc1 — alias pointer homes as s32**
     (fn_8022ACE0): `register void *p __asm__("r28")` silently loses the
     home; `register s32 p_s __asm__("r28")` + casts pins it. Load-web pins
     stick where call-result pins dissolve (reconfirmed ×3 this batch).
246. **Byte-walking tbl address chain** (fn_80229404 park analysis): want's
     constructor loop reuses ONE register as both tbl address base and i+1
     (slwi hoisted pre-loop once; `add r9,r9,r31` per iteration onto scalar
     i+1 → overlapping stw at byte stride). Reproduce via named-var chain
     t(i*4 → +=a0 → store → =i+1). CAUTION pair discovered en route:
     opacity barriers on counters ("+r"/input-only asm) AND register-pins on
     counters BOTH break GCC's doloop conversion (mtctr/bdnz degrades to
     addic./bne or gains a guard compare) — count-reg control without
     breaking mtctr/bdnz is still unsolved.

### NEW: the SDA-zone route (biggest lever of the batch)

This zone's objects were built with small-data ON — constants load
r13-relative (`lfs/lfd/lwz disp(r13)`), which game-code `-G0` objects can
NEVER emit standalone. Route that landed **9 link-sim EXACTs in one batch**:
`// FLAG: -msdata=eabi -GN` + real `extern` lbl refs → ngccc emits
R_PPC_EMB_SDA21 words that mwld resolves vs _SDA_BASE_ byte-identically at
link (§5q recipe, now proven for f32/f64/arrays). Rules:
- Threshold is TYPE-WIDTH-dependent: `-G4` routes f32 externs but f64 (8B)
  falls back to HA/LO absolute → use `-G8`; array externs need explicit sizes
  (`extern f64 lbl_X[3];`) and a threshold ≥ largest object (-G128/-G256 probed).
- Standalone sweeps FALSE-DIFF these drafts (unmasked type-109 reloc words).
  Verify with `tools/sda_verify.py <addr> <flags>`; promote via MANUAL
  configure.py Object registration (promote_wip cannot verify SDA21).
- `flagdiff.py` compiles flagged drafts DIFFERENTLY than sda_verify's path
  (different regalloc on identical source+flags) — never diagnose from it
  alone in SDA zones.

### Other new recipes

1. **Union-pun entry idiom**: punning a float param through a NAMED union
   local (`u.f=x; ix=u.i&M;`) reproduces want's `[fmr f0,f1][stfs f0]`
   copy-then-store; direct `*(u32*)&param` elides the fmr and NEVER matches.
   fdlibm GET_FLOAT_WORD must expand PER-SITE — one shared union diverges.
2. **frN-pin refinements**: fr0-pin return web (`register f32 r
   __asm__("fr0")`) when want ends `lfs f0; fmr f1,f0` instead of `lfs f1`;
   `"+f"` barrier keeps two stfd/stfs reading different FPRs (anti-copy-prop);
   pin the x-copy ONLY when it outlives all multiplies (sin ✓ / cos ✗ where
   last use is `x*y` — GCC coalesces xy onto the dead reg).
3. **Nested-scope register pins as asm operands**: function-level pins are
   live-from-entry and collapse whole-function allocation; a NESTED-BLOCK pin
   dies at `}` and reserves the hard reg without poisoning (cracked floor's
   scratch-load homes r9/r10).
4. **Crossjump anchor ordering**: put the SHARED return textually FIRST so
   the second site branches INTO it (cracked scalbnf from 3.9%).
5. fmuls/fmul operand slots follow SOURCE order, not evaluation order.
6. Volatile empty asm is a real fence; non-volatile empty asm is a no-op for
   scheduling (reconfirmed in new contexts).
7. One volatile `"+r"` barrier between a masked-bit computation and its first
   compare stops sched2 hoisting the compare constant (cracked sinf/cosf
   flaglessly).
8. Shared-tail merge needs identical FPR coloring — two `return y*const`
   tails merge into one fmul only when both constants flow through the SAME
   local name.
9. INSERT_WORDS dead-load shape: want's `[lwz w0(dead)][lwz w1][stw][stw]`
   round-trip comes from a self-read member write (`u.w[1] = u.w[1];`).
10. Hidden switch cases from range compares: a bounds-range subtree
    ([0x65..0x67] for e..g) proves hidden contiguous cases ('f') m2c missed —
    add the semantic case before assuming a tree-shape wall; shared-body
    dispatchers put the call INSIDE the switch (goto-per-arm duplicates the
    body per leaf).
11. fdlibm-verbatim transcription lever: copying the netlib statement text
    EXACTLY (indexed loops, no invented pointer walkers — want's walkers are
    strength-reduction artifacts) was the single biggest jump on big libm
    bodies (rem_pio2 twins 10→32%).
12. Duplicate-literal tell: neighboring functions owning byte-identical string
    literals at DIFFERENT addresses = separate TUs (identifies float/no-float
    engine pairs like BD70/D288).
13. Crclr map for libc calls extends here: memcpy/udiv-style helpers keep
    want-side crclr (leave implicit); named libc fns (strlen/memchr) need protos.

## 6au — fn_800AE250 full-rebuild session (2026-08-30, 1060B gameplay update)

Full hand-rebuild of fn_800AE250 (per-frame gameplay update — gravity/float
branch + item-list rebuild; suggested rename `Skater_UpdateGameplay`). Result:
103/265 (38.9%) masked, SIZE-EXACT 1060B, parked with full notes. Three
reusable findings:

231. **WANT's `xoris r0,r0,0x8000` in u32→f64 conversions means the C
     cast is SIGNED.** ngccc emits TWO idioms: `(f64)(u32)x` → plain store
     + `fsub` of pool double 0x4330000000000000 (2^52); `(f64)(s32)x` →
     `xoris` first + `fsub` of 0x4330000080000000 (2^52+2^31). Both are
     exactly 14 insns for a `(f32)(f64)cast / f32const` division, but the
     unsigned form is 1 insn SHORTER (no xoris) — beware the index-shift
     cascade below when "fixing" it.
232. **Branchy loops defeat base-pointer rematerialization.** In a
     single-block loop, GCC 2.95 keeps `base = ptr + K` in-loop at first
     use (`addi; lwzx`). Add ANY branch (item-check if-block) and LICM
     hoists it to the preheader from the join block, no matter where the
     C assigns it — and the hoist can demand an EXTRA callee-saved
     register (frame +8, ALL stack offsets diverge → massive masked
     loss). The r28 pin + join-block assignment (draft's config) keeps
     the indexed `lwzx rD, r28, rIdx` shape at the cost of the
     hoist+copy; want's in-loop `addi` at the use site is unreachable
     from C in branchy loops. Verify base+index loops for this before
     chasing regalloc ghosts.
233. **Masked-score cascades punish semantically-correct fixes.** The
     score compares got[i] vs want[i] at equal byte offsets, so adding
     one instruction ANYWHERE shifts every later index. The (s32) xoris
     fix matched its own region (44/52 vs 8/52) but cost >2× that in
     shifted regions (vtable 5/84, loop 36/65) — net 101 < 103. Park the
     best BYTE score, and document the semantically-correct form in the
     park note for a future rebuild. Also: u64-chain region scored 0/48
     in EVERY register-pin config — want interleaves an independent
     global load (`lwz r28, -0x194(r30)`) into the subfc/subfe chain
     (scheduling artifact, not source-reachable).

220. **mwcc codegen idioms (needed across all SDK zones)**:
     (a) `IS_FALSE(x)` macro required — plain `== FALSE` folds to neg+cntlzw
     instead of cntlzw+srwi; (b) raw HW addresses need the
     `volatile u32 REG[0x40] AT_ADDRESS(0xCC00xxxx)` header form — literal
     casts never match the lis+addi/stwu symbol forms; (c) mwcc 1.2.5n has NO
     GCC-style extended asm (`__asm__("" : "+r"(x))` unsupported; only CW

     agents' dispute and clarifies §63-168): __builtin_ps_* args mirror
     the ASM operand listing `ps_xxx d,A,C,B` — madd/madds0/sum0 map
     (a,b,c)→(frA,frC,frB), so **madd/madds0(a,b,c) = a*b(.lo)+c**
     (multipliers args 1-2, addend arg 3 — natural math order); sum0 =
     {a.lo+b.lo, c.hi}; mul/muls0(a,b)=a*b(.lo). When porting want's
     `ps_madd fD,fA,fC,fB`, swap slots: `madd(A_val, C_val, B_val)`.
228. **Silent-empty-object trap**: `__builtin_psq_lx/stx/lux` compile
     rc=0 but emit a ~284B EMPTY stub (cc1 dies inside wibo, no stderr)
     — always check object SIZE, not exit code. NgcAs rejects the
     `psq_lux` mnemonic outright; psq_lux is unreachable from plain C
     (walker forms give psq_lu) — only psq_lu/lx/stx emit.
229. **Version discriminator**: scalar→PS broadcast `K=(__ps_t)*kp++;`
     emits bare lfsu consumed as a PS operand on 3.9.3 ONLY; all older
     ProDG builds ICE at expr.c:858. Confirms game objects were built
     with the v1.76 cc1 whenever this shape appears in want.
230. Misc PS emission facts (full list in doc-06 M5.0t update): builtin
     results are NOT volatile → dead retail PS code DCEs from every C
     form; duplicate-mul CSE dodge = mix `t*k` with
     `__builtin_ps_mul(t,k)`; plain __ps_t locals do NOT inflate frames
     in straight-line code (refines §63-173); PSU unions inside frame
     structs drag 16-byte alignment — use raw f32[2] members; `(f32)
     pairvar` extracts lane0 in-register (want's fcmpu-on-pair idiom);
     capstone yields zero disasm on ProDG .o files, and ps_diff.py
     prints signed psq displacements with phantom I1 fields.

## 6aw — vtable-ctor sibling harvest + array-push/remove parks (2026-08-30)

Continued the 0x9B–0xF2 regalloc/loop-wall sweep. 2 new byte-identical matches
(+ 2 parks documented, DOL byte-identical, PROGRESS 7203):

237. **Constructor siblings differ by which field stores the child pointer
     AND whether a prior sibling-init runs — match them one at a time.**
     fn_80009B04 and fn_8000A13C are the same "alloc child via
     fn_800098F4(0x18), wire vtable + self-chain, store into self" pattern:
     9B04 writes self+8 and skips the init call; A13C calls
     fn_80009CF4(self) first and writes self+0x28 (vtable lbl_8028FFB8 vs
     9B04's lbl_8028FF00/lbl_8028FF28). The store ORDER of the four zero
     fields is load-bearing: brute-forcing permutations found A13C needs
     0x4,0xc,0x10,0x14 source order to emit want's exact stw group.
238. **Array-push/remove walls = indexed-store scheduling, not logic.**
     F95C (push) wants base-r10=self+4 + `slwi r0,r9,2; stwx r11,r10,r0`
     with count incremented AFTER the store; ngccc folds base+index into
     one register and hoists the +1. F9C4 (remove-by-value, opt. vtable
     dispatch) wants dual induction (scalar r8 +1 / byte-offset r10 +4),
     re-reads self->0xc4 each iteration, and computes arr base AFTER the
     entry guard — the doc-47 bug. Best matches: F95C 10/26, F9C4 24/36
     (all dispatch+swap bytes from 0x40 onward identical).
239. **Range-header size MUST equal `addr + symbol size` exactly, or a
     promote batch's split regeneration breaks the link.** The whole
     promote pipeline re-derives splits from each header's `range` end;
     one short header (fn_8000D028 header said 0x...D0A0 but symbol is
     size 0x7C ending 0xD0A4) silently produced an under-sized split and
     the linked DOL diverged. Run a size scan (`addr+sym_size` vs header
     end) over `src/fn_*.c` before promotion;
     `tools/test_wip_drafts.py`'s per-function EXACT verdict is NOT a
     link outcome — drafts referencing SDA2-pool constants can trip
     `tools/patch_dol.py`'s `Init r2 setup computes 0x…, expected
     0x803D2F80` assert when the promoted batch shifts the SDA2 base
     (obs. 0x803D2F60), and exac-addr hand-asm labels
     (`__cvt_fp2unsigned` → `lbl_802B1CD8`, `bdnz $`) are undefined in
     the link. Verify a draft links BEFORE batch-promoting it.

## 6ax — auto-asm gap-sweep leaf harvest (2026-08-30, 0x09218/0x0C410 matches)
Three clean leaf-functions were pulled out of pure auto-asm gap units and two
matched byte-identical (fn_8000C410, fn_80009218); one CRC was parked at 21/23
(fn_8000A6D4). Recipes:

240. **Force a global-table offset into a load DISPLACEMENT, not an index
     addi.** `fn_8000C410` needs `mulli r9,r9,0xc; add r9,r9,<base>; lbz r0,0xa(r9)`.
     Written inline as `tbl[n*0xc + 0xa]` ngccc folds the +0xa into a preceding
     `addi` (13/15). Materializing the scaled base as its OWN pointer
     `unsigned char *p = (unsigned char*)tbl + n*0xc; return p[0xa];` forces the
     +0xa into the `lbz` displacement → 15/15 byte-identical. General rule: the
     offset goes in the load if the base-pointer add is a separate statement.

241. **For a u8-masked CRC/checksum index, materialize `u8 lo = (u8)crc` (don't
     inline `((u8)crc)^data[i]`).** `fn_8000A6D4` (table CRC over lbl_802FFA3C) -
     the inline cast makes GCC fold the u8 mask into the index `rlwinm`
     (4/23). A real `unsigned char lo = (unsigned char)crc;` forces a separate
     `clrlwi r9,r3,0x18 # (u8)crc` BEFORE the xor → 21/23. Residue is doc-46
     regalloc only (want keeps data in r8 + masks crc-in-r3; `register u8* dp
     asm("r8")` pinning collapses to 0/23).

242. **Global-counter allocator: store the OLD counter to the node BEFORE
     bumping the global.** `fn_80009218` reads `lbl_802FFA34[0]`, stores it to
     self+4, increments the global, zeroes self+8, calls init, returns self.
     Writing the increment before the self->4 store swapped two `stw` words
     (17/19); ordering `self->4=c` first makes it 19/19 byte-identical.

New parks this session: fn_8000A6D4 (21/23, CRC, doc-46 residue) in WIP.md.
New leaf matches: fn_8000C410 (indexed flag/state check on lbl_80312434),
fn_80009218 (counter-ID allocator). PROGRESS 7205/11492.

**UPDATE (2026-08-31): fn_8000A6D4 SOLVED + promoted — the CRC doc-46 regalloc
residue was fixed by temp DECLARATION ORDER, not pins.** WANT masks crc into
r9 and loads `data[i]` into r0; GCC swapped them. Declaring `unsigned int b
= (unsigned char)data[i]` BEFORE `unsigned int lo = (unsigned char)crc`
picks the WANT web (byte→r0, mask→r9); the prior draft had `lo` first which
folded the load into r9. EXACT 23/23, DOL byte-identical. Full recipe in
docs/parkings/solved/10-pure-regalloc-coin-flip.md. Lesson for doc-10-style
flips: vary local declaration ORDER before reaching for register pins.

## 6ay — gap-sweep follow-ups: two more node-family matches (2026-08-30)

243. **Increment-store pairing: inline `x = x->f + 1` AT the store beats a
     temp when want stores a ptr-field BEFORE a counter-field.** fn_8000A510
     wants `[self->0x40=p; self->4=n+1]` pre-call; any `s32 n` temp makes
     ngccc emit the self->4 store first no matter the source order (24/26).
     `void *p = self->0x3c; self->0x40 = p; self->4 = self->4 + 1;` → 26/26.
     Also: passthrough arg (r4 never touched in-fn) confirms a hidden 2nd
     param forwarded to the callee.

244. **Multi-embedded-node constructors: permute each node's 5-store block
     SEPARATELY, un-paired.** fn_8000A1FC initializes two embedded node
     objects (self+0xc, self+0x24) sharing vtable lbl_8028FFA0, each a
     self-linked dlist with id=-1. Interleaving by field (n1->X; n2->X;)
     caps at 26/35; writing ALL of n1's stores then ALL of n2's and brute-
     forcing each 5-store block (5!×5!) + tail 3-store rotation lands 35/35.
     Winning orders differ per node: n1=[u4,u8,next,prev,vt],
     n2=[u4,vt,next,prev,u8]; tail source [0x40,0x44,0x48] (rotate-right
     → want [0x48,0x40,0x44]). Sibling fn_8000A288 (244B, list-walk +
     unlink + reinit) remains auto-asm — branchy, not a quick leaf.

New matches this run: fn_8000A510 (counter push/pop wrapper around
fn_80009D88), fn_8000A1FC (two-node container ctor, calls A37C).
PROGRESS 7207/11492.

245. **String/path checksum (fn_8000A778, 32/32): hash-first xor + two separate
     fold ifs.** Same table CRC over lbl_802FFA3C, but over chars with A-Z →
     lowercase and '/' → '\\'. Three gotchas: (a) index must be INLINE
     `((u8)hash) ^ (u8)c` (hash first) — want folds the u8 mask into the
     index rlwinm and puts hash in the xor rS; a materialized `u8 lo` temp
     flips it; (b) hash init AFTER the first `c = *str++` or GCC hoists
     `li r10,-1` above the `or. r3,r3,r3` guard; (c) the '/' → '\\' check is
     a SEPARATE if after the fold (want `bgt` skips only the fold, landing on
     `cmpwi r8,0x2f`). NESTING it compiled a bgt 3 insns off — and the
     per-function masked test still said 32/32 because the REL14 mask
     (0xFFFF0003) hides branch displacements. The linked DOL caught it
     (1-byte diff in the bgt low byte). **Rule: after any promote, verify the
     built DOL; if it DIFFERS by bytes inside an intra-function branch,
     check the .rela.text REL14 addends against the want branch targets —
     masked per-function EXACT is NOT a link outcome.**

New match: fn_8000A778 (path/string checksum, sibling of A6D4).
PROGRESS 7208/11492.

## 6az — gap-sweep: wrapper + state-gated park (2026-08-30)

246. **Guard-wrapper call-arg order: materialize EVERY intermediate temp in
     want's emission order.** fn_8000E014 (singleton-guard wrapper, sibling
     of E08C/E104) needs the success-path args computed BEFORE the
     `lbl_802FFE88 = 1` store: reload ptr, arg1*arg2, obj->4 load, then the
     store, then arg0 re-home, then call. Any inline sub-expression and GCC
     re-schedules the store first (20/30); all three temps materialized as
     `void *temp_r9 = *ptr; s32 temp_r5 = arg1*arg2; s32 temp_r0 = *(obj+4);`
     before the store flips it to 30/30.

247. **doc-47's base-hoist needs explicit bases AND array indexing; bare
     self-relative indexing strength-reduces.** fn_8000C938 (third doc-47
     member, 32/37): `*(u8*)(self+0x60+i) = 0` compiles to a walking-pointer
     loop (stb with addi per iter, 29/37); `u8 *buf1 = self+0x60; buf1[i] = 0`
     recovers the indexed `stbx` form and gets everything but the 5-word
     preheader placement. Recorded in doc-47 as a third member.

248. **Signed-float sign-flag: comparison POLARITY flips the rlwinm SH; the
     u32->float path must be (f32)(f64)(s32).** fn_8000C5D8 (C938's sibling,
     200B, 50/50 byte-identical): `buf[idx] = ((f32)(f64)(s32)value) > 0.0f`
     emits `rlwinm r0,r0,0x1e,0x1f,0x1f` (GT); writing `< 0.0f` emits SH=0x1d
     (LT) and fails 1 word. The `(s32)` cast is what produces the xoris +
     0x4330000080000000 magic-constant path (plain u32 gives the unsigned
     constant). Also needs the C938 bool-materialization guard and the
     explicit `u8 *base` for the indexed stbx — same as recipe 247.

New match: fn_8000C5D8 (state-gated sign-flag + PADControlMotor call).
PROGRESS 7210/11492.

249. **`return arg0;` leaf pattern: `void *` return + `return arg0;` forces
     the `mr r9/r11, r3` base copy, and ngccc emits zero/const stores in a
     ROTATED order — source [a,b,c] comes out [c,a,b].** The small-leaf tier
     (16-28B) is full of `self->X = 0; return self;` / vtable-install / float
     pair-store functions whose want starts `mr r9, r3`. Bare void functions
     use r3 directly (no copy) and a different store order. To hit
     byte-identical: declare `void *fn(void *arg0)`, end with `return arg0;`
     (r3 stays live → no restore emitted), and write the stores so the
     ROTATION lands on want's order (e.g. want [8,0,4] needs source
     [0,4,8]; want [0x10,4,8] needs [4,8,0x10]; float pairs want [0x10,0xc]
     needs source [0xc,0x10]). Verified on 10 leaves incl. fn_80054424,
     fn_8018B6B8, fn_801A653C, fn_80059380, fn_80199544. For global-base
     stores (`lbl + off`) an explicit `char *b = lbl;` temp forces ONE
     lis/addi instead of per-store address math.

250. **`a == b` booleanizes via xor/subfic/adde; `(a^b) != 0` folds into a
     cmpw branch.** fn_8019B728/9B73C (equality tests): want is
     `lwz; xor r3, r4, r3; subfic r0, r3, 0; adde r3, r0, r3` — that's
     `arg == x` (the `== 0` carry idiom returns `x == 0`). Writing
     `(x ^ arg) != 0`, `!=`, `!!`, or ternary ALL compile to
     `cmpw; li; bnelr; li; blr` (1 word off) — only literal `==` with the
     ARG as the FIRST operand (`arg == x`) reproduces the xor's rA=r4.
     `subfic/adde` after a subfc is the unsigned `>=` carry idiom
     (fn_801F443C, fn_8012B7B4).

251. **Multi-function src files hide matches from the fn_* scan.**
     src/fn_8013F734.c defines THREE functions (734/74C/764) behind one
     split — promoting 74C/764 as separate files duplicates symbols and
     dtk fails with "overlaps with previous split". Before promoting from
     the small-leaf sweep, grep the WHOLE src/ tree for the address (call
     sites are fine; a second top-level definition is not).

Small-leaf harvest: 16 byte-identical matches (the 8005/8007/8012/8013/

     `cmp` + `ok` + object-.text-size == symbol-size check.

270. **Two-global OR-gates want the boolean `||` form.** fn_80018178
