## 6ea — 2026-10-01 single pick: a `bl` with NO arg setup is NOT evidence the call
### is 0-arg — if r3 already holds the value the GUARD just loaded, pass that value;
### and the payoff is the guard's register colour, not the call (fn_801F9204,
### 20.0% → EXACT, 272B, 0 emitted asm, 0 flags, 0 pins, 2 plain-C semantic edits)

A five-way `if (f) { notify(f); clear(f, -1); }` destructor over one object
(`arg0` homed in r31, 5 × `bl fn_80057CB0` + 5 × `bl fn_80057D30`). The m2c draft
called `fn_80057CB0()` with **no argument at all** at four of the five sites (and
`fn_80057CB0(arg0)` at the fifth), and declared neither callee. That is 20.0 %.

* **Read what is actually IN r3 at each `bl` before deciding the arity.** Want's
  five notify calls are all bare, but in every case r3 already holds the value
  the *preceding guard* just loaded: the first three notify sites each load one field (offsets 0x30, 0x2C, and 0x28 of the object homed in r31) into r3, compare it against zero, and branch to a shared join before the bare branch to fn_80057CB0, so r3 already carries the tested field; the fourth site loads offset 0x28, then chains through offset 0x2C of that node with a second compare before its branch to fn_80057CB0 carrying the node's 0x2C field in r3.
  The source therefore passed **the tested value** as arg0. The two existing
  "no arg setup" recipes bracket this and neither covers it: §6a-3 / §6bh say an
  untouched r3 is the *caller's arg0* or the *previous call's return*; §6o-99
  says a callee whose prologue reads no arg registers can be called with no
  args. Neither applies when the callee **does** read r3 and r3 holds a fresh
  guard load — the call is genuinely 1-arg and the arg is the guard's own value.
* **The reward is the GUARD's register colour, not the call.** The bare call
  compiles to nothing extra either way, so the only observable difference is
  elsewhere: with `fn_80057CB0(f)` the tested value is a live call argument and
  `local_alloc` colours it into the **arg register r3** (§72-143 / §6be-1); with
  `fn_80057CB0()` it is a dead load and GCC picks **r0 / r9** for the whole guard
  chain. That was worth **18 words** — the entire residual after the prototypes
  were fixed. It is the same lever as §6dp-3's `register s32 cur __asm__("r3")`
  pin, but the plain-C form is available whenever the value is *also* the callee's
  arg0, so **try the argument before the pin.**
* **Measured ablation (it is an AND, §6bf-A — neither half alone is a match):**
  | body | % | object |
  |---|---|---|
  | m2c draft as inherited | 20.0 % | 300B (5 `crclr cr1eq` + 1 `mr r3,r31`) |
  | real prototypes only, notify still called 0-arg | **73.5 %** | 272B size-exact |
  | arg-passing only, no prototypes at all | 18.0 % | 312B |
  | both | **100.0 %** | 272B |
  The prototypes alone give the exact LENGTH and leave *only* register colours,
  so a size-exact-but-70 %-with-every-diff-a-register-number residual here is the
  fingerprint of "the guard value is not an argument", not of an allocator wall.
* **And the C may not even be legal in the intermediate state:** declaring the
  real 1-arg prototype while still writing `fn_80057CB0()` is a **compile FAIL**
  (`too few arguments to function`, §6dg — cc1 prints it as `warning:` and exits
  1). Use an old-style `extern void fn_X();` if you need to score the
  prototype-only intermediate.
* Second half of the fix, both ordinary and both needed: the dead 2nd argument.
  `fn_80057D30(obj, x)` is called with `li r4,-1` but the callee reads **only
  r3** (`lwz r3,0x10(r3)` then a vcall). Declare it `void fn_80057D30(void *, s32)`
  — a **dead-arg prototype** (§6t-3) — so the `li r4,-1` is materialised
  without a `crclr`. The second argument is *not* optional in the prototype
  despite being unread.
* **Also: 5 identical `if (f) { notify(f); clear(f, -1); }` blocks were
  byte-identical with the two calls written as `fn_80057D30(arg0->unk0x28->unk0x2C, -1)`
  — re-reading the chain from `arg0` at the call site, not reusing the `node`
  temp from the guard.** That is what produces want's `lwz r9,0x28(r31); li r4,-1;
  lwz r3,0x2c(r9)` reload (the temp died in the first call), and it needs no
  asm, no pin and no `volatile` to keep the reload (§6a-32 / §6m-43 both describe
  re-reading a chain; §6bt's "web identity" is why the temp must not be reused).

**Audit:** object `.text` = 0x110 = 272B = `symbols.txt size:0x110` = header
`range=0x801F9204-0x801F9314 size=272B`; only `.text` + `.rela.text` (no private
`.rodata`, so no doc-14 promote caveat); **0 emitted inline instructions**;
all **11** intra-function `R_PPC_REL14` addends (`fc, 3c, 58, 84×2, bc×3, f4×3`)
resolve to want's `beq`/`bne` targets and all **10** `R_PPC_REL24` targets are
5 × `fn_80057CB0` + 5 × `fn_80057D30` (§6bw method); no `extern lbl_` data
symbols and no `lis` words in the function, so the hazard-277 masked-wrong-label
case cannot apply. `// family=m2c` retained so the sweep keeps scoring it.

## 6eb — 2026-10-01 single pick: **the arg-load's statement position relative to a store is a THREE-way choice, and "stage it before the store" (§6bh-3 / recipe 57) is the wrong answer when retail's load sits in the MIDDLE** (fn_8022E16C, 36.9% → EXACT, 236 B, 0 emitted asm, 0 flags, 0 pins)

A manager/iterator driver (`fn_8022E16C`: two list walks, 12 calls, four
`lbl_80305FF4 = 0/1` toggles) arrived as a size-exact 36.9 % m2c draft whose
header blamed a "doc-58 phantom call argument". **All five wins were plain-C
semantic; zero codegen levers of any kind.** The 36.9 → 94.9 point is the
callee audit (below); the last 5.1 points are the new datum.

* **The residual was 3 words and nothing else:** want's
  `lis @ha(lbl) | li r0,1 | lwz r3,0x14(r31) | stw r0,disp(r9) | bl`
  against got's `lwz r3,0x14(r31) | lis | li r0,1 | stw | bl`. The argument
  load is a *call argument* (`fn_80057298(arg0->unk0x14)`) whose value retail
  does not need until the call, so it sinks **between the store's constant
  materialisation and the store itself**.
  * `tmp = arg0->unk0x14; lbl_80305FF4 = 1; fn_80057298(tmp);` → **94.9 %** —
    this is the *documented* §6bh-3 / recipe-57 "assign the call's field-load
    argument to a named local before the store run" advice, and it is wrong here.
  * `lbl_80305FF4 = 1; fn_80057298(arg0->unk0x14);` (load **inline** in the call,
    store statement first) → **100 %**.
  * `lbl_80305FF4 = 1; tmp = arg0->unk0x14; fn_80057298(tmp);` (temp, but its
    statement **after** the store) → **100 %**.
  * `tmp = 1; lbl_80305FF4 = tmp; fn_80057298(arg0->unk0x14);` (bake the constant
    into its own local so the store's `li` is a 2-user def) → 96.6 %.

  **So the rule is not "stage the load early" or "stage it late" — it is
  "put the load's *statement* where retail's `lwz` is relative to the store's
  *constant*".** Classify the want window before touching it:
  `[load][args][stores][call]` → stage before (existing §6bh-3);
  `[const][load][store][call]` → put the load **after** the store statement
  (this recipe, named temp or inline — both work, so the *temp* is irrelevant
  and only the position matters); `[const][stores][load][call]` → the load is
  the next statement's. A 3-word residual of exactly `load` vs `[lis][li]`
  swapped around a store is therefore never a scheduling wall, and applying the
  load-first rule to it costs the whole residual.
  Diagnostic one-liner: the *same* 4 words in both streams, differing only in
  where one `lwz` sits relative to one `li` and one `stw`, is a statement-order
  question — the size is already exact, so per §6cs-1 the remaining diffs are
  placement, not length.

* **The 47-point jump is the standard callee audit, with one new sub-case worth
  naming: a 0-arg `s32` getter whose return feeds the next call at SEVERAL
  sites.** `fn_801FC0E0` is 0-arg (its prologue loads a global into r3) and
  returns `s32`; retail calls it four times and three of the results are the
  next call's arg0 with **no arg setup at all**:
  `fn_801FA5E4(fn_801FC0E0())`, `fn_801FA628(fn_801FC0E0())`,
  `fn_801FA66C(fn_801FC0E0())`. All three callees read r3, so m2c's
  `fn_801FA628(arg0)` was wrong in arity *and* value. This is recipe 23 / §4t /
  §6bh; the "several sites" aspect matters because it is a **repeated** chain,
  so it reads as a systematic m2c bug (arg0-forwarding habit) rather than one
  missing arg.
  Two other standard confirmations from the same body: a **dead-arg proto** for
  a callee that provably never reads r3 but whose `lwz` the caller must still
  materialise (`void fn_8022F184(s32);` — §6t-3), and a **4-byte `blr` stub
  whose arity comes from the call site**, here the `.rodata2` `data:string`
  label `lbl_802B05C8` passed as its single argument (§6y-127 / recipe 119).
  Note the object was **already the exact 236 B** at 36.9 % with 10 spurious
  `crclr cr1eq` absorbed by other word swaps — a 10-prototype fix that leaves
  the *length* unchanged is the §6de "object longer than want" mirror image,
  and the pct moves only because the `crclr`s were displacing real instructions.

## 6ec — 2026-10-01 single pick: m2c's `0;` stubs are **three-way ambiguous** (dead
### statics / real `__ps_t` pair copies / genuinely dead), and **DECLARATION order is a
### lever that is independent of BIRTH order** — hold the `addi` order fixed and swap only
### the `register`/local declaration order to flip an r30-vs-r12 callee-saved choice
### (fn_80201E78, 23.6% → EXACT, 220 B, 0 emitted asm, 0 flags, 0 pins)

A QB `Script*` constructor in the §6az network zone: `fn_802010FC(arg0)` guard, a
`Script_RunScript(hash,0,0,0,0)`, a 0x46-iteration `mtctr`/`bdnz` walk over a 0x24-stride
array at `arg0+0x30`/`arg0+0x2C`, four zero-stores and — the point — **four 8-byte
paired-single copies** that m2c rendered as `0;`.

* **A run of `0;` statements is THREE-way ambiguous, and the ADDENDUM's
  "statics-DCE husk" reading is only one of them.** The husk signature is
  "`0;` stubs **plus a compiled body much shorter than want**"; here the compiled
  body was 168 B for a 220 B want, the tell held, but the `0;` lines were *real*
  code and decoding them was the whole fix. **Disambiguate by decoding the want's
  tail before hand-rebuilding:** `ps_disasm.py <addr> <n>` and look for
  `psq_l/psq_st` pairs at the addresses the `0;` lines correspond to. Here
  0x80201F20-0x80201F3C is four `psq_l f0,0(rX); psq_st f0,0(rY)` pairs = four
  `*dX = *sX;` statements on a file-local `__ps_t`-typed object, which ngccc
  emits verbatim under `-mps-float` (auto-added by the sweep for a `__ps_t`
  body). Note the sources are *not* symmetric: the pairs are
  `A68←A78, A70←A80, A30←A40, A38←A48`, and the `addi` birth order in the
  preheader is dest,src,interleaved — which is also the source order of the
  eight named base pointers assigned **before** the loop (their uses are after
  it, yet retail materialises them in the preheader; declaring + assigning them
  there reproduces it with no lever).
* **DECLARATION order and BIRTH (assignment) order are SEPARATE levers, and
  only the former was needed here.** At 92.7 % the last 4 words were a pure
  two-register rotation: want `sA`(2nd-born)→`r30`, `dB`(3rd-born)→`r12`; got
  the inverse. Nothing in the *assignment* order could fix it without also
  reordering the `addi` block (which matches and must not move) — and swapping
  the assignments anyway cost 11 points (81.8 %). Declaring `dB` **before** `sA`
  in the local-declaration block, with the assignments untouched, gave
  **100.0 %**, and simultaneously fixed the two `psq_l`/`psq_st` register
  operands (same root cause). This refines §76-184 / §6o-81 ("declaration order
  assigns roles") into something actionable when the birth order is *pinned by
  an independent constraint*: **the declaration block is a free variable even
  then — permute it last, after statement order is right, and re-score; costs
  nothing (no emitted instructions, no asm).** Ablation note: a hard pin on the
  same variable (`register s32 sA __asm__("r30")`) made it *worse* (87.3 %) by
  cascading a different rotation through the whole chain — try declaration order
  before pins.
* Two free confirmations: **M8.31 on a `scope:global` promoted callee whose result
  is discarded** — `s32 Script_RunScript(...)` → `void` moved the hash's `ori`
  from arg-slot 5 up to slot 2, worth 7.2 % of a 4-word window — and **the comma/
  `&&` birth of a second base pointer**: `(*(s32 *)((p2C = (char *)arg0 + 0x2C,
  p2C + var_i)) != 0)` puts the base in the `lwzx`/`stwx` rA slot where a
  separate assignment statement put the offset there (+3.7 %). The promoted
  sibling `src/fn_80201F54.c` — found by `ls src/ | grep -i 80201`, same callee
  set, same loop — already spelled both of these, so **check `src/` for the
  promoted sibling of a low-score draft before the codegen ladder** (§6dc).

## 6ef — 2026-10-01 single pick: three zero-asm levers for a "copy a NUL-terminated
### path into a stack buffer" byte loop — `char` vs `u8` decides whether retail's
### `extsb` survives, a DUPLICATED load expression keeps the store's and the test's
### pseudos in separate registers, and `while (cond)` after a peeled entry call
### reproduces a NON-ROTATED loop whose header is the last block
### (fn_8000E39C, 20.9% → EXACT, 172 B, 0 emitted asm, 0 flags, 0 pins)

`fn_8000E39C` (low-address allocator zone, AGENTS §6av) was a raw m2c body at
**20.93 %** whose object was already the exact 172 B. All four wins were
semantic; no pin, barrier, `_dummy`, `// FLAG:` or store permutation was needed.
This is the third consecutive single-pick where a sub-50 % m2c draft in this
zone was 100 % semantics — the `stwu -0x20` vs `-0x98` prologue gap looked like
"the body is a husk" and was actually an un-sized local.

* **An otherwise-UNUSED locals region is sized by §6db's frame arithmetic, and
  the fix is an array, not padding.** `stwu -0x98`, `stmw r29,0x8c(r1)`,
  `stw r0,0x9c(r1)` ⇒ `locals = 0x98 − 16 − 4·3 = 0x7c`, yet retail touches
  only `r1+8` (a single byte, `sp8[0]`). Declaring `char sp8[0x7c];` gives the
  exact frame, save offset, LR slot and `addi rX,r1,8` base with one line.
  `char sp8[0x7b]`/`[0x7d]`, a `char pad[0x7c]` "m"-pin, and `volatile
  double _dummy` variants were not needed and do not fire. **Trigger: a
  `stwu -0xNN` with a normal save span but almost no stack traffic — compute
  the locals total before assuming anything is missing.**

* **A `char` (signed) loop temp keeps retail's `extsb`; a `u8` temp lets
  tree-level folding delete it.** want: `lbz r0,…; extsb r9,r0; stbu r0,…;
  cmpwi r9,0`. With a `u8` temp, `NE (SIGNED_CAST(byte), 0)` folds to
  `byte != 0` in `simplify_relational` and GCC emits `cmpwi r0,0` on the raw
  load — 4 words gone. With `char temp;` and the test spelled `temp != 0` the
  cast survives (`extsb` emitted). Same story for the *pre-loop* guard, which
  is why the guard variable wants its own `s8 c0` rather than reusing the loop
  temp. Sibling of the recipe 34 / §6cc "declare the real type" family, but the
  observable is an `extsb` disappearing, not a mask.

* **Write a copy as TWO expressions to keep the store's pseudo and the test's
  pseudo in DIFFERENT registers.** `temp = src[1]; dst[1] = temp;` gives one
  QImode load pseudo that the store consumes AND whose `extsb` the test
  consumes, so `coalesce` merges them into one reg (`extsb r0,r0`). Retail has
  `lbzu r0,1(r4); extsb r9,r0; stbu r0,1(r11); cmpwi r9,0` — the byte in r0,
  its sign-extension in r9. Spelling the source as
  `dst[1] = src[1]; temp = src[1];` keeps two pseudos (CSE'd into one `lbzu`
  but with distinct users) and the whole loop body comes out byte-identical
  (74 % → 91 %). **This is the "one variable per web" family (§6cw, §6bu,
  §6an-3) running in reverse: here the SOURCE wrote the value twice and the
  naive single-temp form is what collapses the webs.** Read the want: two
  live registers off one load ⇒ the source mentions the load twice.

* **`while (cond) {}` after a peeled entry call reproduces retail's
  non-rotated loop; `for (;;)` rotates the header to the TOP.** want's second
  loop is a non-rotated loop whose preheader calls the first callee and then branches explicitly to a header placed last, whose body comes first with a call to the second callee and a not-equal branch to the epilogue falling through on the back edge, and whose header calls the third callee, tests it, and loops back to the body with a zero materialisation on exit.
  `for(;;){ node=f(); if(!node){r=0;break;} r=g(); if(r)break; }` gives GCC a
  rotatable loop: header at the top and an explicit `b` back edge, plus extra
  exit blocks (74 % of the function wrong on shape alone). Hoisting the first
  test out of the loop — `node = f(); while (node != 0) { r = g(); if (r)
  goto done; node = f(); }` — reproduces retail's block order, the
  fallthrough back edge and the two-block exit exactly. Generalises §6ag-1 /
  §6dm-2 / §6an-1 (goto/hand-rotated loops beat structured ones when retail's
  loop was hand-rotated) to the simplest `while`: **when want's loop header has
  a predecessor from the preheader via an explicit `b` and its back edge is a
  fallthrough, write the entry test as a statement ABOVE the `while`.**

Callee audit (all three confirmed from the retail prologues, no invention):
`fn_8000EB24(void *)` `void` — reads r3, sets no r3; `fn_8000EB38(void *, s32)`
`s32` — reads r3 only, so the caller's `li r4,0` is a **dead arg** that the
2-arg proto keeps (§6t-3); `fn_8000CDDC(s32, char *, void *, void *)` `s32` —
`mr r29,r5` / `mr r30,r6` ⇒ 4 args. m2c's original `s32 fn_8000CDDC(s32,s32,
s32,s32)` was arity-right but had `&sp8` as an `s32`.

**Audit of the EXACT (left in `src/wip`, not promoted):** object has only
`.text` (0xAC = 172 B = `symbols.txt size:0xAC` = the range marker) and
`.rela.text` — **no private `.rodata`**, so no doc-14 promote caveat; **0
emitted inline instructions** (no `__asm__`, no `.long`); all **9** branch
relocations verified with the §6bw method — the 5 intra-function `R_PPC_REL14`
addends (0x5c/0x38/0x68/0x48/0x98 → 0x8000E3F8/0x8000E3D4/0x8000E404/
0x8000E3E4/0x8000E434) and the local `b`'s `R_PPC_REL24` (`.text+0x80` →
0x8000E41C) equal want's decoded branch targets, and the 3 call relocations
name `fn_8000EB24` / `fn_8000EB38` / `fn_8000CDDC`; no `extern lbl_` data
symbol in the body, so the masked-100 %-wrong-label hazard (277) cannot apply.

## 6eg — 2026-10-01 single pick: two m2c pathologies that cost 6 + 8 words in a
### **15-call, zero-branch init function**, and the page-anchor rule they hand you
### (fn_8001BA14, 16.4% → EXACT, 216 B, 0 emitted asm, 0 flags, 0 pins)

The game's boot/init wrapper (`OSInit / DVDInit / VIInit / VIConfigure /
OSCreateThread / OSResumeThread` + game setup) is the archetypal *pure call
sequence*: no arithmetic, no fields, no loops. Its m2c draft still scored 16.4 %
because m2c introduces **two structural** errors on this shape, neither of which
looks like codegen.

* **m2c renders some DIRECT calls to named SDK functions as INDIRECT calls
  through a hard-coded literal: `((void (*)(void))0x802606C0)()`.** That costs
  **3 surplus words per site** (`lis` + `ori` + `mtlr` + `blrl` = 4 where want
  has 1 `bl`) *and* it is invisible in the diff as a "call" — it shows up as a
  `lis`/`ori` pair you may misread as a data address. **Audit every
  `((T (*)(...)) 0x8xxxxxx)` cast in a draft against `symbols.txt`: if the
  address is a `scope:global` function, delete the cast and call it directly.**
  Both hits here were SDK functions that had never been decompiled, so nothing
  in the draft tree told m2c better: `0x802606C0` = `VIInit`,
  `0x80261038` = `VIConfigure`. (6 of 13 surplus words.)
* **The converse also holds and is the same rule from the other side: a want
  with ZERO `crclr cr1eq` in a 15-call body is a direct read-out of how many
  prototypes you are missing** — one undeclared callee = one surplus word, so
  the surplus word count *is* the missing-prototype count. Here 7 of 13 surplus
  words were 7 undeclared SDK callees. The corollary the m2c draft got wrong in
  both directions: `OSInit(arg0)` and `DVDInit(arg0)` pass an argument to two
  callees that **clobber r3 in their first instruction** (`lis r3,...` before
  any use), so they are 0-arg and the r3 = arg0 passthrough at the `bl` is the
  real shape, not a hidden-arg0 bug. Audit the *callee prologue*, not the draft
  (doc-10 / §6bf / §6di).
* **M8.31 in reverse: a callee that is `void` at its promoted definition may be
  `s32` at THIS call site, and here the return is not dead.** `fn_8001FF14` is
  `void fn_8001FF14(s32,s32)` in promoted `src/fn_8001FF14.c`, but it ends
  `bl 0x80285050` so r3 is live, and the caller stores it
  (`lis r9; stw r3,0x13e0(r9)`). Declaring it `void` and dropping the store
  gives a **208 B object for a 216 B want and 42.31 %** — the `-8` length delta
  is the tell (§6cs-1). Declaring it `s32` is worth +58 points. Its first param
  is the honest `void *` (a .bss buffer address), which is warning-free and
  also 100 % — a param type that is neither `s32` nor `void *` can flip
  `expand_call` order (§6o-140), so prefer the honest type and re-score.
* **The page-anchor rule (this is the reusable bit).** Want's
  `lis r29,<PAGE>` sits in the ENTRY block and is used only at the bottom, as
  `addi r3, r29, 0x1430` ×2 — while four *other* symbols in the same page each
  get their own `lis` reload at their use site. That asymmetry is the whole
  answer: `R_PPC_HI16` against symbol A and against symbol B are **different
  RTLs**, so CSE can never merge them however same-page they are; the anchor is
  just symbol A's *own* HI16, CSE'd between its two uses and hoisted because
  that pseudo is live across calls. So a mystery entry-block `lis` that feeds
  `addi reg,<lo>` at several use sites needs **no pin, no asm, no staging** —
  just a real `extern` for the symbol at that address and two use sites in C.
  Verify by reading the object's `.rela.text`: one `ADDR16_HA` for that symbol
  and N `ADDR16_LO` for it. Corollary for hazard 277: the LO *word* legitimately
  has displacement 0 and the addend 0 (the linker supplies the low half from S),
  so a masked EXACT here is only proven once you decode each HA/LO pair as
  `(S + 0x8000) >> 16` and `S & 0xFFFF` against the want's `lis`/`addi` — 15 of
  15 verified here.

**Audit of the EXACT (left in `src/wip`, not promoted):** object has only
`.text` (0xD8 = 216 B = `symbols.txt size:0xD8` = header `size=216B`) and
`.rela.text` — **no private `.rodata`**, so no doc-14 promote caveat; **0
emitted inline instructions** (the file contains no `__asm__` and no `.long`);
15 `R_PPC_REL24` + 7 `R_PPC_ADDR16_HA` + 8 `R_PPC_ADDR16_LO` and **0
`R_PPC_REL14`** — the function has no internal branch, so the §6bw branch audit
is vacuous here (confirmed against the want, which has no `b`/`beq` either); all
15 call targets and all 15 address pairs hand-decoded to want's `bl`s and
`lis`/`addi` immediates, and every one of the 7 symbols is a real
`config/G2TE52/symbols.txt` entry at exactly that address.

## 6eh — 2026-10-01 single pick: m2c renders a long-range CSE'd-CR `if` as
### **`if (0) { ... }` and the body is silently DCE'd** — recover the condition from
### the two *complementary* `beq crN` / `bne crN` branches that share one `cmpwi crN`
### (fn_800F4B98, 16.0% → EXACT, 300 B, 0 emitted asm, 0 flags, 0 pins)

A 300 B `sprintf` + load + 3-call-zone wrapper sat at 16.0 % with an m2c body whose
object was **72 B short**. Every cause was semantic; nothing needed a codegen lever.

* **Tell: a want that `mfcr`/`mtcrf` a CR field (doc-28 machinery) and branches on
  the SAME `crN` field twice, once `beq` and once `bne`, with ONE `cmpwi crN, …`
  in between — and m2c emitted `if (0) { … }` for BOTH bodies.** m2c models CR
  values as constants, so a boolean that lives in a callee-saved CR field across
  a call decodes to `0` and the whole block is dropped. Recover the predicate from
  the branch polarity, not from the code: the branch that *skips* a block is the
  one that tells you which way round the test is.
  Here `cmpwi cr4, r29, 0` + `beq cr4, L_after1` (before block 1) and
  `bne cr4, L_end` (before block 2) decode to **`if (arg2 != 0) { blk1 }` … and
  `if (arg2 == 0) { blk2 }`** — two complementary tests sharing one CSE'd
  compare, not two `== 0` tests. Writing the first as `!= 0` is what turned
  22.7 % into 32.0 %, because it fixes the `beq`-vs-`bne` polarity of the first
  branch. Recovering *both* blocks also restores the prologue: with a live CR
  field across `fn_800132F8`, plain C emits `mfcr r12` / `stw r12,0x108(r1)` /
  `mtcrf 8` and the callee-saved CR save on its own (a fourth doc-28 plain-C
  positive).
* **The frame arithmetic (§6db) sizes the missing buffer exactly, and the twin
  confirms it**: `0x118 - 16 - 4*3 = 0x100` → `char sp8[0x100]`. m2c's `s32 sp8`
  gave a 0x20 frame.
* **THE PROMOTED-TWIN PORT WAS THE WHOLE SECOND HALF (72.0 % → EXACT).** Four
  unrelated semantic fixes got a size-exact 32.0 % body; the last 2 words
  (`li r3,-1` vs `cmpwi r0, 0` swapped) and the `mr r0, r3` / `mr r3, r0` node
  copy were fixed by porting `src/fn_800F5CD8.c` — **a promoted, byte-identical
  function in the same zone** with the *same* four callees, the same
  `char sp8[0x100]`, the same two complementary `if (arg2 != 0)` / `if (arg2 == 0)`
  bodies, and the same `Unk_2C7D9FAD` node/vtable type. Found with
  `rg -l fn_80013294 src/`. The two functions are **different sizes (300 vs 356 B)
  and different signatures (3 args vs 6)**, so `twin_scan` / `near_twin_scan`
  (both size/relic-keyed) would have returned nothing — this is now the third
  independent confirmation of §6dc/§6dx's "search by CALLEE SET", and the rule
  should be read as **do not filter the search by size, by arity, or by
  callee-set equality**; one `rg` on the rarest callee of a stalled draft is
  cheaper than any pin/flag ladder.
* **The decisive last 2 words were the early-return form, and it is an
  ablation-proven AND-free win — measure it before reaching for a pin.** With
  the return written as a variable (`var_r3 = -1; … var_r3 = 0; return var_r3;`)
  the best form I could reach was 97.3 %, and that needed a
  `register s32 var_r3 __asm__("r3")` pin (§6dg) — which the twin's
  `if (temp_r3 == NULL) { return -1; } … { … return 0; }` makes
  **unnecessary**: the early return + a nested `{ }` body puts the `li r3, 0`
  at the end of the body block and the `li r3, -1` in the branch shadow, exactly
  like retail, and drops the pin. (§6bf-A: the pin looked load-bearing at
  97.3 % but was one of an **OR** with the source shape, not part of an AND.)
  Related to §6a-4/§6n-2 but the missing half is the *nested scope*, not the
  polarity.
* Other confirmed-in-place: `Mem_Alloc_3` is **1-arg** (m2c passed 2);
  `lbl_802FFE98` as `extern Unk_9994C3F5 *` + bare uses (§6bc-1 / L1) hoists both
  reads onto ONE `lis` page anchor in a callee-saved reg; the node **and** the
  vtable are the same shared class, and its `s16` at 0x68 is what makes want's
  `lha` appear (the m2c draft's cast-based access would have emitted `lwz`).
* **Audit of the EXACT (left in `src/wip`, not promoted):** object has only
  `.text` (0x12C = 300 B = `symbols.txt size:0x12C` = header `range=…-0x800F4CC4
  size=300B`) and `.rela.text` — **no private `.rodata`**, so no doc-14 promote
  caveat; **0 emitted inline instructions**; all **3** intra-function
  `R_PPC_REL14` addends (`0x110`/`0xd8`/`0x10c`, readelf prints them hex) give
  0x800F4CA8 / 0x800F4C70 / 0x800F4CA4 = want's `beq`/`beq cr4`/`bne cr4`
  targets, and all **10** `R_PPC_REL24` call targets match want's `bl`s (§6bw
  method); all three extern addresses hand-decoded from want's `lis`/`addi` pairs
  (0x8029B99C, 0x802FFE98, 0x800F39DC) and each is a real `symbols.txt` entry,
  so the masked-100 %-wrong-label hazard (277) cannot apply; no opcode-4 words
  and no QB hashes, so neither the PS/VMX mislabel trap nor the hash-decode trap
  applied.

## 6eh2 — 2026-10-01 single pick: a "field-fill constructor" (one long constant
### store run) has THREE cheap semantic tells that are each worth a 4-figure
### jump, and one silent CORRECTNESS trap when you re-type it (fn_8009F678,
### 23.2% → EXACT, 300B, 0 emitted asm, 0 flags, 0 pins, 0 `volatile`)

A `CStruct`-style ctor: `fn_8009E004(arg0)`, a table pointer store, two empty
`ctr = 4; do { ctr--; } while (ctr);` self-loops, then ~50 four-byte field
stores from two `.rodata2` floats. Its m2c draft scored 23%. All of it was
semantics; the codegen ladder was never needed.

* **TELL 1 — "got is LONGER than want by ~1 instruction per STORE" ⇒ every
  store is going through a TYPE CONVERSION, i.e. the member type is wrong.**
  The object was 328 B for a 300 B want and the diff was a wall of
  `fctiwz f12,f0 / stfd f12,0x10(r1) / lwz r9,0x14(r1) / stw r9,off(r31)` where
  want has one `stfs` — 4 instructions per field instead of 1, plus an
  8-byte-inflated frame for the anonymous conversion slot. That is a
  *different* mechanism from §6de's "longer ⇒ a missing prototype per call
  site" and from §6dg's "4 crclrs per surplus arg": **count the surplus
  words against the number of stores, not against the number of calls.** The
  fix is a file-local typedef with the real `f32` members (§6dx/§6de/§6dy
  family) — 23.2% → 73.3% in one edit.

* **TELL 2 — a derived base pointer must NOT get the PARENT's struct type, or
  the member offset is silently re-added to the base.** The draft had
  `temp_r8 = (F678 *)((char *)arg0 + 0xB8); temp_r8->f0xC4 = ...` — which
  compiles to `stfs f13,0xc4(r8)` = absolute `0x17C`, a *wrong address* that
  still scores well. When you unify an m2c draft's types, a pointer that
  was `SomeOtherClass *` (a class whose members happened to sit at +4/+8/+C
  relative to the derived base) must be re-declared with its **own**
  sub-struct: `typedef struct { char _p[4]; f32 a, b, c; } V;` so the
  displacements come out as `0xc`/`4`/`8`. m2c got this right by accident;
  it is the one place where a *correct* file-local typedef makes the code
  wrong. 73.3% → 81.3%. (Same family as §6dq's "`lwzu` needs the old value
  dead": both are about the *shape* of the address web, not the value.)

* **TELL 3 — in a uniform constant-fill run, ONE store that uses the *other*
  constant register is a real semantic difference, not a register-colour
  diff.** Every field in a 50-store run took `f0` (= 0.0f) except offset
  0x78, which want stores from `f13` (= 1.0f). m2c had assigned
  `unk0x78 = temp_f0`. With the rest of the function byte-identical this was
  the *last single differing word* (98.67% → 100%), and it is the kind of
  1-word diff that is easy to write off as allocation noise. Read the
  *source register* of the stores, not just their displacements; the run's
  uniformity is what makes one exception meaningful. This is the value-side
  twin of §6bh's "two identical-shape stores swapping places is a
  field-assignment bug, not a permutation bug".

* **Store-run ordering at the END of a long uniform run: write the LONG run
  first, then the short pairs, then the integer stores.** The 13-store tail
  window (with a hoisted `lwz`/`ori` read-modify-write of a flag word) has
  want's order `[108][10c][c8][flags][ec][f0][f4][f8][fc][100][104][110]
  [114]`. m2c's order put the short `[108][10c]` pair first, and ngccc then
  broke the 7-store float run: it hoisted 4 stores (including the flag store
  and a redundant second `0x114` store) *above* the run and sank `0xC8`
  *below* it — 14 differing words from an otherwise byte-exact body. Moving
  the long run to the front of the window restored it (81.3% → 93.3%), and
  putting the four integer stores (3× `stw r10` zero + 1× `stw r0` flag —
  a separate store class per §6an-206) as `[110][114][c8][flags]` gave
  98.67%. Ten hand-scored orders, no search; the rule is *run contiguity
  first, then per-class re-ordering of the leftovers*.

* **A `blr`-stub arity audit is not the only use of §6bf's audit — a callee
  that is a real 0xAC-byte function is the case that gets missed.** The
  inherited call `fn_8009E004()` had no declaration at all; its prologue is
  `mr r30,r3` and want leaves r3 untouched at the `bl`, i.e. **1-arg with
  arg0 passthrough**. The *promoted sibling* `src/fn_801A2888.c` already
  declared it (`void fn_8009E004(Unk_DB0E2BAB *);`) — grep `src/` for the
  callee before inventing a prototype, exactly as §6dc prescribes for
  typedefs.

**Audit of the EXACT (left in `src/wip`, not promoted):** object has only
`.text` (0x12C = 300 B = `symbols.txt size:0x12C` = header
`range=0x8009F678-0x8009F7A4 size=300B`) and `.rela.text` — **no private
`.rodata`**, so no doc-14 promote caveat; **0 emitted inline instructions**
(the only `__asm__` strings in the file are inside the header comment);
all 9 relocations verified with the §6bw method — 1 `R_PPC_REL24` to
`fn_8009E004`, 2 self-targeting `R_PPC_REL14` (addends 0x2C/0x40 → 0x8009F6A4
and 0x8009F6B8, the two `bdnz .` self-loops of the empty ctr loops) and 6
`ADDR16_HA/LO` pairs, all hand-decoded to want's `lis`/`addi` immediates
(0x80297C08, 0x80297B54, 0x80297B58 — the last two are 0.0f and 1.0f
respectively, read from `.rodata2`). `// family=m2c` retained so the sweep
keeps scoring it. This is promoteable.

## 6ei — 2026-10-01 single pick: a "dual induction variable" latch ⇒ write the byte
### offset as `index * stride` and let the compiler DERIVE the second IV — the derived
### IV is created by a different pass, and that alone moves the HI16 anchor in the
### preheader (fn_801D1380, 14.8% → EXACT, 216 B, 0 emitted asm, 1 flag, 0 pins)

A 23-iteration skater-physics reset over a 0xC-stride record array. 100 % of the
14.8 % → 100 % ladder was **semantic**; the only codegen lever was one flag.

* **THE RECIPE — dual IV latch + a `lis` anchor wedged between the two constant
  inits.** Want's latch is `cmpwi r28,0 / addi r27,r27,-0xc / addi r28,r28,-1 /
  bne` — a byte-offset IV and a counter IV updated independently — and the
  preheader is `[li r28,0x17][lis r26,-0x7fd0][li r27,0x114]`: the HI16 anchor
  sits **between** the two constant births, which is a position nothing from the
  source can reach, because the front-end constants are born first and the
  reload pseudo is born last. The fix is to stop hand-writing the byte IV:

  ```c
  s32 off = 0x114;   ... node = base + off + 0x24; ... off -= 0xC;   /* 70.4% */
  s32 count = 0x17;
  ...             node = base + count * 0xC + 0x24;  ... /* EXACT   */
  ```

  With `count * 0xC` in the body, loop.c **derives** the offset IV. The derived
  IV's init is emitted by a *late* pass, so it lands AFTER the loop-invariant
  anchor reload and the preheader comes out in want's order. Verified with
  `cc1 -dr -dj`: with the hand-written IV the literal `276` is already in the
  post-reload RTL in the entry block; with `count * 0xC` there is no `276`
  anywhere in the RTL and it is born later. **So: "birth order" is not only about
  source statement order — the pass that creates a def decides its position in
  the preheader, and letting the compiler create the def can be the lever that
  no source permutation reaches.** Related: §6an-1 (dual induction), §6o-184 /
  §6cs-5 (birth order assigns colours), §6bt (web identity) — this is the
  *position* axis they don't cover.

* **NEW CLASS for `-fno-sched-interblock`: it stops loop-invariant DEFS from being
  hoisted into the preheader.** Flagless (74.1 %, 14 diffs, still the right
  216 B) the preheader carries the loop-invariant `f = 1` and the cached
  `count == 7` compare, which drags the loop's top-guard `beq` extent and shifts
  the whole body by one word. With the flag both stay in the loop body exactly
  where want has them and the object is byte-identical. 27-flag sweep: the flag
  is the ONLY one load-bearing (`-fno-schedule-insns` = 13 diffs, `-fno-gcse` /
  `-fno-thread-jumps` / `-fno-rerun-cse-after-loop` / `-Os` / `-O3` = no-ops).
  Existing §4r-2 / §6ds-3 note this flag only for arg-move and prologue
  ordering; add the "invariant def hoisted into the preheader" trigger to the list.

* **Reconfirmed, with a crisp LENGTH datapoint: `while (0 != n--)` vs
  `while (n-- != 0)`** (§6cv). The left form compiles to want's 3-word latch
  `cmpwi/addi/bne`; the right form emits a `mr r0,n` copy and the object comes
  out **4 bytes too long (220 B vs 216 B)**, 56.4 %. Good first check whenever
  the length is wrong and the latch is a post-decrement.

* **Reconfirmed, `add dst,a,b; addi dst,dst,K` needs the sum in TWO statements**
  (§6dq-2's dead-old-value pointer, without the `lwzu`). Written as one
  3-term address `base + count*0xC + 0x24` ngccc puts the sum in a SCRATCH and
  the offset in the destination (`add r9,r9,r27; addi r31,r9,0x24`, 68.5 %,
  17 diffs); split into `node = base + count*0xC; node += 9;` and the sum is
  born directly in the destination register (`add r31,r27,r0; addi r31,r31,0x24`).
  Pair with offset-first addition `(char *)((s32)(i*0xC) + (s32)base)`
  (§6k-66) or the `add`'s operands swap and you lose the other half (72.2 %).

* **Reconfirmed: one C name for a value that is set to two different constants
  is what makes retail's ONE callee-saved register serve both.** `f = 1` /
  `f = 0` → `li r29,1` … `li r29,0` in the same r29. Spelling the literals
  directly gives two registers (r25/r27) and costs the whole function (38.9 %,
  33 diffs). §6bu / §6an-3 / §6cw, in its simplest possible form.

* **Also plain: two `if (cond)` statements instead of one reused compare are
  what produce GCC's cr4 SAVE (`mfcr r12` / `stw r12,0xc(r1)` in the prologue,
  `mtcrf 8, r12` in the epilogue).** The second `if (count == 7)` reuses the
  first's CR compare across two calls, so GCC homes the compare in a
  callee-saved CR field and saves the whole CR. This is doc-28 / §6as-3, and it
  falls out of plain C with no asm and no memory-backed flag — the same body
  with the two index-7 blocks deleted never gets a CR save at all.

* **Audit of the EXACT (left in `src/wip`, not promoted):** object has only
  `.text` (0xD8 = 216 B = `symbols.txt size:0xD8` = the header marker) and
  `.rela.text` — **no private `.rodata`**, so no doc-14 promote caveat;
  **0 emitted inline instructions**; all 6 `R_PPC_REL14` addends
  (`0xac/0x60/0x70/0xa0/0xac/0x28` — readelf prints them hex) resolve to
  0x801D142C/0x801D13E0/0x801D13F0/0x801D1420/0x801D142C/0x801D13A8, exactly
  want's six branch targets, and both `R_PPC_REL24` targets are
  `Tmr_GetTime` = 0x80124F44 (§6bw method); the two externs are
  `lbl_80303150` (`.data:0x80303150, size 0x4`, hand-decoded from want's
  `lis r26,-0x7fd0` + `lwz r0,0x3150(r26)`) and `Tmr_GetTime`
  (`.text:0x80124F44, scope:global`), so the masked-100 %-wrong-label hazard
  (277) cannot apply. `// family=m2c` and the `// FLAG:` line both retained —
  dropping the family marker silently scores the draft flagless (§6bg).

## 6ek — 2026-10-01 single pick: an **`extern f32` global's DECLARATION FORM** (scalar extern vs `extern char[]` + `*(f32 *)`) permutes the WHOLE local-alloc colour map, and **`volatile` on a plain INT store pins it to the top of its block against `sched`** (fn_800A84B4, 15.2% → EXACT, 184B, 0 emitted asm, 0 flags, 0 pins)

A frameless field-fill constructor: one vtable pointer store, an empty 4-iteration
`bdnz .` countdown, then ~40 `stfs` from two `.rodata2` float constants through
four derived base pointers. The m2c draft was **already size-exact 184 B at
15.2%** with 39/184 words differing, and every diff was either a register number
or a small block-order window — i.e. a declaration/type audit, not a scheduling
wall. Four fixes, all semantic, no levers.

**1. `extern f32 lbl_X;` vs `extern char lbl_X[];` + `*(f32 *)lbl_X` — the same
value, a 35% swing, and it moves EVERY base register in the function.** The two
forms produce different RTL for the same load, so `reload` allocates the HI16
anchor out of a different preference set, and the whole colour map rotates:

```
extern f32    lbl_802981F0;   temp_f0 = lbl_802981F0;      15.2%
extern char   lbl_802981F0[]; temp_f0 = *(f32 *)lbl_802981F0;  50.0%
```

before → base copy `mr r7, r3`, derived pointers r10/r9/r11/r8, 39 diffs
after  → base copy `mr r6, r3`, derived pointers r11/r10/r9/r8, 23 diffs

The array form is also what the rest of the file already used for the vtable
label, so it is the *consistent* spelling — worth trying on any draft that
mixes `extern f32 lbl_X;` with `extern char lbl_X[];` in the same TU. Extends
§6bx (pointer-valued global ⇒ `extern T *`), §6bt2 (`const` on a read-only
global) and §6be-L4 (extern symbol vs value-identical literal) to the
**scalar-vs-array axis of the same declaration**, and confirms the family
thesis: *the declaration form of a global is a codegen lever, not just
semantics.* Note it must be a *rewrite* of the extern, not an added one — a
second declaration of the same symbol with a different type is a hard
`conflicting types` FAIL.

**2. `volatile` on a plain INT store as an UNSCHEDULABLE-INSN lever.** want
brackets a `sched` window — the store first (in the `bdnz` delay slot), the
`stfs` last, with two HI16 anchors plus four `addi` in between: retail orders the nine-instruction window with the word store to offset 0x18 first, then the two high-part loads, the four address adds interleaved with the float load, and the float store to offset 0x20 last, while the build pulls both cheap stores into the middle of the address-add run with the float load third and the two stores mid-window.

`sched` pulls both cheap stores into the middle of the `addi` run. Writing the
first one through a `volatile s32 *` lvalue takes it out of the ready list so it
holds the RTL position of the block's first statement: **82.6% → 100.0%, and
the whole 9-insn window then matches**. `volatile` on the *other* store is an
**OR** (either one works, both work) — measure the ablation. This is a NEW use
of `volatile` in this project: every documented use so far is dead-store
survival (§6ao-172), frame-slot sorting (§6bv), a float-op memory fence
(§6ax-173) or hiding a load from a dependent store's alias barrier (§6cc);
here it is a plain integer store whose entire job is to be **pinned against
`sched`'s cost ordering** so it lands at the head of its basic block.

**3. TRIAGE STEP — "four different hand-chosen source orders compiled
byte-identically" proves statement order is not the lever, and `cc1 -dr` then
says who owns the window.** Before grinding source order on a small window,
try 3-4 hand-chosen orders; if every one produces a *byte-identical* object,
`sched` has normalised the window and the only levers left are **frozen-ness**
(`volatile`, `asm volatile`) or the compiler front end. `cc1 -dr` (post-reload
RTL, invocation in §6bz) confirms the source order is already want's, which
rules out source order completely. Here the RTL read was literally want's
sequence and the 7 residual words were pure `sched`/`sched2` output. Cheapest
possible form of the same test: the object is already the right LENGTH, so
per §6cs-1 every diff is placement, not length.

**4. Pin ablation is mandatory once pins are in play — five pin sets all scoring
identically is a warning, not a result.** Reaching 84.8% needed all four
`register … __asm__("rN")` pins; after the correct fix, all 16 subsets
(including the empty one) score 100.0%, so the pins were dead scaffolding that
had been *masking* the real cause. This is the §6bf-A/§6df **OR** case again,
and it is worth stating as a rule: **if N different pin sets give the identical
score, suspect the fix is compensating for a semantic bug rather than fixing a
colour** — go back to §5 of the method (types, declaration forms, constants)
before touching `register`.

**5. Re-confirmations.** Sub-struct store groups through a derived base pointer
each emit **rotate-right** (last source statement first, rest in order —
recipes 24/64/159/206): m2c's `0x8, 0x4, 0xC` for the `+0x80` group needed
ascending `0x4, 0x8, 0xC` to rotate into want's `0xC, 0x8, 0x4` (65.2 → 69.6%).
`extern char lbl_X[]` + `*(f32 *)lbl_X` and the plain `extern f32` form emit
the *same* `ADDR16_HA/LO` relocs and both match, so the §6by-4 "masked score
can't see the declaration form" trap applies in reverse: here only the anchor
*register* differed, and it was visible.

**Audit of the EXACT (left in `src/wip`, not promoted):** object has only
`.text` (0xB8 = 184 B = `symbols.txt size:0xB8` = header `size=184B`) and
`.rela.text` — **no private `.rodata`**, so no doc-14 promote caveat;
**0 emitted inline instructions** (the only `__asm__` is the zero-code
`__asm__ volatile("" ::: "memory")` clobber inside the empty countdown, so
asm density is 0/46); the single `R_PPC_REL14` (addend `0x18` → 0x800A84CC)
equals want's self-targeting `bdnz` (§6bw method), and there are **no
`R_PPC_REL24`** entries (no calls); all three `ADDR16_HA/LO` pairs hand-decoded
from want's `lis`/`addi` immediates — `0x802A0000 − 0x7DC0 = 0x80298240`
(vtable), `0x802A0000 − 0x7E14 = 0x802981EC`, `0x802A0000 − 0x7E10 = 0x802981F0`
— and each is a real `config/G2TE52/symbols.txt` `.rodata2` entry, so the
masked-100 %-wrong-label hazard (277) cannot apply. Promoteable.

## 6el — 2026-10-01 single pick: an m2c "stack slot at base+K" read that lands inside
### the SAVE AREA is a **pointer deref mis-decode**, and a **5-word branchy select
### survives only with a barrier in the NULL arm + the result register matching the
### TEST register** (fn_8009CD60, 18.3% → EXACT, 240B, 0 emitted asm)

A `search_t`-on-the-stack node walk: cursor@+4, name@+8, a `-1` sentinel at
node+0x4, a per-node vcall (s16 off@vt+0x18, fn@vt+0x1C), then node+4/+8
zeroed. All four wins were *semantic or a single zero-code lever*; 0 emitted
instructions, 0 flags, 3 `register`-attribute + 2 `"+r"` constructs.

* **THE LOW-SCORE TELL: m2c writes `*(&sp8 + 0x4 + 0xC)` where want does
  `lwz r9,4(sp); lwz r11,0xc(r9)`.** The expression is a *stack read at
  base + base-offset + field-offset* — the classic shape of an address m2c
  printed as a stack slot. Check the arithmetic: if `field_off` is applied
  **on top of a slot that itself holds a pointer**, the read is a dereference
  of that pointer, not a slot. **The arithmetic is self-checking:** with a
  0x10-byte local the m2c form reads `r1+0x18`, i.e. *inside the callee-save
  area* — a read the compiler happily emits (it never bounds-checks) but that
  is obviously not the game's data. **Compute every m2c stack offset from
  `sizeof(your local)`; anything past the end is a mis-decoded pointer.**
  Sibling of §6bp-1 ("recognize &arg1 param-home spills") and §6bh's
  "a pointer stored into a struct is usually the address of the whole object".
* **The local must be its REAL 16-byte struct, not `s32 sp8` accessed out of
  bounds.** m2c declared `s32 sp8;` and wrote to `+0x4` and `+0x8`, so ngccc
  sized the frame from a 4-byte object (`stwu -0x20` / `stmw r28,0x10`) and
  want's is `stwu -0x28` / `stmw r28,0x18` / `stw r0,0x2c` — 16 bytes of
  locals. §6db's frame arithmetic states the size (`0x28 − 16 − 4·1 = 0x10`),
  and the **field names come from the byte-proven sibling**: this is the
  `search_t` of `src/fn_8021D7F0.c`, and a promoted sibling's file-local
  typedef is a stronger oracle than the corpus-voted `Unk_*` class (§6dc).
  Reusing the sibling's `search_t` also brings its `p->name` / `p->cursor` /
  `s = p` prologue shape (§6d-86) for free.
* **A 5-word branchy select needs THREE things at once, and two of them are
  zero-code.** Want here is
  `cmpwi r11,0 ; bne L ; li r11,0 ; b M ; L: lwz r11,4(r11) ; M: or. r29,r11,r11`
  — the layout `fold_cond_expr` (polarity) and `jump` (arm hoist) destroy from
  every plain spelling (§6dv's register-destination case; a MEMORY destination
  survives, a register one does not). The winning combination:
  ```c
  register Node_t *n __asm__("r11");        /* (1) result register == TEST register */
  ...
  if (n == 0) { __asm__("" : "+r"(n)); n = 0; }   /* (2) barrier: keeps the dead `li` */
  else       { n = n->unk4; }                     /*     AND blocks if-conversion  */
  ```
  With plain `n_2 = (n != 0) ? n->unk4 : 0;` (a SECOND variable) you get 4 words
  in **r0**, not r11 — the result pseudo is a different web, so it cannot
  coalesce with the dying test operand, and the `or.` copy reads r0. The
  **in-place update on ONE variable is what makes `lwz rD,4(rS)` with rD == rS
  legal and therefore what puts the result in r11** (22.0% → 96.7% for the
  in-place edit alone). The `"+r"` barrier is load-bearing (removing it →
  32.2%): without it the `n = 0` is provably dead, GIMPLE deletes both the
  `li` and the `b`, and you lose two words *and* the layout.
  So: **an `if (x) y = 0; else y = f(x)` where want has the 5-word form needs
  (i) the update IN-PLACE on one variable, (ii) a `"+r"` barrier on that
  variable, and (iii) nothing else. §6du's `volatile("")`-in-the-arm was
  measurable here (22% → 75%) but a full 16-combo ablation showed it INERT
  once the barrier was in place** — measure the whole set before assuming any
  one construct is the lever.
* **The loop's twin select needed the barrier in the ELSE arm, not the
  pre-init.** `walker = 0; if (c) walker = c->unk4;` emits `li / cmpwi / beq /
  lwz` with the zero **above** the compare; want has `cmpwi / li / beq / lwz`
  with the zero in the **branch shadow** (§6ad-146). Writing it
  `if (c) walker = c->unk4; else { __asm__("" : "+r"(c)); walker = 0; }` puts
  the zero in the shadow. This is a *different* fix from the `cmpwi`-vs-`li`
  materialisation order of §6c-28/§73-118/§6ap-2 (those provoke a *fresh*
  `li`; this one only changes which *block* the existing `li` lands in), and
  the else-arm `"+r"` barrier is an **OR** with a hard pin on the tested
  variable — either alone kept 100%, both removed dropped to 90%.
* **Free confirmations.** (a) `((s32 (*)())...)` on an indirect call emits a
  spurious `crclr cr1eq`; declaring the slot as a real member
  `void (*fn)(void *);` in a file-local vtable typedef removes it (recipe 21 /
  §4n — and the `s16` at vt+0x18 must be a member too or the `lha` becomes a
  `lwz`, §6dc). (b) The pair `stw r31,4(r30); stw r31,8(r30)` in retail comes
  from source order `8` then `4` (recipe 24/64 store-run rotate). (c) A named
  temp for the `arg0+8` base (`temp_r3`) is load-bearing — inlining it as an
  expression drops 8 points, because retail keeps it live in the *argument*
  register r3 across the first store.
* **Audit:** object `.text` = 0xF0 = 240B = `symbols.txt size:0xF0`; only
  `.text` + `.rela.text` in the object (no private `.rodata`, so no doc-14
  caveat); 9/9 intra-function branch relocations match want (§6bw method);
  `lbl_802978A8` hand-decoded from want's `lis`/`addi`
  (page `0x80290000` + `0x78a8`) and confirmed in `symbols.txt`
  (`.rodata2:0x802978A8`), so hazard 277 cannot apply; no opcode-4 words.
  **Promoteable.**

## 6em — 2026-10-01 single pick: **`volatile void *x` is NOT a volatile variable** (the qualifier is on the pointee, so the store is still DCE'd), and **casting volatile off a STORE is what lets the delay-slot filler place it between the `cmpw` and the `bne`** (fn_80060AB4, 14.5% → EXACT, 192 B, 0 emitted asm, 0 flags, 0 pins)

A linked-list walk (`fn_80060AB4`, 192 B) whose two pointers must round-trip
through the stack every iteration. Two bits of it are new; the rest re-used
§4p-1, §6m-43, L4 and §6q-86. Full lever log in `src/wip/fn_80060AB4.c`.

* **`volatile void *sp10;` is a pointer TO volatile — the VARIABLE is not
  volatile, so ngccc still register-allocates it and DCEs the store.** The
  score went 14.55 % → **2.38 %** on that first "fix" (the stores vanished and
  the object *shrank*), which is the diagnostic: the qualifier must be
  `void *volatile sp10;` (equivalently `volatile void *sp10;` as a **struct
  member**, where the member declaration `volatile void *` does qualify the
  member). A stack-resident list walker is the shape where this matters, because
  "make the loop variable live in memory" and "make the *pointer* volatile"
  read the same but differ by one `*`. Same class as the documented
  "pointer-typed register pins are dropped" rules (§6az-245 / §76-178): it is a
  qualifier/type-position trap, not a codegen wall.

* **A `volatile` STORE cannot be moved into a branch delay slot; casting
  volatile off *just the store* can.** want's loop latch is
  `[load p][load head][load p->4][cmpw][stw p] ; bne` — the `stw` is the
  **delay slot** of the `bne`, i.e. the scheduler hoisted it *past* the compare.
  With a `volatile` member the store is a side-effecting insn that
  `final_insn_delayed_slot` refuses to move, so it stays before the `sp8` read
  (77.1 %). Declaring the struct member plain and reading it through
  `*(volatile void **)&fr.sp10` (cast the address once) keeps every read
  ordered and un-CSE-able while leaving the store schedulable — the store then
  lands in the delay slot exactly as retail has it. This is the mirror image of
  §6bz-2 ("a volatile WRITE with a NON-VOLATILE READ freezes only the store"),
  which used the same mix to *freeze* a store; here the mix is used to *loosen*
  one. Generalisable trigger: **a residual `stw` that is one position too early
  relative to the `cmpw` that precedes its `bne`** — check whether the variable
  is volatile before reaching for a barrier or a pin.

* Corollary, worth knowing because it fixed 3 words for free: the `volatile`
  read is only *ordered relative to other volatile reads* — a following
  **non-volatile** load is free to sink to right after its own volatile read.
  To get want's `[load p][load head][load p->4]` the source must read BOTH
  pointers into named locals **before** the `->4` load, in that order
  (`c = fr.sp10; h = fr.sp8; n = c->4; fr.sp10 = n;` → `while (n != h)`). Doing
  so also fixed the pre-loop register colours (r9/r0) without a pin — the extra
  short-lived pseudos shifted the local-alloc pool, §6ds-2.

* The other three wins, all re-used, for the record: the callee was **5-arg**
  (m2c's 4-arg cost a `crclr cr1eq` and shifted the whole arg-setup window), its
  **arg0 is the field-pass** the guard just loaded, and the return constant is
  a `.rodata2 data:float` so `extern f32` + bare use is required (m2c's
  `extern char` + `*(s32 *)` synthesized the whole xoris/`lis 0x4330`/lfd/fsub/
  frsp dance plus a private 8-byte `.rodata` pool). Frame: 36 bytes of locals at
  r1+8 / r1+0x10 / r1+0x18, reproduced with a §6q-86 frame-template struct whose
  interior gaps are **explicit `char` pads** (§6dy/§6de) — and the trailing pad
  had to be tuned by measurement (`char pad2[16]` overshot the frame by 8;
  `[8]` hit 0x40 / stmw 0x2c / f31 0x38 exactly).

**Audit of the EXACT (left in `src/wip`, not promoted):** object has only
`.text` (0xC0 = 192 B = `symbols.txt size:0xC0` = the header marker) and
`.rela.text` — no `.rodata`/`.bss`, so no doc-14 promote caveat; **0 emitted
inline instructions**; all **7** branch relocations verified with the §6bw
method against independently decoded want words (5 `R_PPC_REL14` addends
+0x38/+0xA0/+0x88/+0x88/+0x4C, the local `b`'s `R_PPC_REL24` +0xA8, and the one
`R_PPC_REL24` call target `fn_80052248`); the two `lbl_80293EE4` references are
`R_PPC_ADDR16_HA` + `R_PPC_ADDR16_LO` against the real `.rodata2` symbol, so the
masked `lis 0; lfs 0(r9)` immediates are link-correct and the hazard-277
wrong-label case cannot apply. Promoteable.

## 6en — 2026-10-01 single pick: a statics-DCE husk in a node-manager family goes
### 0% → **91.07%** on semantics + two promoted siblings as templates, and the last 5
### words are a **preheader-ordering wall with a proven mechanism** (fn_80032698, 224B)

`fn_80032698` (node-list "remove and release") arrived as a textbook §6j-4 DCE husk:
m2c rendered the notify call as `if (tmp == 0) { vcall }` nested inside
`if (tmp != 0)`, so GCC deleted it and the object was **152 B for a 224 B want**.
